words.enDefinition: fitting slightly closer than you would like

examples.en: The shoes felt a little snug after I stood in them.
examples.zh: 我穿着这双鞋站起来后，觉得它们「稍微有点紧」。

examples.en: I told the assistant the cardigan was a little snug across my chest.
examples.zh: 我告诉店员，这件开衫胸口「稍微有点紧」。

collocations: be a little snug at first
a little snug around the toes

words.zhGloss: 商品应达到的合理质量
words.enDefinition: in Australian consumer usage, the standard of quality people can reasonably expect for particular goods
acceptedZhAnswers: 商品应达到的合理质量

examples.en: The Australian guide discussed acceptable quality using examples of new and secondhand products.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南用新品和二手商品的实例介绍「商品应达到的合理质量」。

examples.en: I read the part about acceptable quality before speaking to the store about my order.
examples.zh: 去找店家问订单之前，我读了关于「商品应达到的合理质量」的那一部分。

words.enDefinition: indicating that a code for online course materials has been redeemed

examples.en: The seller wrote access code already used beside the photo of the textbook's back cover.
examples.zh: 卖家在教材封底的照片旁注明「访问码已使用」。

examples.en: The bookshop label read access code already used beneath the price of the used workbook.
examples.zh: 旧练习册价格下方的店铺标签注明「访问码已使用」。

collocations: listed with access code already used
notice reading access code already used
label marked access code already used

words.enDefinition: coverage for specified damage resulting from an unexpected accident

examples.en: I read about accidental damage protection before deciding whether to buy the plan.
examples.zh: 我先看了有关「意外损坏保障」的说明，才决定是否买这个方案。

examples.en: The adviser said the screen replacement fell under accidental damage protection in my plan.
examples.zh: 客服说，按我的方案，更换屏幕属于「意外损坏保障」。

words.enDefinition: A note warning that the item's real color may differ from the image.

examples.en: The listing said “Actual color may vary” immediately below the photo of the green pouch.
examples.zh: 绿色小包照片的正下方注明了「实物颜色可能有差异」。

examples.en: I saw “Actual color may vary” and decided to look at a few buyer photos.
examples.zh: 我看到「实物颜色可能有差异」，于是决定看看买家拍的照片。

collocations: a note saying actual color may vary
a caption reading actual color may vary
a listing stating actual color may vary

words.enDefinition: indicating that the images show the exact item being sold

examples.en: The listing said actual item pictured beside the photo of the brass lamp.
examples.zh: 商品页在黄铜台灯的照片旁标了「照片为商品实拍」。

examples.en: I checked for actual item pictured because I wanted to see the camera's condition.
examples.zh: 我想看相机的实际成色，所以找了找有没有「照片为商品实拍」的标注。

words.enDefinition: The real size of an item without any enlargement or reduction.

examples.en: A note explained that the preview showed the sticker at actual size when printed.
examples.zh: 一条说明写着，预览图打印后按贴纸的「实际大小」呈现。

examples.en: I wanted to see the actual size of the label before ordering a whole sheet.
examples.zh: 订购一整张标签前，我想看看单个标签的「实际大小」。

words.enDefinition: to put a decorative strip around a parcel or gift box

examples.en: Could you add a ribbon to the box before I collect it?
examples.zh: 我来取之前，能给盒子「加一条装饰丝带」吗？

examples.en: The assistant offered to add a ribbon that matched the wrapping paper.
examples.zh: 店员提出「加一条和包装纸相配的装饰丝带」。

collocations: add a ribbon to the gift box
ask someone to add a ribbon

words.enDefinition: to credit points using a receipt from an earlier purchase

examples.en: The cashier explained whether I could add points from a receipt after forgetting my card.
examples.zh: 我忘了带卡，收银员解释了是否能「凭小票补录积分」。

examples.en: I brought the paper slip back to add points from a receipt the next day.
examples.zh: 第二天，我把纸质小票拿回店里「凭小票补录积分」。

collocations: option to add points from a receipt
ask staff to add points from a receipt
add points from a receipt online

words.enDefinition: To put a selected item into the list of things you may buy.

examples.en: I clicked “Add to cart” after choosing the blue cover for my new notebook.
examples.zh: 为新笔记本选了蓝色封套后，我点了「加入购物车」。

examples.en: The “Add to cart” button became available when I selected a size from the menu.
examples.zh: 我在菜单里选好尺寸后，「加入购物车」按钮就可以点了。

collocations: select a size before using add to cart

words.enDefinition: another person with a card linked to an existing membership

examples.en: My sister was listed as an additional cardholder on the shared shopping account.
examples.zh: 共享购物账户把我姐姐列为「会员附卡持有人」。

examples.en: The clerk asked the additional cardholder to update the name on her card.
examples.zh: 店员请「会员附卡持有人」更新卡上的姓名。

words.zhGloss: 收件人写的是别的顾客
words.enDefinition: bearing a label with a different shopper as the recipient
acceptedZhAnswers: 收件人写的是别的顾客

examples.en: The box was addressed to another customer, although the receipt inside was mine.
examples.zh: 箱里的收据是我的，但「收件人写的是别的顾客」。

examples.en: I told the seller the parcel was addressed to another customer nearby.
examples.zh: 我告诉卖家，「收件人写的是附近的另一位顾客」。

collocations: a parcel addressed to another customer
a package mistakenly addressed to another customer
report a parcel addressed to another customer

words.zhGloss: 先发替换品的换货方式
words.enDefinition: an exchange where the substitute is sent before the original is returned
acceptedZhAnswers: 先发替换品的换货方式

examples.en: The retailer offered an advance exchange so I could keep working until the monitor arrived.
examples.zh: 零售商提供了「先发替换品的换货方式」，这样新显示器到货前我还能继续工作。

examples.en: I read the advance exchange terms before accepting the replacement on the customer portal.
examples.zh: 我先读了「先发替换品的换货方式」条款，才在客户页面上接受替换商品。

words.enDefinition: The amount a promotion says a shopper can save under its stated conditions.

examples.en: The advertised savings assumed I would buy both versions of the notebook in the set.
examples.zh: 「广告所示省款金额」是按套装内两个版本的笔记本都买来算的。

examples.en: I checked how the advertised savings were calculated before buying the pencil case and refills.
examples.zh: 我先核对「广告所示省款金额」是怎么算的，再买笔袋和替芯。

collocations: compare the advertised savings with your total

words.enDefinition: a version of a product included in a specified problem or recall

examples.en: My laptop was listed as an affected model on the manufacturer's support page.
examples.zh: 厂商的支持页面把我的笔记本电脑列为「受影响的型号」。

examples.en: I checked the affected model against the number printed on the back of mine.
examples.zh: 我把「受影响的型号」和我的设备背面印的号码做了核对。

words.enDefinition: a sign identifying a numbered or labelled store aisle

examples.en: I checked the aisle marker after the assistant told me to look for twelve.
examples.zh: 店员让我找十二号过道，我就看了「过道编号牌」。

examples.en: The aisle marker was easier to see once I had passed the display.
examples.zh: 经过展台后，「过道编号牌」就更容易看见了。

words.enDefinition: a condition indicating all the parts supplied with an item are present

examples.en: The return slip asked me to check the box marked all accessories included before packing.
examples.zh: 打包前，退货随附单请我勾选「配件齐全」一栏。

examples.en: The clerk wrote all accessories included after counting the pieces in the box.
examples.zh: 店员清点盒子里的零件后，写下了「配件齐全」。

words.enDefinition: a condition requiring every original tag to stay fixed to the item

examples.en: I brought the jacket back with all tags attached and the spare button included.
examples.zh: 我退回夹克时「吊牌齐全且未拆」，还附上了备用纽扣。

examples.en: The form asked me to confirm that it arrived with all tags attached.
examples.zh: 表格请我确认收到商品时「吊牌齐全且未拆」。

words.enDefinition: The cheapest price in the available record for an item.

examples.en: The tracking chart showed that the lamp had hit an all-time low that morning.
examples.zh: 追踪图表显示，这款台灯当天上午达到了「历史最低价」。

examples.en: I bought the speaker after the site flagged its price as an all-time low.
examples.zh: 网站提示音箱达到了「历史最低价」后，我买了它。

collocations: an all-time low for this model

words.enDefinition: indicating an item has been picked up by someone

examples.en: The free cupboard showed as already collected when I checked the group.
examples.zh: 我查看群消息时，那个免费橱柜已标为「已被取走」。

examples.en: The seller said the chair was already collected before the listing came down.
examples.zh: 卖家说，帖子撤下前，椅子就「已被取走」了。

words.enDefinition: a named person other than the buyer who may collect the order

examples.en: I added my roommate as the alternate pickup person before placing the order.
examples.zh: 下单前，我把室友添加为「代取人」。

examples.en: The order page let me change the alternate pickup person after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在订单页面更换了「代取人」。

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether there is any new information about your request

examples.en: “Any update on my case?” I wrote after the shop missed its promised reply.
examples.zh: 店家说好的回复时间过了，我写道「我的工单有进展吗？」

examples.en: I reopened the chat that afternoon and typed, “Any update on my case?”
examples.zh: 那天下午我重新打开聊天框，打字问「我的工单有进展吗？」

collocations: “Is there any update on my case?”
“Any update on my case since yesterday?”

words.enDefinition: To submit a promotion code so it can be checked and used on an order.

examples.en: I waited to apply a code until I had checked which notebook sizes it covered.
examples.zh: 我确认它适用于哪些尺寸的笔记本后，才「使用优惠码」。

examples.en: The page let me apply a code before I selected the delivery method for my order.
examples.zh: 页面允许我先「使用优惠码」，再为订单选择配送方式。

collocations: a box to apply a code

words.enDefinition: to accept the proposed cost so the provider can start the work

examples.en: I waited until I had compared both options before choosing to approve the estimate.
examples.zh: 我比较过两个选项后，才决定「同意按报价维修」。

examples.en: The technician asked whether I could approve the estimate by replying to the email.
examples.zh: 维修人员问我能否回复邮件「同意按报价维修」。

collocations: ask a customer to approve the estimate

words.enDefinition: Matching the information given in the written description.

examples.en: The clip light worked as described and fit on the shelf beside my bed.
examples.zh: 夹灯的表现「与说明一致」，也能夹在我床边的架子上。

examples.en: The refill pack arrived as described, with the same page layout shown in the pictures.
examples.zh: 内页补充装到手后「与说明一致」，页面版式也跟图上一样。

words.enDefinition: in the current condition of the item being sold

examples.en: The speaker was sold as is with a note about its loose knob.
examples.zh: 音箱「按现状出售」，备注里写明有个旋钮松了。

examples.en: The shop sells most donated lamps as is and describes any visible damage.
examples.zh: 店家把大部分捐来的灯具「按现状出售」，并说明可见的损伤。

collocations: buy a used item as is

words.enDefinition: Matching the appearance shown in an image or online listing.

examples.en: The pencil case looked exactly as pictured, even in the darker corner of my desk.
examples.zh: 即使放在光线较暗的桌角，这个笔袋看起来也「与图片一致」。

examples.en: One buyer said the box was as pictured and uploaded a photo on the review page.
examples.zh: 一位买家说收纳盒「与图片一致」，还在评价页上传了一张照片。

words.enDefinition: to ask someone to confirm spoken information in writing

examples.en: I went back to ask for written confirmation of the dispatch address.
examples.zh: 我回去「索取了书面确认」，想核实寄送地址。

examples.en: The buyer chose to ask for written confirmation after a long phone call.
examples.zh: 打了很久的电话后，买家决定「索取书面确认」。

collocations: ask for written confirmation by email
ask for written confirmation of the arrangement
call and ask for written confirmation

words.expression: ask the marketplace to step in
words.lemma: ask the marketplace to step in
words.enDefinition: to request intervention from the company running the marketplace
acceptedEnVariants: ask the marketplace to step in

examples.en: I could ask the marketplace to step in from the same order page.
examples.zh: 我能在同一个订单页面上「请电商平台介入」。

examples.en: I sent one final message before deciding whether to ask the marketplace to step in.
examples.zh: 我最后又发了一条消息，然后才决定要不要「请电商平台介入」。

collocations: choose to ask the marketplace to step in
ask the marketplace to step in on a case
decide whether to ask the marketplace to step in

words.enDefinition: the amount a seller initially wants for an item

examples.en: I offered less than the asking price because the speaker was missing a cable.
examples.zh: 因为音箱少了根线，我出的价低于「卖方要价」。

examples.en: The asking price on the old bike included a lock and a helmet.
examples.zh: 旧自行车的「卖方要价」包含一把锁和一个头盔。

words.enDefinition: the staff member currently responsible for a support request

examples.en: I sent the new photo to the assigned agent through the case page.
examples.zh: 我通过工单页面把新照片发给了「指定处理客服」。

examples.en: The assigned agent introduced herself and said she had read my earlier messages.
examples.zh: 「指定处理客服」先报了自己的名字，说已经看过我之前的消息。

words.enDefinition: confirmation by staff before a self-service transaction can continue

examples.en: The screen asked for attendant approval after I removed the duplicate item.
examples.zh: 我去掉重复录入的商品后，屏幕提示「需收银员确认」。

examples.en: I paused at the checkout when the display showed “Attendant approval required.”
examples.zh: 屏幕显示「需收银员确认」时，我在收银台停了下来。

words.enDefinition: a business approved by a manufacturer to provide specified product services

examples.en: The shop referred me to an authorized service provider closer to the main campus.
examples.zh: 店家让我去离主校区更近的「授权服务机构」。

examples.en: The authorized service provider confirmed which repair jobs it could handle that week.
examples.zh: 「授权服务机构」确认了当周能受理哪些维修。

words.enDefinition: a message sent without a person writing it at the time

examples.en: The automated reply said my photos had been added to the request.
examples.zh: 「自动回复」说，我的照片已经添加到申请里了。

examples.en: I received an automated reply before anyone at the shop read my message.
examples.zh: 店里还没人看我的消息，我就收到了「自动回复」。

words.enDefinition: a system ending a case without a person closing it

examples.en: The automated message warned of automatic case closure if nobody replied to it.
examples.zh: 自动消息提示，如果没人回复，就会「工单自动关闭」。

examples.en: I asked whether automatic case closure affected my ability to see the chat.
examples.zh: 我问「工单自动关闭」后，我还能不能查看聊天内容。

collocations: notify users of automatic case closure
check the reason for automatic case closure

words.enDefinition: A discount the system applies without a shopper entering a code.

examples.en: An automatic discount appeared after I added the matching set of pens to the cart.
examples.zh: 我把配套的那套笔加入购物车后，页面显示了「自动减免」。

examples.en: The store applied an automatic discount to the online order for my project supplies.
examples.zh: 店铺给我网购项目用品的订单做了「自动减免」。

collocations: an automatic discount in the cart

words.enDefinition: points already credited and ready to be redeemed

examples.en: I used my available points to reduce the price of a notebook at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时，我用「可用积分」抵扣了笔记本的一部分价格。

examples.en: The account displayed available points separately from rewards waiting to be confirmed that week.
examples.zh: 账户把「可用积分」与那周等待确认的奖励分开显示。

words.enDefinition: The overall score calculated from the ratings submitted for an item.

examples.en: The page displayed the average rating beside the number of people who had rated the notebook.
examples.zh: 页面把「平均评分」显示在给这款笔记本打分的人数旁边。

examples.en: I checked the average rating, then read comments from students who used the same planner.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「平均评分」，然后读了使用同款手账的学生写的评论。

collocations: an average rating of four stars

words.enDefinition: a status showing that no staff member has taken the request yet

examples.en: My ticket showed “awaiting agent assignment” when I checked the app after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后查看应用时，工单显示「等待分配客服」。

examples.en: The page still said “awaiting agent assignment” after I uploaded the photos.
examples.zh: 我上传照片后，页面仍显示「等待分配客服」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that support is waiting to hear from the customer

examples.en: The status said “awaiting customer response” because I hadn't attached a picture yet.
examples.zh: 状态显示「等待买家回复」，因为我还没附上照片。

examples.en: I checked the message after my case changed to “awaiting customer response” that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，工单变为「等待买家回复」，我便去查看了消息。

words.enDefinition: Available to buy again after previously selling out.

examples.en: The small white desk organizer came back in stock a few days before term started.
examples.zh: 开学前几天，小号白色桌面收纳架「已补货」。

examples.en: The page said the refill was back in stock, so I could finally order it.
examples.zh: 页面显示替芯「已补货」，我终于可以买了。

collocations: get a back in stock email

words.enDefinition: A sale aimed at people buying supplies for a new school term.

examples.en: I looked through the back-to-school sale for a calculator and a pack of folders.
examples.zh: 我浏览了「开学季促销」，想买一台计算器和一包文件夹。

examples.en: Our campus bookstore advertised its back-to-school sale on a board near the main entrance.
examples.zh: 校园书店在主入口附近的牌子上打出了「开学季促销」的广告。

words.enDefinition: the area next to a checkout for scanned items

examples.en: I set the notebooks in the bagging area after scanning them.
examples.zh: 我扫完笔记本后，把它们放到「结账装袋区」。

examples.en: There wasn't much room in the bagging area for the larger box.
examples.zh: 「结账装袋区」没多少空间放那个大盒子。

collocations: put an item in the bagging area
an item left in the bagging area

words.enDefinition: the usual points earned before any promotional points or bonuses are added

examples.en: The statement showed base points from each purchase and listed the bonuses separately.
examples.zh: 结算单显示每笔消费的「基础积分」，并另列额外积分。

examples.en: I received the base points for my order even after the promotion ended.
examples.zh: 即使活动结束了，我仍收到了这笔订单的「基础积分」。

words.enDefinition: a checkout rule admitting baskets and excluding shopping carts

examples.en: The sign said “Baskets only” above the smaller row of checkouts.
examples.zh: 较小的那排收银台上方写着「仅限手提篮结账」。

examples.en: I followed the “Baskets only” sign because I had just a few items.
examples.zh: 我只买了几件商品，就按「仅限手提篮结账」的牌子走。

words.enDefinition: A notice saying the batteries needed by a product are not supplied.

examples.en: The listing said “Batteries not included” just below the photograph of the small alarm clock.
examples.zh: 小闹钟照片正下方的商品说明写着「不含电池」。

examples.en: I almost missed “Batteries not included” because the words appeared below the product details.
examples.zh: 「不含电池」几个字出现在商品详情下面，我差点没看到。

collocations: a listing marked batteries not included
read batteries not included on the box

words.enDefinition: a measure of how well a battery still holds charge

examples.en: I asked about battery health because the phone was several years old.
examples.zh: 我问了「电池健康度」，因为那部手机已经用了好几年。

examples.en: The used laptop listing included a screenshot showing its battery health.
examples.zh: 那台二手笔记本电脑的商品页附了一张显示「电池健康度」的截图。

words.enDefinition: Describes a price or order amount that has not been reduced by discounts.

examples.en: The page showed the total before discounts separately from the final amount for our order.
examples.zh: 页面分别显示了「折前」总额和我们这单实际要付的金额。

examples.en: I noted the cost before discounts so I could keep a clear record for our group.
examples.zh: 我记下了「折前」费用，好给小组留一份清楚的记录。

words.enDefinition: Describes a price that does not yet include the charge for shipping.

examples.en: The smaller number was the price before shipping, which explained the difference between the two screens.
examples.zh: 小一点的数字是「未计配送费」的价格，这解释了两个页面为什么不同。

examples.en: I noted the cost before shipping, then checked the options for delivery to campus.
examples.zh: 我记下「未计配送费」的价格，然后查看送到校园的配送选项。

words.enDefinition: Describes an amount calculated without any applicable tax added.

examples.en: The smaller figure was the price before tax, according to the breakdown on the screen.
examples.zh: 按页面明细，较小的数字是「税前」价格。

examples.en: I copied the price before tax because our project estimate listed taxes on a separate line.
examples.zh: 我们项目的估算把税单列了一行，所以我抄了「税前」价格。

words.enDefinition: on the employee side of a retail counter

examples.en: The spare headphones were kept behind the counter in a small cabinet.
examples.zh: 备用耳机放在「柜台后面」的小柜子里。

examples.en: The sign said the batteries were behind the counter by the entrance.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着，电池在入口处的「柜台后面」。

collocations: an item stored behind the counter

words.enDefinition: a base charge for taking in and checking equipment at a repair shop's workbench

examples.en: The shop quoted a flat bench fee for checking the record player on its workbench.
examples.zh: 维修店给出了在工作台上检查唱机的固定「工作台检查费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the bench fee was separate from the charge for replacing parts.
examples.zh: 我问「工作台检查费」是不是和更换部件的费用分开算。

words.enDefinition: the step that makes a particular membership benefit available for use

examples.en: I completed benefit activation before booking my first grocery delivery for the semester.
examples.zh: 我先完成「福利开通」，才预约本学期第一次送货上门。

examples.en: The account showed the date of benefit activation under my partner offer details.
examples.zh: 账户在合作商家优惠详情下方显示了「福利开通」的日期。

words.enDefinition: fitting somewhere between two standard sizes for an item

examples.en: I'm between sizes in these jeans, so neither pair feels quite right.
examples.zh: 这款牛仔裤我「介于两个尺码之间」，两条穿起来都不太合适。

examples.en: The assistant said I might be between sizes in this particular style.
examples.zh: 店员说，就这款来说，我可能「介于两个尺码之间」。

words.enDefinition: too badly damaged to be restored to working condition

examples.en: The technician said the old charger was beyond repair after examining the connector.
examples.zh: 维修人员检查接口后说，旧充电器「已无法修复」。

examples.en: The water-damaged speaker was beyond repair, so the service centre returned it to me.
examples.zh: 进水的音箱「已无法修复」，所以服务中心把它退还给了我。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which a bid must typically increase

examples.en: The auction page showed the bid increment just below the current price.
examples.zh: 拍卖页面在当前价格下方显示了「加价幅度」。

examples.en: I asked about the bid increment when the campus auction opened on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六校园拍卖开始时，我问了「加价幅度」。

words.enDefinition: a membership benefit offered around the member's birthday

examples.en: The birthday reward appeared in the shopping app a week before my birthday.
examples.zh: 我的生日还有一周时，购物应用里就出现了「生日奖励」。

examples.en: I used my birthday reward when I bought coffee with a classmate on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二我和同学买咖啡时，用了「生日奖励」。

words.enDefinition: A sale held as part of the shopping event known as Black Friday.

examples.en: I tracked the lamp's price for a week before checking the Black Friday sale.
examples.zh: 在查看「黑色星期五促销」前，我跟踪了一周这款台灯的价格。

examples.en: The small backpack was included in the Black Friday sale, according to the store's email.
examples.zh: 按店铺邮件，小号背包参加「黑色星期五促销」。

collocations: a Black Friday sale on electronics

words.enDefinition: points awarded on top of the standard reward for a purchase

examples.en: The app added bonus loyalty points when I bought the notebook on Friday.
examples.zh: 我周五买笔记本时，应用发放了「额外会员积分」。

examples.en: My receipt separated bonus loyalty points from the points I normally earn each week.
examples.zh: 收据把「额外会员积分」与我每周正常赚的积分分开列出。

words.enDefinition: A package that contains extra product as part of a promotion.

examples.en: The bonus pack contained more drawing paper, but I checked the dimensions before buying it.
examples.zh: 「加量促销装」里有更多绘图纸，不过我买之前先核对了尺寸。

examples.en: I chose the bonus pack because my roommate and I could share the extra pens.
examples.zh: 我选了「加量促销装」，因为额外的笔可以和室友分着用。

collocations: compare a bonus pack with a regular pack

words.enDefinition: an arrangement for exchanging books with other people

examples.en: We held a book exchange so first years could find affordable course readers.
examples.zh: 我们办了次「图书交换活动」，让大一学生能找到负担得起的课程读本。

examples.en: Mina brought her old novels to the book exchange after her final exam.
examples.zh: 米娜期末考试结束后，把旧小说带去参加「图书交换活动」。

words.enDefinition: the lowest surface in a set of shelves

examples.en: I checked the bottom shelf after noticing that the sign pointed down.
examples.zh: 看到标牌上的箭头朝下，我就看了「最下层货架」。

examples.en: The larger storage boxes were kept on the bottom shelf near the till.
examples.zh: 大一点的收纳盒放在收银台旁边的「最下层货架」上。

collocations: store boxes on the bottom shelf

words.expression: bring it out to the car
words.lemma: bring it out to the car
words.enDefinition: to carry the purchase outside to the customer's car
acceptedEnVariants: bring it out to the car

examples.en: I asked whether someone could bring it out to the car after class.
examples.zh: 我问下课后来取时，能不能请店员「把货拿到车边」。

examples.en: The assistant offered to bring it out to the car once it was packed.
examples.zh: 店员说装好后可以「把货拿到车边」。

collocations: ask someone to bring it out to the car
offer to bring it out to the car
could you bring it out to the car

words.enDefinition: to get an item of another size for me to try

examples.en: Could you bring me a different size when you get a chance?
examples.zh: 你有空时能「帮我拿另一个尺码」吗？

examples.en: I asked the attendant to bring me a different size of the same jacket.
examples.zh: 我请服务员「帮我拿同款夹克的另一个尺码」。

collocations: could you bring me a different size
ask someone to bring me a different size
bring me a different size of this style

words.enDefinition: to come with another person who can help lift something

examples.en: Should I bring someone to help lift the dresser when I come to pick it up?
examples.zh: 我来取斗柜时，要不要「带个人帮忙抬」？

examples.en: The listing said to bring someone to help lift the piano into the buyer's van.
examples.zh: 商品页提醒要「带个人帮忙抬」，把钢琴搬进买家的厢式车。

collocations: need to bring someone to help lift
tell buyers to bring someone to help lift
ask whether to bring someone to help lift

words.enDefinition: How well an item is made, assembled, and finished.

examples.en: Several reviewers liked the build quality of the lamp but mentioned the short power cord.
examples.zh: 几名评价者满意这盏灯的「做工质量」，但提到了电源线较短。

examples.en: I could not judge the build quality of the laptop stand from the photos alone.
examples.zh: 单凭照片，我判断不出电脑支架的「做工质量」。

words.enDefinition: to move an older sale post higher in a marketplace feed

examples.en: The app offered to bump a listing so more local buyers might see it.
examples.zh: 应用提供了「把帖子顶上去」的功能，让更多本地买家有机会看到。

examples.en: Our student resale group has a rule about when you can bump a listing.
examples.zh: 我们的学生二手群对什么时候能「把帖子顶上去」有规定。

collocations: bump a listing in a group

words.enDefinition: An offer instruction allowing the shopper to choose any two qualifying items.

examples.en: The sign said “Buy any two” above the shelf of notebooks with matching covers.
examples.zh: 摆了同款封面笔记本的货架上方，牌子写着「任选两件」。

examples.en: We checked which pens were included before using the “Buy any two” offer online.
examples.zh: 在网上用「任选两件」的优惠之前，我们查了哪些笔可以参加。

collocations: a sign reading buy any two

words.enDefinition: to purchase several things together under one price

examples.en: Can I buy as a bundle if I want the camera, bag, and extra lens?
examples.zh: 相机、包和额外的镜头我都想要，可以「打包购买」吗？

examples.en: The pans were cheaper to buy as a bundle than they were to buy individually.
examples.zh: 这些锅「打包购买」比单买更便宜。

collocations: available to buy as a bundle
cheaper to buy as a bundle

words.enDefinition: to purchase something that you sold to someone earlier

examples.en: The campus shop offered to buy back textbooks it sold earlier that term.
examples.zh: 校园商店表示愿意「回购」本学期早些时候售出的课本。

examples.en: Will the bike shop buy back the bicycle I bought there last spring?
examples.zh: 自行车店会「回购」我去年春天从那里买的那辆车吗？

collocations: agree to buy back a bike

words.enDefinition: Advertises larger savings when a shopper buys more qualifying items.

examples.en: The site said “Buy more, save more” above the pens included in the deal.
examples.zh: 网站在参加活动的笔上方写着「买得越多省得越多」。

examples.en: I read “Buy more, save more” before checking how the discount changed with the quantity.
examples.zh: 我看到「买得越多省得越多」后，去查看折扣如何随数量变化。

collocations: a banner saying “buy more, save more”

words.enDefinition: a local Buy Nothing community that gives things away freely

examples.en: Someone in our Buy Nothing group offered an extra chair for my flat.
examples.zh: 我们「社区免费互赠群」里有人要送一把多余的椅子，正好我公寓用得上。

examples.en: My neighbour found a spare watering can through the Buy Nothing group last week.
examples.zh: 邻居上周通过「社区免费互赠群」找到一个闲置浇水壶。

collocations: post in a Buy Nothing group

words.enDefinition: An option to go straight to buying the selected item.

examples.en: I clicked “Buy now” because the notebook was the only thing I wanted to order.
examples.zh: 我只想订那本笔记本，所以点了「立即购买」。

examples.en: For each color, the page showed the “Buy now” option beside the cart button.
examples.zh: 页面上，每种颜色旁的购物车按钮边上都有一个「立即购买」选项。

words.enDefinition: An offer giving a second qualifying product free when one is bought.

examples.en: The bookstore advertised “Buy one get one free” on a display of matching notebooks.
examples.zh: 书店在陈列成套笔记本的区域挂出了「买一送一」的广告。

examples.en: My roommate and I used a buy one get one free offer to get two pencil cases.
examples.zh: 我和室友用「买一送一」的优惠买了两个笔袋。

collocations: a buy one get one free offer
a buy one get one free sticker
advertise buy one get one free

words.enDefinition: a marketplace program that helps with qualifying purchase problems

examples.en: I checked whether buyer protection applied to the order I placed online.
examples.zh: 我查了「买家保障」是否适用我在网上下的那笔订单。

examples.en: The marketplace described buyer protection on a page linked from the order.
examples.zh: 电商平台在订单链接到的页面上介绍了「买家保障」。

words.enDefinition: a request for help under a purchase protection program

examples.en: My buyer protection claim included photos showing the item I actually received.
examples.zh: 我的「买家保障申请」里附了实际收到的商品照片。

examples.en: The marketplace assigned a reference to my buyer protection claim that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，电商平台给我的「买家保障申请」分配了一个编号。

collocations: a decision on a buyer protection claim

words.enDefinition: regret about a purchase after deciding to make it

examples.en: I felt buyer's remorse after realising the new speaker was larger than my desk.
examples.zh: 发现新音箱比我的桌面还大后，我有点「买后后悔」。

examples.en: Her buyer's remorse faded once she tried the jacket with her other clothes at home.
examples.zh: 她在家把夹克配着其他衣服试穿了一下，「买后后悔」的感觉渐渐消失了。

words.enDefinition: the platform's messaging service for customers and sellers

examples.en: I sent the photo through buyer-seller messaging so it stayed with the order.
examples.zh: 我通过「买卖双方站内消息」发了照片，这样照片就会和订单留在一起。

examples.en: The platform displayed the seller's reply in the buyer-seller messaging area.
examples.zh: 平台把卖家的回复显示在「买卖双方站内消息」区。

collocations: find a thread in buyer-seller messaging

words.enDefinition: a fee for sending a technician to the customer's location

examples.en: The repair company listed a call-out charge before the hourly rate for labour.
examples.zh: 维修公司先列出「上门服务费」，再列每小时的人工费。

examples.en: We split the call-out charge because the printer belonged to three flatmates.
examples.zh: 打印机是三个室友共有的，所以我们分摊了「上门服务费」。

words.enDefinition: to ask the staff member supervising a checkout to come over

examples.en: The screen said to call the attendant if the barcode couldn't be read.
examples.zh: 屏幕提示，如果读不出条码，就「呼叫自助区店员」。

examples.en: I asked whether I should call the attendant before moving the box.
examples.zh: 我问挪动盒子之前要不要先「呼叫自助区店员」。

collocations: press the button to call the attendant

words.enDefinition: a feature that lets callers request a return call

examples.en: I selected the callback option so I could put my phone down.
examples.zh: 我选了「客服回拨选项」，这样就可以先把手机放下。

examples.en: The recording mentioned a callback option after telling me how many callers were waiting.
examples.zh: 录音告诉我有多少人等候后，提到了「客服回拨选项」。

words.enDefinition: the period when a return call is expected

examples.en: I chose a callback window after the last lecture on my timetable.
examples.zh: 我选了课表上最后一节课结束后的「预计回拨时段」。

examples.en: The callback window on the screen was later than I had expected.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的「预计回拨时段」比我想的要晚。

words.enDefinition: a university sale of equipment or furniture it no longer needs

examples.en: Our library put some old reading chairs in the campus surplus sale this year.
examples.zh: 今年图书馆把几张旧阅览椅拿到「校园闲置资产出售」活动上卖。

examples.en: I bought a metal filing cabinet at the campus surplus sale by the gym.
examples.zh: 我在体育馆旁的「校园闲置资产出售」活动上买了一个金属文件柜。

collocations: find a desk at a campus surplus sale

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether the hanger is included with the purchase

examples.en: “Can I keep the hanger?” I asked after choosing the interview jacket.
examples.zh: 我选好面试穿的夹克后问「这个衣架我能留下吗？」

examples.en: I pointed at the skirt and asked, “Can I keep the hanger?”
examples.zh: 我指了指那条裙子问「这个衣架我能留下吗？」

collocations: “Can I keep the hanger with this jacket?”
“Can I keep the hanger as well?”

words.expression: can I see one out of the box
words.lemma: can i see one out of the box
words.enDefinition: a question asking staff to show an unpackaged example
acceptedEnVariants: can I see one out of the box

examples.en: I pointed to the boxed lamps and asked, “Can I see one out of the box?”
examples.zh: 我指着盒装台灯问「能拿一件出来看看吗？」

examples.en: “Can I see one out of the box?” she asked before choosing a kettle.
examples.zh: 她挑水壶前问「能拿一件出来看看吗？」

collocations: ask “Can I see one out of the box?”
“Can I see one out of the box before I decide?”
“Can I see one out of the box here?”

words.expression: can I try this over my shirt
words.lemma: can i try this over my shirt
words.zhGloss: 我可以套在衬衫外面试吗
words.enDefinition: a question asking whether to try a garment over a shirt
acceptedZhAnswers: 我可以套在衬衫外面试吗
acceptedEnVariants: can I try this over my shirt

examples.en: “Can I try this over my shirt?” I asked, holding up the jacket.
examples.zh: 我拿起夹克问「我可以套在衬衫外面试吗？」

examples.en: My friend asked, “Can I try this over my shirt?” by the coat rack.
examples.zh: 朋友站在大衣架旁问「我可以套在衬衫外面试吗？」

collocations: ask “Can I try this over my shirt?”
“Can I try this over my shirt here?”
“Can I try this over my shirt first?”

words.expression: can you confirm what was shipped
words.lemma: can you confirm what was shipped
words.zhGloss: 能确认一下实际发了什么吗
words.enDefinition: a request to verify which products were sent
acceptedZhAnswers: 能确认一下实际发了什么吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you confirm what was shipped

examples.en: “Can you confirm what was shipped?” I asked after comparing the two labels.
examples.zh: 对照两张标签后，我问「能确认一下实际发了什么吗？」

examples.en: I sent the order number and wrote, “Can you confirm what was shipped?”
examples.zh: 我发了订单号，并写道「能确认一下实际发了什么吗？」

collocations: ask “Can you confirm what was shipped?”
“Can you confirm what was shipped on Monday?”
“Can you confirm what was shipped in the second parcel?”

words.expression: can you leave the price off
words.lemma: can you leave the price off
words.enDefinition: a request to remove visible pricing before giving a gift
acceptedEnVariants: can you leave the price off

examples.en: I bought the scarf for a friend and asked, “Can you leave the price off?”
examples.zh: 围巾是给朋友买的，我便问「能把价格去掉吗？」

examples.en: “Can you leave the price off?” she asked before the clerk wrapped it.
examples.zh: 店员打包前，她问「能把价格去掉吗？」

collocations: ask “Can you leave the price off?”
“Can you leave the price off the gift?”
“Can you leave the price off the tag?”

words.expression: can you see my previous messages
words.lemma: can you see my previous messages
words.zhGloss: 你能看到我之前的消息吗
words.enDefinition: a question checking whether another adviser can read earlier messages
acceptedZhAnswers: 你能看到我之前的消息吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you see my previous messages

examples.en: “Can you see my previous messages?” I asked when another adviser joined the chat.
examples.zh: 另一位客服接入聊天时，我问「你能看到我之前的消息吗？」

examples.en: I typed, “Can you see my previous messages?” before explaining the problem again.
examples.zh: 在重新说明问题之前，我打字问「你能看到我之前的消息吗？」

collocations: ask “Can you see my previous messages?”
“Can you see my previous messages about this order?”
“Can you see my previous messages in this chat?”

words.enDefinition: to ask that a membership end and stop renewing

examples.en: I called the shop to cancel a membership I'd opened before moving into residence.
examples.zh: 我打电话给店里，「取消入住前开通的会员资格」。

examples.en: The help page explained how to cancel a membership registered with an old email.
examples.zh: 帮助页解释了如何「取消用旧邮箱注册的会员资格」。

words.expression: cancel at the end of the term
words.lemma: cancel at the end of the term
words.enDefinition: to end a membership after the current paid or trial period finishes
acceptedEnVariants: cancel at the end of the term

examples.en: I selected cancel at the end of the term and checked the expiry date.
examples.zh: 我选择了「到本期结束时取消」，然后核对了到期日。

examples.en: The support adviser asked whether I wanted to cancel at the end of the term.
examples.zh: 客服问我是否要「到本期结束时取消」。

collocations: choose to cancel at the end of the term
select “Cancel at the end of the term”
option to cancel at the end of the term

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a cancellation request has not yet been resolved

examples.en: The app showed cancellation pending while the seller checked the status of the shipment.
examples.zh: 卖家核实发货状态期间，应用显示「取消申请处理中」。

examples.en: My order stayed at cancellation pending until support sent me a separate email.
examples.zh: 我的订单一直显示「取消申请处理中」，直到客服给我另外发了一封邮件。

words.enDefinition: the period during which an order can still be cancelled

examples.en: I checked the cancellation window as soon as I noticed the duplicate order.
examples.zh: 我一发现重复下单，就查看了「可取消的时间段」。

examples.en: The store's cancellation window ended when the warehouse started preparing the parcel that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚仓库开始准备包裹时，商店的「可取消时间段」就结束了。

words.enDefinition: a status showing an order was cancelled before the seller shipped it

examples.en: My order showed cancelled before dispatch after the seller checked with the warehouse.
examples.zh: 卖家向仓库核实后，我的订单显示「发货前已取消」。

examples.en: The account recorded cancelled before dispatch beside the item that was no longer needed.
examples.zh: 账户在不再需要的商品旁记录了「发货前已取消」。

words.enDefinition: a message saying the selected order or request cannot be stopped

examples.en: The order page said it cannot be cancelled once preparation had already started.
examples.zh: 订单页说，开始备货后就「不可取消」。

examples.en: The note cannot be cancelled appeared beside the item that was already in transit.
examples.zh: 已经在途的商品旁出现了「不可取消」的提示。

words.enDefinition: Says that an offer may not be used together with other offers.

examples.en: The email said the coupon cannot be combined with the discount on the product page.
examples.zh: 邮件说，这张优惠券与商品页上的折扣「不可叠加使用」。

examples.en: I spotted “Cannot be combined” below the offer when checking the new total in my cart.
examples.zh: 我核对购物车的新总额时，在优惠信息下方发现了「不可叠加使用」。

collocations: cannot be combined with other offers
a note saying cannot be combined
marked cannot be combined with discounts

words.enDefinition: a British sale where people display goods beside their cars

examples.en: Our friends in Leeds invited us to a car boot sale on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我们在利兹的朋友邀我们周日早上去「汽车后备箱旧货市集」。

examples.en: At the car boot sale, I bought a stack of records from a teacher.
examples.zh: 我在「汽车后备箱旧货市集」上从一位老师手中买了一摞唱片。

collocations: go to a car boot sale

words.enDefinition: Directions for cleaning and maintaining an item without damaging it.

examples.en: I looked for the care instructions before selecting a pale cover for the dorm chair.
examples.zh: 为宿舍椅子挑浅色椅套前，我找了找「养护说明」。

examples.en: The care instructions were printed below the material information on the product page for the bag.
examples.zh: 包袋商品页上，材料信息下方印有「养护说明」。

words.enDefinition: a handle attached to a box or package to lift it

examples.en: The clerk added a carry handle so I could take the box home.
examples.zh: 店员加了个「提手」，方便我把盒子拿回家。

examples.en: I asked whether the kettle box had a carry handle on top.
examples.zh: 我问水壶的包装盒顶上有没有「提手」。

collocations: a box with a carry handle

words.enDefinition: service for which the customer takes the product to a repair centre

examples.en: The carry-in service was available at a small shop beside the main bus station.
examples.zh: 总站旁的一家小店提供「自行送修服务」。

examples.en: I chose carry-in service because I could bring the monitor on my way to class.
examples.zh: 我选择了「自行送修服务」，因为去上课时可以顺路把显示器带过去。

words.enDefinition: The combined price of selected items before any additional charges are applied.

examples.en: The cart subtotal changed after I removed the spare cable from my list of items.
examples.zh: 我把备用线缆从清单上移除后，「购物车商品小计」变了。

examples.en: I checked the cart subtotal before deciding who would order the materials for our project.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「购物车商品小计」，才决定小组项目的材料由谁下单。

collocations: a change in the cart subtotal

words.enDefinition: a message confirming support has received a request

examples.en: I got a case acknowledgment moments after sending the form to customer support.
examples.zh: 给客户支持发送表单后，我很快就收到了「工单受理确认」。

examples.en: The case acknowledgment included a link to the page with my latest messages.
examples.zh: 「工单受理确认」里有一个链接，可以打开显示我最近消息的页面。

collocations: an email with a case acknowledgment

words.enDefinition: a request to reconsider a support or dispute decision

examples.en: I filed a case appeal after finding the original photo on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上找到原始照片后，提交了「工单复核申请」。

examples.en: The help page explained how a case appeal differed from adding a comment.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了「工单复核申请」和添加留言有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: documents or images used to establish what happened in a case

examples.en: The adviser grouped my photos and receipt together as case evidence.
examples.zh: 客服把我的照片和收据归在一起，作为「工单材料」。

examples.en: I could see all the case evidence after signing back into the marketplace.
examples.zh: 我重新登录电商平台后，可以看到所有「工单材料」。

words.enDefinition: a short record added to a support request

examples.en: The case note said that the seller had already checked the warehouse record.
examples.zh: 「工单备注」写着卖家已经核对过仓库记录。

examples.en: The adviser read the case note before asking a follow-up question.
examples.zh: 客服先看了「工单备注」，然后问了我一个后续问题。

words.enDefinition: new information provided about the progress of a support request

examples.en: The case update said the adviser was still checking the parcel records.
examples.zh: 「工单进展通知」说，客服还在核对包裹记录。

examples.en: I got a case update while waiting for the seller to send a photo.
examples.zh: 我等卖家发照片时，收到了一条「工单进展通知」。

words.enDefinition: payment in cash when the buyer collects the item

examples.en: The advert said cash on collection for the small bookshelf near the station.
examples.zh: 广告说，车站附近的那个小书架要「取货时付现金」。

examples.en: I asked if the seller accepted cash on collection for the spare desk lamp.
examples.zh: 我问那个多出来的台灯能不能「取货时付现金」。

words.enDefinition: A promotion that may return part of an eligible purchase amount to the buyer.

examples.en: The cashback offer was listed separately beneath the amount the store charged for the headphones.
examples.zh: 「购物返现优惠」单独写在店铺收取的耳机价格下方。

examples.en: I checked the terms of the cashback offer before comparing it with a lower upfront price.
examples.zh: 我先查看「购物返现优惠」的条款，再拿它和较低的直接售价比较。

words.enDefinition: A web page grouping products of a particular type.

examples.en: The category page put desk lamps and clip lights under the same heading for students.
examples.zh: 「商品分类页」把台灯和夹式灯放在了同一个面向学生的栏目下。

examples.en: I returned to the category page after deciding I wanted a larger storage box.
examples.zh: 决定买大一点的收纳盒后，我回到了「商品分类页」。

words.enDefinition: deciding you no longer want an item without claiming a problem with it

examples.en: The form had a box for change of mind next to the other reasons.
examples.zh: 表格在其他原因旁还设有「改变主意」的选项。

examples.en: The store asked whether change of mind was the reason for my return.
examples.zh: 店员问我退货的原因是不是「改变主意」。

collocations: return due to a change of mind

words.enDefinition: a retailer's rules for returns when there is no problem with the item itself

examples.en: The shop's change-of-mind policy was displayed near the baskets at the entrance.
examples.zh: 商店的「反悔退货政策」贴在入口购物篮旁边。

examples.en: I compared the change-of-mind policy with the information on my order page.
examples.zh: 我把「反悔退货政策」与订单页面上的信息进行了比较。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling donated goods to raise money for charity

examples.en: I picked up several novels for my reading group at a charity shop.
examples.zh: 我在「慈善旧货店」给读书小组买了几本小说。

examples.en: The charity shop near our hall accepts clean coats and shoes on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 宿舍附近的「慈善旧货店」周六收干净的外套和鞋子。

words.enDefinition: the waiting line for customers trying to reach a chat agent

examples.en: The chat queue had grown by the time I found my order email.
examples.zh: 我找到订单邮件时，「在线客服等候队列」已经更长了。

examples.en: My screen still showed the chat queue after I added details about the order.
examples.zh: 我添上订单详情后，屏幕上还是显示「在线客服等候队列」。

words.enDefinition: a period of activity in a support chat from opening to ending

examples.en: The chat session ended before I could upload the second photo of the box.
examples.zh: 我还没上传箱子的第二张照片，「这次客服对话」就结束了。

examples.en: I started a new chat session after my laptop went to sleep.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑休眠后，我重新开始了「一次客服对话」。

words.enDefinition: a written copy of messages sent during an online chat

examples.en: The shop emailed a chat transcript after the adviser ended our conversation.
examples.zh: 客服结束对话后，店家发来了一份「聊天文字记录」。

examples.en: I downloaded the chat transcript so I could check exactly what the adviser said.
examples.zh: 我下载了「聊天文字记录」，方便核对客服说的原话。

collocations: keep a copy of the chat transcript

words.enDefinition: a small interactive box that opens a chat on a website

examples.en: I opened the chat widget in the corner of the order page.
examples.zh: 我打开了订单页面角落里的「网页聊天窗口」。

examples.en: The chat widget disappeared when I made the browser window too narrow.
examples.zh: 浏览器窗口缩得太窄时，「网页聊天窗口」就不见了。

words.enDefinition: An option that serves a similar purpose and costs less.

examples.en: I found a cheaper alternative that fit the same binder and used the same paper size.
examples.zh: 我找到了一个「更便宜的替代品」，适合同一个活页夹，纸张尺寸也一样。

examples.en: My classmate suggested a cheaper alternative when the branded calculator case was outside my budget.
examples.zh: 品牌计算器保护套超出预算时，同学推荐了一个「更便宜的替代品」。

words.enDefinition: An offer making the lowest-priced qualifying item in a group free.

examples.en: The sign said “Cheapest item free” above a selection of three different notebook sizes.
examples.zh: 三种大小的笔记本上方，告示写着「最便宜的一件免费」。

examples.en: I checked which pencil case counted under the “Cheapest item free” offer before checking out.
examples.zh: 结算前，我确认了「最便宜的一件免费」优惠中，哪个笔袋算免费。

collocations: an offer marked cheapest item free
a sign saying cheapest item free
buy three with the cheapest item free

words.enDefinition: The available choice that costs the least.

examples.en: The cheapest option was a smaller pack, so I checked how many pages it contained.
examples.zh: 「最便宜的选项」是小包装，所以我查看了里面有多少页。

examples.en: I picked the cheapest option that included the cable I needed for my class.
examples.zh: 我选了包含上课所需线缆的「最便宜的选项」。

words.enDefinition: to look for the item or its availability at another location

examples.en: Could you check another branch before I make the trip across town?
examples.zh: 我跑一趟城另一头之前，你能「查一下别的门店」吗？

examples.en: The assistant offered to check another branch for a black backpack.
examples.zh: 店员说可以「查一下别的门店」有没有黑色双肩包。

collocations: ask staff to check another branch
check another branch for a different size

words.enDefinition: to notify staff you have arrived to collect an order

examples.en: I opened the app to check in for pickup outside the shop.
examples.zh: 我在店外打开应用，「登记自己已到店自提」。

examples.en: The sign asked customers to check in for pickup before joining the queue.
examples.zh: 标牌请顾客先「登记已到店自提」，再去排队。

collocations: check in for pickup at the store
use the app to check in for pickup
be asked to check in for pickup

words.enDefinition: to verify the measurements of a physical item

examples.en: Can you check the dimensions before I borrow a car to collect the desk?
examples.zh: 我借车来搬书桌前，你能「核对一下尺寸」吗？

examples.en: We need to check the dimensions to see whether the cabinet fits our hallway.
examples.zh: 我们得「核对尺寸」，看看橱柜能不能放进走廊。

collocations: check the dimensions of the shelf
ask someone to check the dimensions

words.enDefinition: a moving surface that carries purchases toward the cashier

examples.en: I put my books on the checkout belt after the previous shopper.
examples.zh: 前面的顾客放好商品后，我把书放上了「收银传送带」。

examples.en: The checkout belt stopped after the cashier finished scanning the boxes.
examples.zh: 收银员扫完那些盒子后，「收银传送带」停了下来。

collocations: put groceries on the checkout belt

words.enDefinition: a bar separating one shopper's items from another's on the belt

examples.en: I used a checkout divider to separate my notebooks from another shopper's groceries.
examples.zh: 我用「收银传送带隔条」把自己的笔记本和另一位顾客的食品隔开。

examples.en: The cashier handed me a checkout divider when I set down my bag.
examples.zh: 我放下包时，收银员递给我一根「收银传送带隔条」。

collocations: place a checkout divider on the belt

words.enDefinition: a passage leading to a particular register in a store

examples.en: I switched to the next checkout lane when the cashier waved me over.
examples.zh: 收银员挥手让我过去，我便换到了旁边的「收银通道」。

examples.en: The closest checkout lane was already full by the time we reached it.
examples.zh: 我们到最近的「收银通道」时，那里已经排满了人。

words.enDefinition: a light showing whether a checkout lane is serving customers

examples.en: I saw the checkout light turn green just before I reached the queue.
examples.zh: 我刚走到队伍旁，就看见「收银通道指示灯」变绿了。

examples.en: The cashier turned off the checkout light before taking a break.
examples.zh: 收银员去休息前关掉了「收银通道指示灯」。

words.enDefinition: the distance measured around the chest

examples.en: I checked my chest measurement before choosing a jacket for the interview.
examples.zh: 选面试要穿的夹克前，我先量了自己的「胸围尺寸」。

examples.en: The clerk asked for my chest measurement before suggesting a size to try.
examples.zh: 店员先问了我的「胸围尺寸」，再建议我试哪个尺码。

words.enDefinition: paint with small pieces broken away from the surface

examples.en: The cabinet had chipped paint along the top but all its drawers worked.
examples.zh: 柜子顶部有几处「漆面剥落」，不过所有抽屉都能用。

examples.en: She pointed out the chipped paint on the frame before I paid.
examples.zh: 付款前，她指给我看架子上「漆面剥落」的地方。

words.enDefinition: a short advertisement placed under a category in a publication

examples.en: I spotted a classified ad for a folding bike in the student paper.
examples.zh: 我在学生报上看到一则卖折叠自行车的「分类广告」。

examples.en: Her classified ad for old shelving drew a reply from a nearby student.
examples.zh: 她发布了一则出售旧搁架的「分类广告」，附近有位学生给了回复。

words.enDefinition: To remove selected search filters and show the broader results again.

examples.en: I clicked “Clear filters” when none of the storage boxes matched my original choices.
examples.zh: 当没有收纳盒符合先前的选项时，我点了「清除筛选条件」。

examples.en: The clear filters button brought back the items I had accidentally hidden from the results.
examples.zh: 「清除筛选条件」按钮把我不小心从结果里隐藏的商品重新显示出来。

collocations: clear filters on a results page

words.enDefinition: A store rack holding items marked for clearance.

examples.en: I checked the clearance rack for a desk organizer before looking at the new arrivals.
examples.zh: 浏览新到商品前，我先去「清仓商品架」找桌面收纳架。

examples.en: The shop moved the older folders to the clearance rack near the front window.
examples.zh: 店铺把旧款文件夹移到了前窗旁的「清仓商品架」。

collocations: find an item on the clearance rack

words.enDefinition: a service for ordering online and collecting from a shop
acceptedEnVariants: buy online, pick up in store

examples.en: I used click and collect because the shop was near my seminar room.
examples.zh: 店就在研讨课教室附近，我就选了「线上下单门店自提」。

examples.en: The retailer offered click and collect for the lamp I was looking at.
examples.zh: 我看的那款台灯，零售商支持「线上下单门店自提」。

words.enDefinition: To select and save a digital coupon so it can be used later.

examples.en: I had to clip a coupon in the app before the smaller price appeared.
examples.zh: 我得先在应用里「领取优惠券」，较低的价格才会显示。

examples.en: My roommate showed me where to clip a coupon for the cheaper laundry supplies.
examples.zh: 室友指给我看，在哪里可以「领取优惠券」买到更便宜的洗衣用品。

collocations: clip a coupon in the app

words.enDefinition: closed without a result that addresses the problem

examples.en: My case was closed with no resolution after the seller stopped answering messages.
examples.zh: 卖家不再回复消息后，我的工单「未解决就关闭了」。

examples.en: The page said “closed with no resolution,” although I had sent the requested photo.
examples.zh: 虽然我已经发了要求的照片，页面仍显示「未解决就关闭了」。

collocations: a dispute closed with no resolution

words.enDefinition: A sale held because a shop is about to shut permanently.

examples.en: A closing-down sale started at the small stationery shop across from my residence hall.
examples.zh: 我宿舍楼对面的小文具店开始了「歇业清仓」。

examples.en: I bought spare notebook covers during a closing-down sale at the shop near my bus stop.
examples.zh: 我在公交站旁的店铺「歇业清仓」时买了些备用笔记本封套。

words.enDefinition: an event where people exchange clothing they no longer wear

examples.en: The art students ran a clothes swap in the hall on Friday.
examples.zh: 艺术专业学生周五在礼堂办了一场「衣物交换活动」。

examples.en: I took two jackets to the clothes swap and came home with a scarf.
examples.zh: 我拿了两件夹克去参加「衣物交换活动」，带回来一条围巾。

collocations: bring something to a clothes swap

words.enDefinition: a stand or rail used to hang clothes for sale

examples.en: I put the blue jacket back on the clothing rack near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我把那件蓝夹克放回入口旁的「服装挂架」。

examples.en: The clothing rack by the window held several styles of winter coats.
examples.zh: 窗边的「服装挂架」上挂着几款冬大衣。

collocations: hang something on a clothing rack

words.enDefinition: A status showing that a code has been accepted for the current purchase.

examples.en: The cart showed “Code applied” beside the smaller amount for the set of folders.
examples.zh: 购物车在价格调低后的文件夹套装旁显示「优惠码已生效」。

examples.en: I noticed “Code applied” only after checking the updated price beneath my selected products.
examples.zh: 我查看了所选商品下方更新后的价格，才注意到「优惠码已生效」。

collocations: see code applied in the cart

words.enDefinition: a repair option in which the provider picks up and returns the item

examples.en: The company offered a collection and delivery service for printers too large to carry.
examples.zh: 公司为太大不便携带的打印机提供了「上门取送服务」。

examples.en: I asked if the collection and delivery service included buildings on the other campus.
examples.zh: 我问「上门取送服务」是否覆盖另一个校区的楼栋。

collocations: book a collection and delivery service
offer a collection and delivery service

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a pickup has been organized

examples.en: The order showed collection arranged after we agreed to meet on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我们约好周四碰面后，订单的状态变成了「取货时间已约好」。

examples.en: I saw collection arranged next to the order when I opened the message.
examples.zh: 我打开消息时，在订单旁看见了「取货时间已约好」。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating the carrier could not collect a scheduled return

examples.en: The tracking page read collection failed even though I had waited by the buzzer.
examples.zh: 我一直在门铃旁等着，追踪页面却显示「取退件未成功」。

examples.en: The collection failed message gave me a link to arrange a new time.
examples.zh: 「取退件未成功」的消息里有一个链接，可以另约时间。

words.enDefinition: a machine where customers can check in to collect orders

examples.en: The collection kiosk was opposite the doors near the covered car park.
examples.zh: 「取货自助终端」在有顶棚的停车场旁、那两扇门对面。

examples.en: I asked an assistant how to find my order on the collection kiosk.
examples.zh: 我问店员，怎么在「取货自助终端」上查看我的订单。

collocations: check in at a collection kiosk

words.enDefinition: a set period during which a programme counts points earned by members

examples.en: The collection period ended before I made my final purchase of the term.
examples.zh: 我下本学期最后一笔单前，「积分累积周期」已经结束了。

examples.en: I checked which collection period included my first order from the new address.
examples.zh: 我查了一下从新地址下的第一笔订单属于哪个「积分累积周期」。

words.enDefinition: a slip or message showing that a buyer has collected an item

examples.en: The seller sent a collection receipt after I took the used desk home.
examples.zh: 我把二手书桌搬回家后，卖家发来了「取货凭条」。

examples.en: I saved the collection receipt in the same folder as the listing photos.
examples.zh: 我把「取货凭条」和商品页的照片保存在同一个文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: A small sample showing the color available for an item.

examples.en: I clicked the green color swatch and the photo switched to the matching folder.
examples.zh: 我点了绿色的「色样」，图片就切换成对应的文件夹。

examples.en: One color swatch looked almost white, but the label below it said pale blue.
examples.zh: 一个「色样」看上去几乎是白色的，下面却标的是浅蓝色。

words.enDefinition: A particular combination of colors used for one version of a product.

examples.en: The colorway I liked had a green body with small yellow details along the edges.
examples.zh: 我喜欢的「配色款」以绿色为主，边缘带有黄色小细节。

examples.en: My friend chose a different colorway of the same backpack so we could tell them apart.
examples.zh: 朋友选了同款背包的另一个「配色款」，这样我们就能分清谁的是谁的。

words.enDefinition: An amount shown as a benchmark beside the current selling price.

examples.en: The page showed a compare-at price beside the current amount for the headphones.
examples.zh: 商品页把耳机「标示的参考价」放在当前售价旁边。

examples.en: I checked what the compare-at price represented before deciding whether the lamp was a bargain.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「标示的参考价」代表什么，再判断台灯划不划算。

words.enDefinition: A table showing product features or specifications together to make differences easy to see.

examples.en: The comparison chart showed which model had the longest cable and the widest base.
examples.zh: 「对比表」显示了哪个型号的线缆最长、底座最宽。

examples.en: I used the comparison chart to decide which pencil case would hold my geometry tools.
examples.zh: 我用了「对比表」来判断哪个笔袋放得下我的几何工具。

words.enDefinition: Able to work together with a stated device, part, or product.

examples.en: The new pen tip was compatible with my tablet according to the listing details.
examples.zh: 商品详情注明，新笔尖「与我的平板兼容」。

examples.en: I asked whether the spare cable was compatible with the charger in my room.
examples.zh: 我问了一下备用线缆「是否与我房间里的充电器兼容」。

collocations: check what it is compatible with

words.enDefinition: the physical state of something when it is first received

examples.en: I described the lamp's condition on receipt in the message to the seller.
examples.zh: 我在给卖家的消息里说明了台灯「收到时的状态」。

examples.en: The warehouse took photos to record the monitor's condition on receipt that morning.
examples.zh: 仓库当天早上拍照记录了显示器「收到时的状态」。

words.enDefinition: to indicate that the item has been received

examples.en: The app asked me to confirm receipt after the seller handed over the lamp.
examples.zh: 卖家把台灯交给我后，应用请我「确认收到商品」。

examples.en: I forgot to confirm receipt and received a reminder before my next class.
examples.zh: 我忘了「确认收到商品」，下节课前收到了一条提醒。

collocations: ask the buyer to confirm receipt

words.enDefinition: to verify that a sent item reached its recipient

examples.en: The seller asked me to confirm that it arrived before closing the case.
examples.zh: 卖家让我先「确认东西收到了」，然后再关闭工单。

examples.en: I'll confirm that it arrived once I can get to the mailroom.
examples.zh: 我能去收发室的时候再「确认东西收到了」。

collocations: reply to confirm that it arrived
ask someone to confirm that it arrived
check the label and confirm that it arrived

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells goods on behalf of their owners

examples.en: A consignment shop downtown was selling the guitar on behalf of its owner.
examples.zh: 市区的一家「寄卖店」正在帮琴主出售那把吉他。

examples.en: I left my nearly new coat with a consignment shop before moving overseas.
examples.zh: 出国前，我把几乎全新的外套放在一家「寄卖店」代售。

words.enDefinition: a service providing information or guidance to people about purchases

examples.en: I asked the consumer advice service what the wording on the letter meant.
examples.zh: 我向「消费者咨询服务」询问信里的说法是什么意思。

examples.en: The website listed a consumer advice service for general questions about purchases.
examples.zh: 网站列出了可以回答一般购物问题的「消费者咨询服务」。

collocations: speak to a consumer advice service

words.enDefinition: a form for recording and submitting a consumer's complaint

examples.en: The consumer complaint form asked me to name the business I had contacted.
examples.zh: 「消费者投诉表」要求我填写联系过的商家名称。

examples.en: I saved the consumer complaint form while I looked for the original order email.
examples.zh: 我保存了「消费者投诉表」，好先去找原来的订单邮件。

words.enDefinition: a protection given to consumers by law for qualifying goods or services

examples.en: The Australian handout used a faulty desk lamp to explain a consumer guarantee.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的讲义用一盏有故障的台灯说明「消费者法定保障」。

examples.en: I saw consumer guarantee in the official guide next to examples about repairs.
examples.zh: 我在官方指南的维修示例旁看到了「消费者法定保障」。

words.enDefinition: a public body responsible for protecting consumers in the marketplace

examples.en: The consumer protection agency had information on how it handles shopping complaints.
examples.zh: 「消费者保护机构」提供了他们如何处理购物投诉的说明。

examples.en: I found the consumer protection agency listed separately from the retailer's own hotline.
examples.zh: 我发现名单把「消费者保护机构」和零售商自己的热线分开列出。

collocations: guidance from a consumer protection agency

words.enDefinition: a way of addressing a consumer problem, such as repairing or replacing goods

examples.en: The guide gave an example of a consumer remedy for a faulty kitchen appliance.
examples.zh: 指南举了一个厨电故障后的「消费者补救方式」示例。

examples.en: Our class compared which consumer remedy each scenario in the worksheet described that week.
examples.zh: 那周我们在课堂上比较了练习单每种情况描述的「消费者补救方式」。

words.enDefinition: a way to reach a support team, such as phone or chat

examples.en: The order page offered a different contact channel for purchases made through the marketplace.
examples.zh: 订单页面给出了另一种「联系渠道」，处理通过平台买的商品。

examples.en: I chose a contact channel that let me upload photos from my laptop.
examples.zh: 我选了一个能用笔记本电脑上传照片的「联系渠道」。

words.enDefinition: an online form for sending a message to an organization

examples.en: I used the contact form because I could attach the two photos there.
examples.zh: 我用了「联系表单」，因为可以在那里附上两张照片。

examples.en: The contact form asked which store I had bought the lamp from.
examples.zh: 「联系表单」问我那盏台灯是在哪家店买的。

words.enDefinition: to get in touch with the person or shop that sold something

examples.en: The order page told me where to contact the seller about the wrong colour.
examples.zh: 订单页面告诉我在哪里「联系卖家」，反映颜色发错了。

examples.en: I tried to contact the seller before asking the marketplace for help.
examples.zh: 我先试着「联系卖家」，然后才找电商平台帮忙。

collocations: contact the seller through the platform
contact the seller about an order

words.enDefinition: to exchange earned points for a voucher that can be used later

examples.en: I chose to convert points to a voucher before ordering the new desk lamp.
examples.zh: 下单买新台灯前，我选择「把积分换成优惠券」。

examples.en: The app explained when I could convert points to a voucher for the first time.
examples.zh: 应用告诉我，什么时候可以第一次「把积分换成优惠券」。

collocations: option to convert points to a voucher
convert points to a voucher online
choose to convert points to a voucher

words.enDefinition: to change from free or trial access to a membership that requires payment

examples.en: I checked when the trial would convert to a paid membership after signing up.
examples.zh: 注册后，我查了试用资格什么时候会「转为付费会员」。

examples.en: The help page explained which benefits changed if I chose to convert to a paid membership.
examples.zh: 帮助页解释了如果选择「转为付费会员」，有哪些福利会变化。

collocations: choose to convert to a paid membership
automatically convert to a paid membership
trial set to convert to a paid membership

words.enDefinition: a limited period for reconsidering or cancelling an eligible purchase agreement

examples.en: I checked when the cooling-off period started before contacting the seller about my order.
examples.zh: 联系卖家咨询订单前，我先确认了「冷静期」从什么时候开始。

examples.en: The information sheet explained how the cooling-off period differed from the store's holiday returns policy.
examples.zh: 说明单解释了「冷静期」和商店节日退货政策的区别。

words.enDefinition: The distance from one end of a power or connecting cord to the other.

examples.en: The cord length was listed below the photo of the lamp beside the specifications.
examples.zh: 「线缆长度」列在台灯照片下方的规格表旁。

examples.en: I checked the cord length because the socket in my room is behind the desk.
examples.zh: 我查看了「线缆长度」，因为房间里的插座在书桌后面。

collocations: an item with an adjustable cord length

words.enDefinition: damage to how something looks without necessarily affecting operation

examples.en: The seller photographed the cosmetic damage around one corner of the laptop.
examples.zh: 卖家拍下了笔记本电脑一角周围的「外观损伤」。

examples.en: The camera works, but the listing mentions cosmetic damage near the battery cover.
examples.zh: 相机能用，但商品页提到电池盖附近有「外观损伤」。

words.enDefinition: A comparison showing that one thing costs double the amount of another.

examples.en: The larger lamp costs twice as much as the one I use at home.
examples.zh: 大款台灯的「价格是我在家用的那款的两倍」。

examples.en: This cover costs twice as much, although both versions fit the same tablet model.
examples.zh: 虽然两个版本都适配同款平板，但这款保护套的「价格是两倍」。

collocations: costs twice as much as the smaller one

words.enDefinition: A small book containing several coupons for different offers.

examples.en: A student volunteer handed me a coupon booklet before the start of the campus fair.
examples.zh: 校园集市开始前，一名学生志愿者给了我一本「优惠券册」。

examples.en: The coupon booklet included offers from several shops within walking distance of our residence.
examples.zh: 「优惠券册」里有几家从宿舍走路就能到的店铺的优惠。

collocations: find a voucher in a coupon booklet

words.enDefinition: The stated rules that determine when and how a coupon can be used.

examples.en: I checked the coupon terms before adding the two notebooks to my order online.
examples.zh: 在网上把两本笔记本加进订单前，我先核对了「优惠券使用条款」。

examples.en: The coupon terms explained why the offer did not cover the larger calculator case.
examples.zh: 「优惠券使用条款」解释了为什么这项优惠不适用于大号计算器保护套。

words.enDefinition: a fault that comes within the scope of a warranty or plan

examples.en: The technician confirmed the loose socket was a covered defect after inspecting the monitor.
examples.zh: 维修人员检查显示器后，确认松动的插口是「在保修范围内的缺陷」。

examples.en: The booklet listed an example of a covered defect near the warranty contact details.
examples.zh: 手册在保修联系方式旁举了一个「在保修范围内的缺陷」的例子。

words.enDefinition: a customer review that focuses on faults or weaknesses

examples.en: I read a critical review that noted the lid did not fit this version.
examples.zh: 我读到一条「指出不足的评价」，说这款的盖子不合适。

examples.en: A critical review pointed out that the printed guide did not explain the controls.
examples.zh: 一条「指出不足的评价」提到，纸质指南没有说明各个按键的用法。

words.enDefinition: photographs that show the present appearance of an item

examples.en: Could you send me some current photos of the suitcase before I visit?
examples.zh: 我上门看箱子前，你能给我发几张箱子的「近期实拍照」吗？

examples.en: The seller added current photos after I asked about the torn seat fabric.
examples.zh: 我问起座椅面料撕裂的情况后，卖家补发了几张「近期实拍照」。

words.enDefinition: Pictures uploaded by customers showing a product they received or used.

examples.en: I looked at customer photos to see how the blue cover appeared in daylight.
examples.zh: 我看了「买家实拍图」，想知道蓝色封套在日光下是什么颜色。

examples.en: Several customer photos showed the stand folded up beside a ruler on a desk.
examples.zh: 几张「买家实拍图」里，折好的支架摆在书桌上的一把尺旁。

collocations: add customer photos to a review

words.enDefinition: A score a customer gives an item based on their experience.

examples.en: The customer rating caught my eye, but I still wanted to see what people wrote.
examples.zh: 「顾客评分」吸引了我的注意，但我还是想看看大家具体写了什么。

examples.en: One customer rating came from someone who used the lamp in a room like mine.
examples.zh: 有一条「顾客评分」来自在和我房间类似的地方使用这盏灯的人。

words.enDefinition: the counter where shoppers can get help in a store

examples.en: The sign directed customers with online purchases to the customer service desk upstairs.
examples.zh: 牌子指引线上购物的顾客到楼上的「客服柜台」。

examples.en: I showed the receipt at the customer service desk before explaining the problem.
examples.zh: 我在「客服柜台」出示收据，然后说明了问题。

collocations: go to the customer service desk
ask at the customer service desk

words.enDefinition: a telephone number for getting a company's help with purchases

examples.en: The customer service number was printed below the opening hours on the receipt.
examples.zh: 「客服电话」印在收据上的营业时间下方。

examples.en: I tried the customer service number while the shop was still open.
examples.zh: 店还开着的时候，我试着拨了「客服电话」。

collocations: look up the customer service number

words.enDefinition: the group that helps customers with questions or problems

examples.en: The customer support team had already spoken to the shop about my order.
examples.zh: 「客服团队」就我的订单已经和门店沟通过了。

examples.en: I called the customer support team when the package arrived without its power cord.
examples.zh: 包裹送到了，却没配电源线，我便打电话给「客服团队」。

collocations: speak to the customer support team
a member of the customer support team

words.enDefinition: An offer tied to the shopping event known as Cyber Monday.

examples.en: The Cyber Monday deal brought the blue headphones within the amount I planned to spend.
examples.zh: 「网络星期一优惠」让蓝色耳机降到了我计划花费的额度内。

examples.en: I saved the Cyber Monday deal for later because I needed to check the laptop model.
examples.zh: 我先收藏了「网络星期一优惠」，因为还需要核对笔记本电脑型号。

collocations: a Cyber Monday deal on laptops

words.enDefinition: in a damaged condition when first received by the customer

examples.en: The desk lamp was damaged on arrival, as the photo of the box showed.
examples.zh: 盒子的照片显示，台灯「到货时已损坏」。

examples.en: The seller asked me to note that the parcel was damaged on arrival.
examples.zh: 卖家请我注明包裹「到货时已损坏」。

collocations: report an item damaged on arrival

words.enDefinition: a message reminding customers about saving their data before a device service

examples.en: The repair shop emailed a data backup notice when I booked the appointment online.
examples.zh: 我在网上预约时，维修店发来了一份「数据备份提示」。

examples.en: I read the data backup notice after the technician explained the extent of the work.
examples.zh: 维修人员解释维修范围后，我阅读了「数据备份提示」。

words.enDefinition: unable to power on or operate when first received

examples.en: The monitor was dead on arrival, so I contacted the seller that evening.
examples.zh: 显示器「到货即无法开机」，我当天晚上就联系了卖家。

examples.en: The technician asked whether the speaker was dead on arrival or had stopped working later.
examples.zh: 技术人员问音箱是「到货即无法开机」，还是后来才坏的。

collocations: report an item dead on arrival

words.enDefinition: a decision accepting the buyer's position in a dispute

examples.en: The marketplace issued a decision in the buyer's favor after reviewing both messages.
examples.zh: 电商平台查看双方消息后，作出了「支持买家的处理决定」。

examples.en: The platform said its decision in the buyer's favor was now on the case page.
examples.zh: 平台说，「支持买家的处理决定」现在已经显示在工单页面上。

collocations: issue a decision in the buyer's favor
record a decision in the buyer's favor
receive notice of a decision in the buyer's favor

words.enDefinition: to tell the provider not to proceed with an offered repair

examples.en: I decided to decline the repair after seeing how much the new display cost.
examples.zh: 看到新屏幕的价格后，我决定「拒绝进行维修」。

examples.en: The form showed which option to select if I wanted to decline the repair.
examples.zh: 表格标明了如果我想「拒绝进行维修」，应该选哪一项。

words.enDefinition: to subtract a charge from the money returned to a customer

examples.en: I asked which fees the seller would deduct from a refund for that order.
examples.zh: 我问卖家，这笔订单有哪些费用会「从退款中扣除」。

examples.en: The note explained what the shop might deduct from a refund if a cable was missing.
examples.zh: 说明解释了如果少了一根线缆，商家可能「从退款中扣除」哪些费用。

collocations: deduct from a refund for shipping
deduct from a refund for handling
amount to deduct from a refund

words.enDefinition: a fault caused by how an item was manufactured, assembled, or repaired

examples.en: The loose stitching was described as a defect in workmanship on the inspection form.
examples.zh: 检验表把缝线松脱描述为「加工装配缺陷」。

examples.en: Our design class discussed whether the misaligned hinge showed a defect in workmanship after assembly.
examples.zh: 设计课上，我们讨论了铰链装好后没有对齐是否属于「加工装配缺陷」。

collocations: check for a defect in workmanship

words.enDefinition: money returned for all or part of an original delivery fee

examples.en: The delivery charge refund appeared separately from the amount for the damaged lamp.
examples.zh: 「配送费退款」与损坏台灯的退款分开显示。

examples.en: The seller issued the delivery charge refund after checking the duplicate invoice that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，卖家查过重复开具的发票后，办理了「配送费退款」。

words.enDefinition: A close photograph of a small feature or part of an item.

examples.en: A detail shot showed the stitching on the handle where the bag usually wears out.
examples.zh: 一张「细节特写」展示了提手易磨损部位的针脚。

examples.en: I liked the zipper better after seeing it clearly in the final detail shot.
examples.zh: 在最后一张「细节特写」里看清拉链后，我更喜欢它了。

collocations: a detail shot of the stitching

words.enDefinition: a status indicating the technician finished identifying the problem or checking for faults

examples.en: The service page read diagnosis complete and gave me the technician's contact details.
examples.zh: 服务页面显示「故障检测已完成」，并给了维修人员的联系方式。

examples.en: I found diagnosis complete next to the repair job number on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我在凭条上的维修任务编号旁看到了「故障检测已完成」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for examining a product to find the cause of a fault

examples.en: The service centre charged a diagnostic fee when I brought the faulty speaker in.
examples.zh: 我把故障音箱送去后，维修中心收了一笔「故障检测费」。

examples.en: I checked whether the diagnostic fee would be applied to the final repair bill.
examples.zh: 我确认了「故障检测费」能否抵扣最终的维修账单。

words.enDefinition: a question checking whether one item was recorded twice

examples.en: “Did that scan twice?” I asked after hearing two quick beeps.
examples.zh: 听到两声很近的提示音后，我问「刚才是不是扫了两次？」

examples.en: She looked at the item list and asked, “Did that scan twice?”
examples.zh: 她看了看商品列表，问「刚才是不是扫了两次？」

collocations: “Did that scan twice when you moved it?”

words.enDefinition: A coupon saved, displayed, or redeemed electronically instead of on paper.

examples.en: The digital coupon appeared in the shop's app below the image of the lamp.
examples.zh: 「电子优惠券」出现在店铺应用里那张台灯图片的下方。

examples.en: I used a digital coupon for the folder and kept the receipt for our group.
examples.zh: 我用了「电子优惠券」买文件夹，并给小组留着收据。

collocations: show a digital coupon on your phone

words.enDefinition: No longer made or offered as part of the seller's current range.

examples.en: The smaller clock was discontinued, but the site still displayed its photo for reference.
examples.zh: 小号时钟「已停产」，但网站仍展示它的照片供参考。

examples.en: I found out my favorite pencil case was discontinued when the page showed its replacement.
examples.zh: 看到页面推荐它的替代款，我才发现最喜欢的笔袋「已停产」。

words.enDefinition: The sum of money taken off the cost of an order.

examples.en: The discount amount appeared as a separate line below the names of the two folders.
examples.zh: 「优惠减免金额」单独列在两个文件夹名称的下方。

examples.en: I checked the discount amount after removing a small notebook from my online cart.
examples.zh: 我从网上购物车里移除一本小笔记本后，查看了「优惠减免金额」。

words.enDefinition: A prominent strip on a website or sign that advertises a discount.

examples.en: A discount banner at the top of the page linked to the eligible stationery.
examples.zh: 页面顶部的「折扣横幅」链接到参加活动的文具。

examples.en: The discount banner stayed on the page even after I changed the selected color.
examples.zh: 即便我改了所选颜色，「折扣横幅」仍然显示在页面上。

words.enDefinition: The largest amount a promotion can take off a qualifying purchase.

examples.en: The discount cap applied even though my order included several packs of drawing paper.
examples.zh: 即使我的订单包含多包绘图纸，仍有「最高减免金额」限制。

examples.en: I noticed the discount cap after looking at the promotion below the large banner.
examples.zh: 我查看了大横幅下方的优惠信息后，留意到「最高减免金额」。

collocations: a discount cap of ten dollars

words.enDefinition: A reduction applied to the combined price of the eligible order rather than a single item.

examples.en: The code gave us a discount on the whole order for the group project.
examples.zh: 使用优惠码后，小组项目的采购享受了「整单折扣」。

examples.en: I checked whether the discount on the whole order applied to the gift wrapping too.
examples.zh: 我核对了一下「整单折扣」是否也适用于礼品包装。

collocations: offer a discount on the whole order
get a discount on the whole order
apply a discount on the whole order

words.enDefinition: the process of returning a purchase that was sold at a reduced price

examples.en: The employee looked up the discounted item return rules before examining my receipt.
examples.zh: 员工先查「打折商品退货」的规定，再查看我的收据。

examples.en: I asked how a discounted item return would show up on my account.
examples.zh: 我问「打折商品退货」会怎样显示在我的账户里。

words.enDefinition: a sample product set out for customers to look at or handle

examples.en: The assistant showed me the display model before fetching a boxed kettle.
examples.zh: 店员先给我看了「陈列样机」，然后去拿盒装的新水壶。

examples.en: The display model felt lighter than the one I already had at home.
examples.zh: 这台「陈列样机」拿起来比我家里那台更轻。

words.enDefinition: a table used to show products to people in a shop

examples.en: The folded sweatshirts were on a display table beside the front window.
examples.zh: 叠好的卫衣放在橱窗旁的「商品陈列台」上。

examples.en: I put the folded shirt back on the display table before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前，我把叠好的衬衫放回了「商品陈列台」。

collocations: arrange items on a display table
a display table by the entrance

words.enDefinition: the result recorded after a disputed matter has been considered

examples.en: I read the dispute outcome after receiving an email from the marketplace.
examples.zh: 我收到电商平台的邮件后，查看了「纠纷处理结果」。

examples.en: The dispute outcome explained which photos were relevant to the decision.
examples.zh: 「纠纷处理结果」说明了哪些照片和处理决定有关。

collocations: notify someone of the dispute outcome

words.enDefinition: the category or explanation given for challenging a purchase

examples.en: I changed the dispute reason after discovering the invoice listed the wrong model.
examples.zh: 我发现凭据上的型号不对之后，更改了「发起纠纷的原因」。

examples.en: The form displayed my dispute reason above the description I had typed.
examples.zh: 表单把「发起纠纷的原因」显示在我输入的说明上面。

words.enDefinition: selling goods or services through channels without meeting the buyer in person

examples.en: Our consumer studies class compared distance selling through a website with buying in person.
examples.zh: 消费研究课对比了通过网站「远程销售」和当面购物。

examples.en: I found a page about distance selling while reading the terms of my online order.
examples.zh: 我看网上订单条款时，找到了一页介绍「远程销售」的材料。

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether a shop sells a particular brand

examples.en: “Do you carry this brand?” I asked, showing the label on my bottle.
examples.zh: 我给店员看了瓶子上的标签，问「你们有卖这个牌子吗？」

examples.en: I showed the assistant a photo and asked, “Do you carry this brand?”
examples.zh: 我给店员看了张照片，问「你们有卖这个牌子吗？」

collocations: “Do you carry this brand in store?”
“Do you carry this brand anywhere nearby?”

words.expression: do you have any more in the back
words.lemma: do you have any more in the back
words.enDefinition: a question asking whether extra items are kept off the shop floor
acceptedEnVariants: do you have any more in the back

examples.en: The shelf was almost empty, so I asked, “Do you have any more in the back?”
examples.zh: 货架几乎空了，我便问「备货间还有吗？」

examples.en: “Do you have any more in the back?” my roommate asked at the till.
examples.zh: 室友在收银台问「备货间还有吗？」

collocations: ask “Do you have any more in the back?”
“Do you have any more in the back unopened?”
“Do you have any more in the back at this store?”

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether a shopper wants a bag for the purchase

examples.en: The cashier asked, “Do you need a bag?” as I packed my wallet away.
examples.zh: 我收起钱包时，收银员问「你需要袋子吗？」

examples.en: “Do you need a bag?” she asked after scanning the last notebook.
examples.zh: 她扫完最后一本笔记本后问「你需要袋子吗？」

collocations: “Do you need a bag for that?”
“Do you need a bag for the books?”

words.enDefinition: a question about whether any part of a shoe squeezes the foot

examples.en: “Does it pinch anywhere?” the assistant asked when I took the first step.
examples.zh: 我迈出第一步时，店员问「有没有哪里夹脚？」

examples.en: My friend watched me try the boot and asked, “Does it pinch anywhere?”
examples.zh: 朋友看我试靴子，问「有没有哪里夹脚？」

collocations: “Does it pinch anywhere when you walk?”
“Does it pinch anywhere near your toes?”

words.enDefinition: asks whether a device can power on at all
