examples.en: The first question I had was, "Does it turn on with the original charger?"
examples.zh: 我第一个问题是，用原装充电器「能开机吗」？

examples.en: I messaged the seller, "Does it turn on when you press the power button?"
examples.zh: 我给卖家发消息问，按下电源键「能开机吗」？

collocations: does it turn on at all
does it turn on with the charger

words.enDefinition: a container where people leave items for an organization to collect

examples.en: I checked what the donation bin could accept before bringing my old clothes.
examples.zh: 我先看了「捐赠箱」能收什么，再把旧衣服带过去。

examples.en: The student volunteers moved the donation bin inside when it started raining.
examples.zh: 下雨后，学生志愿者把「捐赠箱」搬进了屋里。

collocations: put clothes in a donation bin
donated items in a donation bin

words.enDefinition: twice the number of points normally awarded for a transaction

examples.en: A sign at the checkout offered double points to members during the weekend.
examples.zh: 收银台的告示写着，会员周末可获「双倍积分」。

examples.en: The app showed double points for stationery but the usual rate for everything else.
examples.zh: 应用显示文具可获「双倍积分」，其他商品仍按平时的比率。

words.enDefinition: to move your membership to a lower level with fewer benefits

examples.en: You can downgrade your membership online if the higher plan no longer suits you.
examples.zh: 如果更高的方案不再适合，你可以在线「调低会员等级」。

examples.en: The email explained when to downgrade your membership before the next payment was due.
examples.zh: 邮件说明要在下次付款前什么时候「调低会员等级」。

collocations: contact support to downgrade your membership

words.enDefinition: to take something to a service location and leave it there for repair

examples.en: The librarian showed me which devices I could drop off for repair on campus.
examples.zh: 图书管理员告诉我，哪些设备可以在学校「送去维修」。

examples.en: I called about the printer I planned to drop off for repair that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我打电话咨询那天下午打算「送去维修」的打印机。

collocations: arrange to drop off for repair
devices to drop off for repair
choose where to drop off for repair

words.enDefinition: An unintended second order for the same items.

examples.en: I checked my inbox for a duplicate order after my browser briefly stopped responding.
examples.zh: 浏览器短暂卡住后，我查看了收件箱，看看是否生成了「重复订单」。

examples.en: My roommate noticed a duplicate order for the desk lamp in the account history.
examples.zh: 室友在账户的历史记录里发现了台灯的「重复订单」。

words.enDefinition: a removable paper cover placed around a hardback book

examples.en: The hardback didn't have a dust jacket, but its cover was in good condition.
examples.zh: 这本精装书没有「外护封」，不过封面保存得不错。

examples.en: I asked for a photo of the dust jacket before ordering the novel.
examples.zh: 我下单买这本小说前，向卖家要了张「图书外护封」的照片。

words.enDefinition: permission to use an offer or see products before general access begins

examples.en: The programme gave early access to students who had renewed their membership that month.
examples.zh: 当月续会的学生获得了活动的「提前开放资格」。

examples.en: My early access ended the evening before the new collection opened to everyone.
examples.zh: 新品系列向所有顾客开放的前一晚，我的「提前开放资格」结束了。

words.enDefinition: A reduction offered for buying or booking before an early deadline.

examples.en: Our department announced an early bird discount on the printed field guides for next term.
examples.zh: 我们院系公布了下学期纸质实地指南的「提前购买优惠」。

examples.en: I bought the workshop materials before the early bird discount ended on the campus website.
examples.zh: 我赶在校园网站上的「提前购买优惠」结束前买了研讨活动的材料。

collocations: an early bird discount before Friday

words.enDefinition: to receive points as a reward for purchases or other qualifying activity

examples.en: I can earn points at the campus shop without carrying a separate card.
examples.zh: 我在校园商店不用带单独的卡也能「赚取积分」。

examples.en: The app showed which shops let me earn points while visiting another city.
examples.zh: 应用列出了我去另一座城市时，哪些商店能让我「赚取积分」。

words.enDefinition: the number of points a programme awards per unit of spending or activity

examples.en: The earn rate was higher on groceries than on orders placed through partner shops.
examples.zh: 杂货消费的「积分累积比率」比通过合作店铺下单高。

examples.en: I compared the earn rate with the value of vouchers in both loyalty programmes.
examples.zh: 我比较了两个会员计划的「积分累积比率」和优惠券价值。

words.enDefinition: The reduction actually achieved after accounting for the way an offer is applied.

examples.en: The effective discount was smaller because only one of the two folders qualified for the offer.
examples.zh: 两个文件夹中只有一个符合优惠条件，所以「实际折扣幅度」更小。

examples.en: I calculated the effective discount after checking which reductions could be used together on the order.
examples.zh: 我核对了订单上哪些减免能叠加后，算出了「实际折扣幅度」。

collocations: an effective discount of ten percent

words.enDefinition: allowed to be returned under the applicable rules or policy

examples.en: The shop confirmed the lamp was eligible for return even without its outer box.
examples.zh: 店家确认，台灯没有外包装盒也「符合退货条件」。

examples.en: I asked whether the headphones were eligible for return after the package had been opened.
examples.zh: 我问拆开包装后耳机是否仍「符合退货条件」。

collocations: check if an item is eligible for return

words.enDefinition: a notice limiting a service or offer to items that satisfy stated conditions

examples.en: The return sign read eligible items only beside a small list of exclusions.
examples.zh: 退货告示写着「仅限符合条件的商品」，旁边有一小份例外清单。

examples.en: I noticed eligible items only below the option for a prepaid label on the website.
examples.zh: 我发现网站上的预付邮费标签选项下方写着「仅限符合条件的商品」。

collocations: offer available for eligible items only

words.enDefinition: a purchase that meets the requirements of a particular program

examples.en: I asked whether the jacket counted as an eligible purchase under their program.
examples.zh: 我问这件夹克在他们的计划下算不算「符合保障条件的订单」。

examples.en: The notice didn't say whether a guest order was an eligible purchase.
examples.zh: 通知没有说访客下单算不算「符合保障条件的订单」。

collocations: check whether it is an eligible purchase

words.enDefinition: assistance provided through email messages

examples.en: I picked email support because I had several photos to send with my query.
examples.zh: 我选择了「邮件客服」，因为咨询时要一起发送好几张照片。

examples.en: Email support asked me which part of the desk had not arrived.
examples.zh: 「邮件客服」问我书桌的哪部分没收到。

words.enDefinition: a delivered parcel containing none of the items expected

examples.en: I showed the adviser the empty package with the label still attached.
examples.zh: 我把还贴着标签的「空包裹」给客服看了。

examples.en: The shop wanted a photo of the label on the empty package.
examples.zh: 店家想要一张「空包裹」上标签的照片。

collocations: a photo of an empty package

words.enDefinition: a display of products at the end of a store aisle

examples.en: The towels were on an end-of-aisle display rather than along the wall.
examples.zh: 毛巾摆在「过道尽头的陈列台」上，沿墙的货架上没有。

examples.en: I walked past the end-of-aisle display before I spotted the kitchen shelves.
examples.zh: 我经过「过道尽头的陈列台」后，才看到摆厨房用品的货架。

words.enDefinition: Describes a type of product being phased out of a seller's range.

examples.en: An end-of-line lamp was cheaper than the new model, but the colors were more limited.
examples.zh: 一款「即将停售的」台灯比新款便宜，但颜色选择更少。

examples.en: The shop grouped end-of-line products on a separate shelf beside the stationery counter.
examples.zh: 商店把「即将停售的」产品集中放在文具柜台旁的单独货架上。

words.enDefinition: A sale held as a selling season comes to an end.

examples.en: I found a lightweight blanket in an end-of-season sale while preparing for my move.
examples.zh: 准备搬家时，我在一场「季末促销」中找到了轻便的毯子。

examples.en: The end-of-season sale included the remaining summer bags, which were displayed near the shop door.
examples.zh: 「季末促销」包括剩下的夏季包袋，店里把它们摆在门口附近。

collocations: buy something in the end-of-season sale

words.enDefinition: to record how many units of the same item someone is buying

examples.en: The attendant showed me where to enter the quantity for identical notebooks.
examples.zh: 收银员指给我看，同款笔记本要在哪里「输入商品件数」。

examples.en: The screen asked me to enter the quantity before adding the items.
examples.zh: 屏幕在添加商品前要求我「输入商品件数」。

collocations: ask someone to enter the quantity

words.enDefinition: the first or lowest level in a programme with several levels

examples.en: I stayed in the entry-level tier because I mainly shopped at the campus branch.
examples.zh: 我主要在校园门店购物，所以留在了「入门等级」。

examples.en: The entry-level tier included points but offered fewer options for early access.
examples.zh: 「入门等级」可以攒积分，提前购买的机会比较少。

words.enDefinition: a request to send an issue to someone with greater authority

examples.en: The adviser added my emails to the escalation request for the order that never arrived.
examples.zh: 客服把我的邮件加进了这笔一直没送到的订单的「升级处理申请」。

examples.en: I asked when the escalation request would reach the team handling seller disputes.
examples.zh: 我问「升级处理申请」什么时候会到负责卖家纠纷的团队。

words.enDefinition: a group that handles problems referred by initial support staff

examples.en: The escalation team asked the seller why the label showed the wrong model.
examples.zh: 「升级工单处理团队」问卖家为什么标签上的型号不对。

examples.en: An adviser from the escalation team contacted me after my afternoon class.
examples.zh: 下午的课结束后，「升级工单处理团队」的一名客服联系了我。

collocations: refer a case to the escalation team
a response from the escalation team

words.enDefinition: a sale of a household's possessions, often after someone's death

examples.en: A neighbour bought the armchair at an estate sale on our street.
examples.zh: 邻居在我们街上的一次「家中物品清售」中买下了这把扶手椅。

examples.en: The estate sale included most of the books and furniture from the house.
examples.zh: 这次「家中物品清售」出售了屋里大部分的书和家具。

words.enDefinition: a status showing an estimate is still being prepared or awaited

examples.en: The service page said estimate pending while the engineer checked the new fault.
examples.zh: 工程师检查新故障期间，服务页面显示「报价待出」。

examples.en: I saw estimate pending beside the repair number when I reopened the email.
examples.zh: 我重新打开邮件，看到维修编号旁写着「报价待出」。

words.enDefinition: The date on which a seller expects to send an item out.

examples.en: The estimated dispatch date was displayed next to the name of the personalized notebook.
examples.zh: 「预计发货日期」显示在那本定制笔记本的名称旁边。

examples.en: I wrote down the estimated dispatch date so I knew when to expect another update.
examples.zh: 我记下了「预计发货日期」，以便知道什么时候可以留意下一条消息。

collocations: an estimated dispatch date for the order

words.enDefinition: The expected period needed to prepare an order before it is sent or collected.

examples.en: The estimated processing time was longer for mugs with names printed on the side.
examples.zh: 杯身印有名字的马克杯，订单的「预计处理时间」更长。

examples.en: I checked the estimated processing time before ordering a notebook for my roommate's birthday.
examples.zh: 为室友生日订笔记本之前，我查看了订单的「预计处理时间」。

collocations: an estimated processing time of three days

words.enDefinition: A result that matches the words or identifier entered in a search.

examples.en: I entered the model number but did not find an exact match in the results.
examples.zh: 我输入了型号，却没有在结果里找到「完全匹配项」。

examples.en: The site showed an exact match for the refill named on my empty pen packet.
examples.zh: 网站显示了一款与我用完的笔的包装上注明的替芯「完全匹配」的商品。

collocations: an exact match for the model

words.enDefinition: to give back a purchase in order to receive another item instead

examples.en: I wanted to exchange an item because the colour looked different in daylight.
examples.zh: 那件商品在日光下颜色看着不一样，所以我想「换一件」。

examples.en: The cashier told me which desk to visit if I needed to exchange an item.
examples.zh: 收银员告诉我，要是「换一件商品」，应该去哪个柜台。

collocations: exchange an item for another size

words.enDefinition: a status showing the retailer has confirmed a requested exchange

examples.en: The app said exchange confirmed after the shop reserved the smaller size for me.
examples.zh: 商店为我留了小一码后，应用显示「换货已确认」。

examples.en: I got the exchange confirmed message before the warehouse printed the new mailing label.
examples.zh: 仓库打印新邮寄标签前，我收到了「换货已确认」的消息。

words.enDefinition: whether an item can be exchanged under the applicable policy

examples.en: The store checked exchange eligibility before reserving another pair of shoes for me.
examples.zh: 商店先核实「换货资格」，才为我预留另一双鞋。

examples.en: I read the exchange eligibility section before returning the jacket to the counter.
examples.zh: 我在把夹克退到柜台之前，看了「换货资格」一栏。

words.enDefinition: a label indicating that an exchange is offered instead of an ordinary refund

examples.en: The shop marked the clearance rack exchange only on the printed price card.
examples.zh: 商店在清仓货架的印刷价签上标了「只换不退」。

examples.en: I saw exchange only below the store's name on the till receipt.
examples.zh: 我在购物小票上店名的下面看到了「只换不退」。

words.enDefinition: an order created to supply an item in place of a returned purchase

examples.en: The exchange order showed the smaller size under the original jacket's product name.
examples.zh: 「换货订单」在原夹克的商品名称下标明了较小的尺码。

examples.en: I checked the shipping address on the exchange order before the seller confirmed it.
examples.zh: 卖家确认前，我检查了「换货订单」上的配送地址。

words.enDefinition: a status stating that the seller cannot offer an exchange at present

examples.en: The app showed exchange unavailable while the smaller size was out of stock.
examples.zh: 小一号码没货时，应用显示「目前无法换货」。

examples.en: I saw exchange unavailable on the order page after the store closed that evening.
examples.zh: 那天傍晚商店关门后，我在订单页面看到了「目前无法换货」。

words.enDefinition: Brands whose products are outside the terms of a promotion.

examples.en: The list of excluded brands was below the offer, along with the dates it ran.
examples.zh: 「不参加活动的品牌」列表和优惠日期都放在优惠文字下方。

examples.en: I checked the excluded brands to see whether my usual notebook was part of the sale.
examples.zh: 我查看了「不参加活动的品牌」，想知道自己常买的笔记本是否参加促销。

words.enDefinition: A notice saying that some products or circumstances are excluded from an offer.

examples.en: The window sign said “Exclusions apply” underneath the line about discounted stationery for students.
examples.zh: 橱窗告示在面向学生的文具折扣下面注明「部分情况不适用」。

examples.en: I opened the details after seeing “Exclusions apply” beside the website's offer for headphones.
examples.zh: 我在网站的耳机优惠旁看到「部分情况不适用」，就打开了详情。

collocations: read exclusions apply in the small print

words.enDefinition: A promotion code that is past its stated period of use.

examples.en: I had copied an expired code from an email sent just before my exams.
examples.zh: 我从考试前刚收到的一封邮件里复制了一个「已过期的优惠码」。

examples.en: The shop's message said I had entered an expired code when I updated the cart.
examples.zh: 我更新购物车时，店铺提示我输入了「已过期的优惠码」。

words.enDefinition: a checkout lane intended for shoppers buying a small number of items

examples.en: I took my three notebooks to the express lane near the door.
examples.zh: 我拿着三本笔记本去了门边的「少量商品快结通道」。

examples.en: The express lane had a sign showing how many items it accepted.
examples.zh: 「少量商品快结通道」有块牌子，写着最多可以结几件商品。

collocations: a sign for the express lane

words.enDefinition: a warranty created by a stated promise about a product or its performance

examples.en: The brochure included an express warranty about the battery rather than a general slogan.
examples.zh: 宣传册中对电池作出了「明示担保」，写得比宣传口号具体。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which statements in the advertisement might count as an express warranty.
examples.zh: 导师问广告里的哪些表述可能算「明示担保」。

words.enDefinition: an agreement that adds protection beyond the original product warranty

examples.en: I compared the extended warranty with the coverage already included with the laptop.
examples.zh: 我把「延长保修」与笔记本电脑原本自带的保修范围做了比较。

examples.en: The total for the monitor did not include the optional extended warranty at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时，显示器的总价没有包含可选的「延长保修」。

words.enDefinition: An additional amount or percentage taken off a price or an existing offer.

examples.en: The page showed an extra discount after I selected the larger pack for our group.
examples.zh: 我选了给小组用的大包装后，页面显示有「额外折扣」。

examples.en: I checked whether the extra discount also applied to the blue version of the lamp.
examples.zh: 我核对了一下「额外折扣」是否也适用于蓝色款台灯。

collocations: an extra discount on selected items

words.enDefinition: the formation of small balls of fibre on fabric

examples.en: She included a close-up of the fabric pilling near the sweater cuff.
examples.zh: 她附了一张毛衣袖口附近「面料起球」的特写照片。

examples.en: There was some fabric pilling on the coat where the bag strap rubbed.
examples.zh: 外套被包带磨到的地方有些「起球」。

words.enDefinition: a repair centre operated directly by the product manufacturer

examples.en: The factory service centre offered to inspect the monitor after the local shop declined.
examples.zh: 本地商店没有受理，于是「厂商直营维修中心」提出可以检查显示器。

examples.en: I received an estimate from the factory service centre shortly before leaving for campus.
examples.zh: 出发去校园前不久，我收到了「厂商直营维修中心」的报价。

collocations: send equipment to the factory service centre

words.enDefinition: a condition grade showing noticeable wear that limits appearance or quality

examples.en: My roommate expected the table in fair condition to have a few scratches.
examples.zh: 室友想，这张「成色一般」的桌子应该会有几道划痕。

examples.en: The chair was listed in fair condition because its seat was badly worn.
examples.zh: 椅子座面磨损明显，所以卖家标注为「成色一般」。

collocations: described as being in fair condition

words.enDefinition: a status showing a technician verified the reported problem

examples.en: The fault confirmed message explained which connector had caused the monitor to fail.
examples.zh: 「已确认故障」的消息说明了哪个接口导致显示器故障。

examples.en: The report stated fault confirmed after the test reproduced the problem with the power button.
examples.zh: 测试复现了电源键的问题后，报告写着「已确认故障」。

words.enDefinition: a written or spoken explanation of how a product is failing

examples.en: I included the clicking sound in my fault description for the repair technician.
examples.zh: 我给维修人员写「故障描述」时，把咔嗒声也写了进去。

examples.en: The fault description needed to state what happened each time I plugged the charger in.
examples.zh: 「故障描述」要写明我每次插上充电器时发生了什么。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a technician could not recreate the reported problem during testing

examples.en: The technician wrote “Fault not reproduced” after testing the phone throughout the afternoon.
examples.zh: 维修人员测试了那部手机一个下午，最后写下「未能复现故障」。

examples.en: I saw “Fault not reproduced” on the report and checked what tests were listed.
examples.zh: 看到报告上的「未能复现故障」后，我查看了列出的测试。

words.enDefinition: an item with a defect that affects its normal function

examples.en: The shop assistant asked me to describe what happened when I used the faulty item.
examples.zh: 店员请我说说，使用那件「有质量问题的商品」时发生了什么。

examples.en: The seller offered to inspect the faulty item at the service counter that afternoon.
examples.zh: 卖家提出当天下午可以在服务台检查「有质量问题的商品」。

words.enDefinition: To show products based on whether they are currently available to buy.

examples.en: My roommate used a checkbox to filter by availability before choosing a desk chair online.
examples.zh: 室友在网上选书桌椅前，用复选框「按库存状态筛选」。

examples.en: The page lets shoppers filter by availability, which helped when I needed a notebook soon.
examples.zh: 页面允许顾客「按库存状态筛选」，在我急需一本笔记本时很方便。

collocations: an option to filter by availability

words.enDefinition: To show only products made by selected brands.

examples.en: I used the menu to filter by brand because I only wanted original replacement tips.
examples.zh: 我只想买原厂替换笔尖，就用了菜单里的「按品牌筛选」。

examples.en: The shop lets visitors filter by brand without losing the type of bag they selected.
examples.zh: 顾客在这家店「按品牌筛选」时，可以保留已选的包袋类别。

collocations: filter by brand on the results page
an option to filter by brand

words.enDefinition: a sales label indicating the retailer treats that purchase as ineligible for routine returns

examples.en: The display marked the last pair of shoes as final sale in red.
examples.zh: 展台上用红字标明，最后一双鞋「不予常规退换」。

examples.en: I noticed the final sale label before I paid for the discounted jacket.
examples.zh: 我买那件打折夹克付款前，看到了「不予常规退换」的标签。

words.enDefinition: Important conditions printed in smaller text below or beside the main offer.

examples.en: The fine print said the free pouch was available only with the larger set.
examples.zh: 「小字条款」写着，只有买大套装才会附送小包。

examples.en: I read the fine print because the voucher showed a different total from my estimate.
examples.zh: 优惠券显示的总额和我估算的不一样，所以我读了「小字条款」。

words.enDefinition: Restricts an offer to the first order a person places with a seller.

examples.en: The shop listed the code as “First order only” beneath its welcome offer.
examples.zh: 店铺在新客优惠下方为优惠码注明「仅限首单」。

examples.en: I noticed the message “First order only” after opening the offer from our orientation booklet.
examples.zh: 我打开迎新手册里的优惠后，注意到「仅限首单」。

collocations: an offer marked first order only
a code valid for first order only
a message saying first order only

words.enDefinition: a repair that resolves the reported problem on the first attempt

examples.en: The shop described the loose connection as a first-time fix in its service log.
examples.zh: 维修店在服务记录中写明，松动接口「一次修好」。

examples.en: I asked how often an appointment ended with a first-time fix for that fault.
examples.zh: 我问这种故障有多大概率在第一次送修时就「一次修好」。

words.enDefinition: suitable for the job or use expected of the product

examples.en: I asked whether the bag was fit for purpose as a laptop carrier on rainy days.
examples.zh: 我问这个包在雨天装笔记本电脑，是否「适合预定用途」。

examples.en: The reviewer said the inexpensive stand was fit for purpose in a small study room.
examples.zh: 评论者说，这个便宜的支架用在小自习室里「适合预定用途」。

collocations: goods that are fit for purpose
make sure something is fit for purpose

words.enDefinition: small enough to carry inside a particular car

examples.en: I measured the shelf to make sure it fits in the car with both seats down.
examples.zh: 我量了搁架的尺寸，确认放倒两个座位后它「装得进汽车」。

examples.en: The table fits in the car once the seller takes the legs off today.
examples.zh: 卖家今天把桌腿卸下来后，桌子就「装得进汽车」。

collocations: check whether it fits in the car
make sure it fits in the car
see if it fits in the car

words.enDefinition: the employee who manages entry to a store's fitting rooms

examples.en: The fitting room attendant counted my items before showing me a cubicle.
examples.zh: 「试衣间服务员」先数了我要试的衣服，然后指给我一个隔间。

examples.en: I asked the fitting room attendant where to leave the clothes I didn't want.
examples.zh: 我问「试衣间服务员」不想买的衣服要放在哪里。

collocations: show your items to the fitting room attendant
speak with a fitting room attendant

words.enDefinition: an advertisement that sets a price rather than inviting bids

examples.en: I chose a fixed-price listing because I needed the chair by Friday.
examples.zh: 因为周五之前就需要椅子，我选了一个「固定价格商品帖」。

examples.en: The marketplace displayed a fixed-price listing next to the auction for a similar bike.
examples.zh: 平台在一辆类似自行车的拍卖信息旁展示了一个「固定价格商品帖」。

words.enDefinition: A sale that lasts for a very short time.

examples.en: The flash sale started during our evening lecture, so I looked at the products afterward.
examples.zh: 「短时抢购活动」开始时我们在上晚课，所以我下课后才去看商品。

examples.en: I found the lamp in a flash sale that lasted just a few hours.
examples.zh: 我在只持续了几个小时的「短时抢购活动」中找到了那盏台灯。

words.enDefinition: a repair offered for a set price within specified conditions

examples.en: The shop gave me a flat-rate repair option for the laptop's cracked screen.
examples.zh: 店家为开裂的笔记本电脑屏幕提供了「固定费率维修」选项。

examples.en: I read what the flat-rate repair included before selecting it on the support site.
examples.zh: 在支持网站上选定之前，我看了「固定费率维修」包括哪些项目。

words.enDefinition: a market where stalls often sell used or vintage goods

examples.en: We found matching bowls at a flea market held near the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站附近举办的「跳蚤市场」上找到了同款的碗。

examples.en: The Saturday flea market had a stall selling old maps and postcards.
examples.zh: 周六的「跳蚤市场」有一个摊位卖旧地图和明信片。

words.enDefinition: the manager responsible for staff and activity on a sales floor

examples.en: The clerk asked the floor manager to take a look at my order.
examples.zh: 店员请「卖场主管」帮忙看一下我的订单。

examples.en: I spoke to the floor manager near the entrance after comparing the boxes.
examples.zh: 我对照过两个盒子后，在入口附近和「卖场主管」谈了谈。

words.enDefinition: Measurements of an item when it has been folded down.

examples.en: The folded dimensions mattered because I wanted to keep the laptop stand in my drawer.
examples.zh: 「折叠后尺寸」很重要，因为我想把电脑支架放进抽屉。

examples.en: One student mentioned the folded dimensions when recommending the drying rack for small dorm rooms.
examples.zh: 一名同学推荐这个适合小宿舍的晾衣架时，提到了「折叠后尺寸」。

words.enDefinition: to check again about a support request already in the system

examples.en: I used the same email address to follow up on a ticket from Monday.
examples.zh: 我用同一个邮箱「跟进周一的一笔工单」。

examples.en: The help page showed me how to follow up on a ticket online.
examples.zh: 帮助页面告诉我如何在网上「跟进一笔工单」。

collocations: follow up on a ticket by email
call to follow up on a ticket
follow up on a ticket from last week

words.enDefinition: additional repair work arranged after an earlier service or inspection

examples.en: The technician offered a follow-up repair after the monitor stopped working again on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日显示器再次坏掉后，维修人员提出安排「后续维修」。

examples.en: I booked a follow-up repair for the week after my final exam ended.
examples.zh: 我预约了「后续维修」，时间在期末考试结束后的那一周。

words.enDefinition: describing an item that does not work properly

examples.en: The printer was listed as for parts or not working because it could not feed paper.
examples.zh: 那台打印机无法进纸，所以商品页标注了「供拆件或无法使用」。

examples.en: I noticed the label for parts or not working underneath the photograph of the old camera.
examples.zh: 我在旧相机的照片下方看见了「供拆件或无法使用」的标注。

collocations: listed as for parts or not working
marked for parts or not working
for parts or not working category

words.enDefinition: offered directly by the person who owns the item

examples.en: The sign on the bicycle read for sale by owner and showed a contact number.
examples.zh: 自行车上的牌子写着「物主直售」，还留了一个联系电话。

examples.en: I filtered by for sale by owner listings when I was looking for a used canoe.
examples.zh: 我找旧独木舟时，按「物主直售」筛选了商品。

collocations: listed as for sale by owner

words.enDefinition: offered mainly for its parts or for someone to fix

examples.en: My flatmate listed the broken bicycle for spares or repair in the student group.
examples.zh: 室友在学生群里把坏自行车挂出来，写着「供拆件或维修」。

examples.en: The seller said the old amplifier was for spares or repair because it produced no sound.
examples.zh: 卖家说旧功放没有声音，标注为「供拆件或维修」。

words.enDefinition: At a price equal to the one being compared or discussed.

examples.en: Another shop offered a larger pack for the same price, so I checked the sheet count.
examples.zh: 另一家店「以相同价格」出售更大一包，于是我去查看有多少张。

examples.en: I could get the blue case for the same price if I picked it up locally.
examples.zh: 如果在本地自提，我可以「以相同价格」买到蓝色保护套。

collocations: get a bigger pack for the same price
sell two versions for the same price
offer more for the same price

words.enDefinition: edges of fabric or material that have started to unravel

examples.en: The rug had frayed edges, so I asked for a photo in daylight.
examples.zh: 地毯的「边缘磨散了」，所以我请卖家在日光下再拍一张照片。

examples.en: Even with its frayed edges, the denim bag looked sturdy enough for my books.
examples.zh: 虽然牛仔包的「边缘磨散了」，它看起来还是够结实，能装下我的书。

words.enDefinition: participation in a programme without a regular membership fee

examples.en: I chose the free membership because I only visited the shop once a month.
examples.zh: 我每月只去这家店一次，所以选了「免费会员资格」。

examples.en: The retailer introduced free membership for people who wanted to earn rewards on groceries.
examples.zh: 零售商为想靠买菜攒奖励的顾客推出了「免费会员资格」。

words.enDefinition: repair work provided without charging the owner for the service

examples.en: The manufacturer offered a free repair for products listed in its safety notice.
examples.zh: 厂商为安全通告中列出的产品提供「免费维修」。

examples.en: I checked whether the free repair included a replacement cable with the charger.
examples.zh: 我确认了「免费维修」是否包含一条替换的充电器线缆。

words.enDefinition: returns for which a customer is not charged for sending the goods back

examples.en: I checked whether free returns covered both the shoes and the discounted jacket.
examples.zh: 我查看了「免费退货」是否同时适用于鞋子和打折夹克。

examples.en: The order page listed free returns under a separate heading below the price.
examples.zh: 订单页在价格下方另设标题，写明「免费退货」。

words.enDefinition: A small amount or example of a product offered at no charge.

examples.en: The campus art shop offered a free sample of the paper next to its notebooks.
examples.zh: 校园美术用品店在笔记本旁提供了一份这种纸的「免费试用品」。

examples.en: A free sample of the hand cream was attached to the display card in the shop.
examples.zh: 店内展示卡上附有一份护手霜的「免费试用品」。

words.enDefinition: Standard delivery for which the shopper is not charged a shipping fee.

examples.en: The cart offered free standard shipping for the folders but listed a charge for faster delivery.
examples.zh: 购物车显示文件夹「标准配送免运费」，更快的配送则要收费。

examples.en: I chose free standard shipping because I already had enough paper for this week's class.
examples.zh: 因为这周上课用的纸已经够了，我选了「标准配送免运费」。

words.enDefinition: a shop where people can take donated items without paying

examples.en: I found three mugs at the campus free store before moving into residence.
examples.zh: 住进宿舍前，我在学校的「免费取物店」找到了三个马克杯。

examples.en: The free store takes kitchenware and winter clothing donated by students leaving campus.
examples.zh: 「免费取物店」接收离校学生捐出的厨具和冬衣。

words.enDefinition: offered without payment to someone who will use it

examples.en: Our neighbour's spare table was free to a good home when she cleared out her garage.
examples.zh: 邻居清理车库时，愿把多出来的桌子「免费送给有需要的人」。

examples.en: The listing offered the plant pots free to a good home before the end of term.
examples.zh: 帖子说，学期结束前会把这些花盆「免费送给有需要的人」。

collocations: advertise as free to a good home
free to a good home listing
offer furniture free to a good home

words.enDefinition: A better version or higher service level offered at no additional charge.

examples.en: The printing shop offered a free upgrade to thicker paper for our exhibition posters.
examples.zh: 印刷店给我们的展览海报提供了「免费升级」，可以用更厚的纸。

examples.en: I checked what the free upgrade included before ordering a display board for class.
examples.zh: 给课堂订展示板前，我先核对了「免费升级」包括什么。

collocations: a free upgrade to the larger size

words.enDefinition: a mistake while preparing or sending out an order

examples.en: The retailer confirmed there had been a fulfilment error with my first parcel.
examples.zh: 零售商确认，我的第一个包裹有「订单发货差错」。

examples.en: They described it as a fulfilment error after comparing the order and warehouse record.
examples.zh: 他们对照订单和仓库记录后，把它定为「订单发货差错」。

words.enDefinition: in US consumer warranty law, a written warranty meeting specified federal requirements for coverage

examples.en: The US brochure placed full warranty and limited warranty under two separate headings.
examples.zh: 美国的宣传册把「美国完全保修」和有限保修放在两个不同的标题下。

examples.en: I asked the clerk which parts of the equipment the full warranty described.
examples.zh: 我问店员，「美国完全保修」说明中提到了设备的哪些部件。

collocations: product sold with a full warranty

words.enDefinition: able to perform all the functions it was designed for

examples.en: The keyboard is fully functional, but there are scratches around the space bar.
examples.zh: 键盘「功能完好」，不过空格键周围有划痕。

examples.en: I asked if the used camera was still fully functional before arranging collection.
examples.zh: 我在约取相机之前，问了这台二手相机是否仍「功能完好」。

words.enDefinition: a test checking whether a product performs the operations it is meant to perform

examples.en: The technician completed a functional test before ruling out a fault with the power switch.
examples.zh: 维修人员做了「功能测试」，才排除电源开关故障。

examples.en: Our lab assistant watched a functional test of the unit after the cable was replaced.
examples.zh: 换完线缆后，实验室助理观看了设备的「功能测试」。

words.enDefinition: extra space between a waistband and the body

examples.en: I noticed a gap at the waist when I turned sideways to the mirror.
examples.zh: 我侧身照镜子时，发现「腰部有一处空隙」。

examples.en: The smaller pair reduced the gap at the waist without feeling uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 小一码的那条把「腰部空隙」缩小了，穿着也没觉得难受。

collocations: notice a gap at the waist
a small gap at the waist
trousers with a gap at the waist

words.enDefinition: a sale of used household goods held at someone's home

examples.en: I found an old bread tin at a neighbour's garage sale last Sunday.
examples.zh: 上周日，我在邻居办的「车库旧物售卖」上找到一个旧面包烤模。

examples.en: They put a garage sale sign on the lawn beside the student house.
examples.zh: 他们在学生合租屋旁的草坪上立了块「车库旧物售卖」的牌子。

words.enDefinition: leather made from an animal hide rather than manufactured material

examples.en: The bag was labelled genuine leather inside the small zipped pocket.
examples.zh: 包的小拉链袋里标有「真皮」字样。

examples.en: The seller described the sofa as genuine leather and showed me the label.
examples.zh: 卖家说这张沙发是「真皮」的，还给我看了标签。

collocations: check for a genuine leather label

words.enDefinition: to ask for assistance related to an existing purchase

examples.en: I clicked the button to get help with an order from last week.
examples.zh: 我点了按钮，为「上周那笔订单找客服帮忙」。

examples.en: You can get help with an order from its page in the app.
examples.zh: 在这个应用里，你可以到订单页面「找客服处理订单问题」。

collocations: get help with an order online
get help with an order from a seller
click to get help with an order

words.enDefinition: a decorative bag used to present a gift

examples.en: I asked for a gift bag after choosing the scarf for my friend.
examples.zh: 我给朋友挑好围巾后，要了一个「礼品袋」。

examples.en: The clerk brought a small gift bag that fit the notebook perfectly.
examples.zh: 店员拿来一个小「礼品袋」，刚好能装那本笔记本。

collocations: put a present in a gift bag

words.enDefinition: a decorative box used to present an item as a gift

examples.en: The assistant found a gift box large enough for both of the mugs.
examples.zh: 店员找了个能装下两个马克杯的「礼品盒」。

examples.en: I chose a plain gift box because I had a ribbon at home.
examples.zh: 我家里有丝带，就选了个素色「礼品盒」。

collocations: put an item in a gift box

words.enDefinition: a membership bought or arranged for someone else as a gift

examples.en: My friends bought a gift membership for me before my first year abroad.
examples.zh: 我出国读第一学年前，朋友给我买了一份「赠送的会员资格」。

examples.en: The store emailed the details of the gift membership directly to my sister.
examples.zh: 商店把「赠送的会员资格」详情直接发邮件给了姐姐。

words.enDefinition: A short message the buyer asks a seller to include with a gift.

examples.en: I added a gift message to the notebook I ordered for my roommate's graduation.
examples.zh: 我给室友订了本笔记本作为毕业礼物，还附上了「礼品附言」。

examples.en: The page gave me room to write a gift message below the recipient's name.
examples.zh: 页面在收礼人姓名下方留了空间填写「礼品附言」。

words.enDefinition: a receipt for a gift that usually leaves out the price

examples.en: My friend put a gift receipt in the box in case the jumper didn't fit.
examples.zh: 朋友在盒子里放了张「礼品退换凭条」，以防毛衣不合身。

examples.en: The cashier scanned the gift receipt and asked which size I wanted instead.
examples.zh: 收银员扫描了「礼品退换凭条」，问我想换哪个尺码。

collocations: return a gift with a gift receipt

words.enDefinition: the return of a purchase someone received as a gift

examples.en: I asked whether a gift return would send credit to me or the purchaser.
examples.zh: 我问「礼品退货」的款项会退给我，还是会退给买礼物的人。

examples.en: The shop handled the gift return after I showed the receipt from the box.
examples.zh: 我出示盒子里的收据后，商店办理了「礼品退货」。

words.enDefinition: a tag attached to a gift for a name or short message

examples.en: The clerk left the gift tag blank so I could write it later.
examples.zh: 店员把「礼物吊牌」留空，让我回去自己写。

examples.en: I wrote my roommate's name on the gift tag at the counter.
examples.zh: 我在柜台把室友的名字写在「礼物吊牌」上。

collocations: write a name on a gift tag

words.enDefinition: A free item included when a purchase meets the stated offer conditions.

examples.en: The shop offered a gift with purchase when I bought the larger pack of markers.
examples.zh: 我买大包装马克笔时，店铺提供了一份「购物赠品」。

examples.en: A small pouch appeared as the gift with purchase on the checkout screen that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，一只小收纳袋作为「购物赠品」出现在结算页面上。

collocations: a gift with purchase of a calculator

words.enDefinition: a store counter where purchases can be wrapped as gifts

examples.en: I took the books to the gift wrap counter after paying for them.
examples.zh: 我结完书钱，把书拿到「礼品包装柜台」。

examples.en: The gift wrap counter had three rolls of paper to choose from.
examples.zh: 「礼品包装柜台」有三卷包装纸可选。

collocations: go to the gift wrap counter
ask at the gift wrap counter
a line at the gift wrap counter

words.enDefinition: Wrapping provided to make a purchased item ready to give as a gift.

examples.en: The shop offered gift wrapping for the pen set I was sending to my sister.
examples.zh: 店铺为我准备送给姐姐的套笔提供「礼品包装」。

examples.en: I selected gift wrapping because the planner was going straight to my friend's residence hall.
examples.zh: 我选了「礼品包装」，因为手账会直接寄到朋友的宿舍楼。

words.enDefinition: A surface treatment that makes an item look shiny.

examples.en: The glossy finish on the tablet cover reflected the window in one review photo.
examples.zh: 一张评价照片里，平板保护套的「亮光表面」映出了窗户。

examples.en: The site showed a close-up of the glossy finish on the pale blue desk tray.
examples.zh: 网站用一张特写展示了浅蓝色桌面托盘的「亮光表面」。

collocations: a cover with a glossy finish

words.enDefinition: a resale grade for used goods with limited wear

examples.en: The listing said the coat was in good used condition despite one missing button.
examples.zh: 商品页上写着，这件外套虽然少了一颗纽扣，但「二手成色良好」。

examples.en: I donated a bicycle in good used condition that my sister had outgrown.
examples.zh: 我捐出了一辆妹妹已经骑不了的自行车，车的「二手成色良好」。

words.enDefinition: An option to place an order without creating or using a store account.

examples.en: I used guest checkout because I was ordering a replacement cover from the store just once.
examples.zh: 我只会在这家店买一次备用封套，所以用了「游客结算」。

examples.en: Our group chose guest checkout when ordering a set of folders for the new project.
examples.zh: 给新项目买一套文件夹时，我们小组选了「游客结算」。

words.enDefinition: Half of the amount normally charged for the item.

examples.en: The notebooks with plain covers were half price when the shop cleared the display table.
examples.zh: 店铺清理陈列台时，素面笔记本卖「半价」。

examples.en: I bought the pencil case for half price at the sale after my afternoon class.
examples.zh: 下午下课后，我在促销活动中以「半价」买了这个笔袋。

words.enDefinition: a shoe size between two adjacent whole-number sizes

examples.en: I asked whether the trainers came in a half size above these.
examples.zh: 我问这款运动鞋有没有比这双大「半码」的。

examples.en: The assistant brought a half size up because my toes touched the front.
examples.zh: 我的脚趾顶到鞋头，店员给我拿了一双「大半码」的。

words.enDefinition: a portable device used to read barcodes or other codes

examples.en: The cashier used a handheld scanner for the box in my cart.
examples.zh: 收银员用「手持扫描器」扫了我购物车里那个盒子的码。

examples.en: I found a handheld scanner attached to the side of the checkout.
examples.zh: 我发现收银设备侧面连着一个「手持扫描器」。

words.enDefinition: an amount taken out of a refund to cover handling costs

examples.en: The refund breakdown showed a handling deduction under the original price of the item.
examples.zh: 退款明细在商品原价下面列了一笔「扣除的处理费」。

examples.en: I asked the seller to explain the handling deduction on the credit statement.
examples.zh: 我请卖家说明退款账单中「扣除的处理费」。

words.enDefinition: movement of the heel up and down inside a shoe

examples.en: I noticed some heel slip when I took a few steps.
examples.zh: 我走了几步，发现鞋子有些「鞋跟不跟脚」。

examples.en: The second pair felt better, with less heel slip as I walked.
examples.zh: 第二双穿起来感觉更好，走路时「鞋跟没那么容易滑脱」。

words.enDefinition: a section of a site containing answers and ways to get assistance

examples.en: I searched the help center before sending a message about the missing cable.
examples.zh: 我先在「帮助中心」搜索了一下，再发消息说电线少了一根。

examples.en: The help center had an article about orders delivered in more than one box.
examples.zh: 「帮助中心」有篇文章，讲订单分多个箱子送达的情况。

words.enDefinition: a category of instructions or answers on a support page

examples.en: I selected a help topic about damaged items to see my contact options.
examples.zh: 我选了有关商品损坏的「帮助主题」，查看能通过哪些方式联系。

examples.en: That help topic explained where to find my messages from the seller.
examples.zh: 那个「帮助主题」说明了在哪里能找到卖家发给我的消息。

collocations: a help topic about online orders

words.enDefinition: A review that gives information another shopper finds useful.

examples.en: A helpful review explained which tablets fit inside the sleeve with a keyboard attached.
examples.zh: 一条「有参考价值的评价」说明了哪些平板装着键盘也能放进内胆包。

examples.en: I found a helpful review that described how bright the lamp looked in a small room.
examples.zh: 我找到了一条「有参考价值的评价」，描述了这盏灯在小房间里有多亮。

words.enDefinition: Expenses that are hard to notice at first when looking at the advertised price.

examples.en: I checked for hidden costs after noticing that the listed lamp price excluded its adapter.
examples.zh: 我发现台灯标价不含适配器后，查了查是否还有「未显明的额外费用」。

examples.en: The comparison sheet helped us spot hidden costs for the board we needed for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 对比表帮助我们发现了展览所需展板的「未显明的额外费用」。

words.enDefinition: colour added over text to mark important parts

examples.en: The listing said there was highlighting in the first three chapters only.
examples.zh: 商品页注明，只有前三章有「高亮标记」。

examples.en: I didn't mind the highlighting because all the figures were still readable.
examples.zh: 我不介意「高亮标记」，因为所有图表都看得清。

words.enDefinition: to keep an item available for a particular buyer temporarily

examples.en: The seller agreed to hold an item until a student could view it Saturday.
examples.zh: 卖家同意「暂时留货」，等一位同学周六来看。

examples.en: At the swap meet, one stall was happy to hold an item until noon.
examples.zh: 在交换集市上，有个摊位愿意「暂时留货」到中午。

collocations: ask someone to hold an item

words.enDefinition: music played to a caller who is temporarily waiting

examples.en: The hold music stopped just before a different adviser answered my call.
examples.zh: 另一位客服接起我的电话之前，「电话等候音乐」停了。

examples.en: I heard hold music after the adviser asked me to wait for a minute.
examples.zh: 客服请我稍等片刻，之后我就听到了「电话等候音乐」。

collocations: put a caller on hold with hold music

words.enDefinition: Remains in good condition through continued normal use.

examples.en: The cover holds up well in my backpack even when I carry it every day.
examples.zh: 即使每天都把封套装在背包里，它也很「经用」。

examples.en: A reviewer wrote that the handle holds up well after a year of commuting.
examples.zh: 一位评价者写道，通勤用了一年后，提手依然很「经用」。

collocations: holds up well to daily use

words.enDefinition: a special period for returning purchases made around a holiday

examples.en: The holiday return window gave my sister time to try the jacket after Christmas.
examples.zh: 「节日购物退货期限」让姐姐可以在圣诞节后试穿夹克再决定。

examples.en: The receipt did not say whether the holiday return window covered this purchase.
examples.zh: 收据没写这次购买是否适用「节日购物退货期限」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a shop selling things used in the home

examples.en: I found the kettle in the homeware section next to the stationery.
examples.zh: 我在文具旁边的「家居用品区」找到了水壶。

examples.en: We walked through the homeware section to compare bowls for our flat.
examples.zh: 我们去了「家居用品区」，想给合租房挑几个碗。

words.enDefinition: an additional membership card issued to someone at the main member's address

examples.en: My sister collected her household card after the clerk confirmed our shared address.
examples.zh: 店员确认我们同住的地址后，姐姐领取了「同住成员附卡」。

examples.en: I checked whether the household card had the same expiry as the main one.
examples.zh: 我查了「同住成员附卡」和主卡的到期日期是否相同。

words.enDefinition: a membership that can extend benefits to people at one address

examples.en: The household membership allowed me to add my partner from the same address.
examples.zh: 这项「同住成员会员计划」允许我把住在同一地址的伴侣加为会员。

examples.en: I checked whether the household membership would cover all the people in our flat.
examples.zh: 我问「同住成员会员计划」能不能覆盖公寓里同住的每个人。

words.expression: how long will the review take
words.lemma: how long will the review take
words.enDefinition: a question about the time needed to examine a case
acceptedEnVariants: how long will the review take

examples.en: “How long will the review take?” I asked after sending the photo of the label.
examples.zh: 我发完标签照片后问「审核要多久？」

examples.en: The customer wrote, “How long will the review take?” after the complaint was assigned.
examples.zh: 投诉分配给客服后，顾客写道「审核要多久？」

collocations: ask “How long will the review take?”
“How long will the review take from here?”
“How long will the review take once you have the photos?”

words.expression: how many items can I take in
words.lemma: how many items can i take in
words.enDefinition: a question about the number of items allowed in a fitting room
acceptedEnVariants: how many items can I take in

examples.en: I held up the jackets and asked, “How many items can I take in?”
examples.zh: 我举起几件夹克，问「我能带几件进去试穿？」

examples.en: “How many items can I take in?” she asked at the fitting room entrance.
examples.zh: 她在试衣间入口问「我能带几件进去试穿？」

collocations: ask “How many items can I take in?”
“How many items can I take in at once?”
“How many items can I take in with me?”

words.enDefinition: a question asking how well the item fits the person wearing it

examples.en: “How's the fit?” the attendant asked as I stepped out of the fitting room.
examples.zh: 我从试衣间出来时，服务员问「穿着合身吗？」

examples.en: My roommate looked up from her phone and asked, “How's the fit?”
examples.zh: 室友从手机上抬起头，问「穿着合身吗？」

collocations: “How's the fit compared with the other pair?”

words.enDefinition: a seal used to keep certain goods hygienically closed until they are opened

examples.en: The return note asked whether the hygiene seal was still intact on the package.
examples.zh: 退货说明询问包装上的「卫生封签」是否完好。

examples.en: I found a loose hygiene seal when I opened the parcel that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午我打开快递包裹后，发现商品的「卫生封签」松了。

words.enDefinition: a statement explaining that you cannot locate your purchase record

examples.en: I can't find my order even though the confirmation email arrived yesterday.
examples.zh: 「我找不到自己的订单」，可我昨天已经收到确认邮件了。

examples.en: “I can't find my order,” I wrote after signing into both accounts.
examples.zh: 我登录过两个账户后写道「我找不到自己的订单」。

collocations: “I can't find my order in the app”
“I can't find my order in my account”

words.enDefinition: an offer to put your own purchases into bags

examples.en: “I'll bag these myself,” I said as I took out my reusable bag.
examples.zh: 我掏出自己的环保袋，说「这些我自己装袋」。

examples.en: My roommate told the cashier, “I'll bag these myself,” and moved to the side.
examples.zh: 室友跟收银员说「这些我自己装袋」，然后挪到一边。

collocations: “I'll bag these myself while you scan”

words.enDefinition: a response saying you want to browse the shop first

examples.en: “I'll have a look around,” I said when the assistant offered to help.
examples.zh: 店员主动提供帮助时，我说「我先自己逛逛」。

examples.en: My friend answered, “I'll have a look around,” and headed toward the shelves.
examples.zh: 朋友回答「我先自己逛逛」，然后朝货架走去。

collocations: “I'll have a look around and come back”

words.expression: I received one instead of two
words.lemma: i received one instead of two
words.zhGloss: 说好的两件只收到一件
words.enDefinition: a statement explaining that only half the ordered units arrived
acceptedZhAnswers: 说好的两件只收到一件
acceptedEnVariants: I received one instead of two

examples.en: I received one instead of two, although both chargers appear on the receipt.
examples.zh: 「说好的两件我只收到一件」，收据上却列了两个充电器。

examples.en: “I received one instead of two,” I wrote when reporting the missing notebook.
examples.zh: 我上报少了一本笔记本时写道「说好的两件我只收到一件」。

collocations: say “I received one instead of two”
“I received one instead of two in the box”
“I received one instead of two in the first delivery”

words.enDefinition: a way to tell someone images are included with your message

examples.en: I've attached the photos so you can see both labels side by side.
examples.zh: 「我把照片附上了」，你可以对照看两张标签。

examples.en: “I've attached the photos,” I wrote below the description of the broken clasp.
examples.zh: 我在描述坏掉的搭扣后写道「我把照片附上了」。

collocations: “I've attached the photos to this message”

words.enDefinition: A note saying that an image is an example and may differ from what is supplied.

examples.en: The caption said “Image for illustration only” beneath the photo of the desk organizer.
examples.zh: 收纳架照片下方的文字写着「图片仅供参考」。

examples.en: I noticed “Image for illustration only” after checking whether the pictured accessories were included.
examples.zh: 我核对图片里的配件是否随附后，留意到了「图片仅供参考」。

collocations: a note reading image for illustration only
mark a picture image for illustration only
a caption saying image for illustration only

words.enDefinition: damage caused by a product striking something or being hit

examples.en: The technician photographed the impact damage along the lower edge of the screen.
examples.zh: 维修人员拍下了屏幕下边缘的「撞击损坏」。

examples.en: The inspection note said no impact damage was visible around the cracked hinge.
examples.zh: 检验记录写着，开裂的铰链周围没有可见的「撞击损坏」。

words.enDefinition: a warranty that can arise by law without an express promise from the seller

examples.en: The US consumer guide explained implied warranty in its section on everyday purchases.
examples.zh: 美国消费者指南在日常购买一节中解释了「默示担保」。

examples.en: Our tutor used a broken toaster to illustrate an implied warranty in the reading.
examples.zh: 导师借坏掉的烤面包机说明阅读材料中的「默示担保」。

words.enDefinition: A label stating that an offer or item is available only at physical stores.

examples.en: The wording “In-store only” explained why I could not apply the offer to my online cart.
examples.zh: 「仅限店内」说明了为什么我不能把优惠用在网上的购物车里。

examples.en: I read “In-store only” beneath the voucher and checked when the local branch opened.
examples.zh: 我在券的下方看到「仅限店内」，就查了本地分店何时开门。

words.enDefinition: a return made by taking the item to a physical shop

examples.en: I chose an in-store return so I could ask about finding a smaller size.
examples.zh: 我选择「到店退货」，这样顺便能问问有没有小一号的。

examples.en: The website showed which branches supported an in-store return for my online order.
examples.zh: 网站列出了哪些门店接受这笔网上订单的「到店退货」。

words.enDefinition: working correctly and fit for its usual purpose

examples.en: We couldn't tell whether the record player was in working order from the photo.
examples.zh: 单看照片，我们无法判断唱机是否「可以正常使用」。

examples.en: I asked whether the sewing machine was in working order after the recent repair.
examples.zh: 我问那台缝纫机最近修过之后是否「可以正常使用」。

words.enDefinition: A review written in exchange for an incentive such as a free sample or reward.

examples.en: The page labeled one comment as an incentivized review because the buyer received a sample.
examples.zh: 因为买家拿到了试用样品，页面把一条评论标为「有奖励的评价」。

examples.en: I noticed the incentivized review included a disclosure next to the customer's profile photo.
examples.zh: 我注意到这条「有奖励的评价」在顾客头像旁注明了有奖励。

words.enDefinition: Extra items that come with the product as part of the purchase.

examples.en: The included accessories were shown in a separate photograph beside the image of the lamp.
examples.zh: 「随附配件」单独拍了一张照片，放在台灯图片旁边。

examples.en: The description listed the included accessories, so I knew the cable came with the lamp.
examples.zh: 说明列出了「随附配件」，我因此知道台灯自带线缆。

collocations: a photo of the included accessories

words.enDefinition: a group of items sold together with some pieces absent

examples.en: I explained that I had received an incomplete set of cups as a gift.
examples.zh: 我说明收到的是一套送人的「缺件杯具」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the incomplete set still had its original insert.
examples.zh: 客服问那套「缺件套装」里还留着原来的夹页吗。

words.enDefinition: a repair business operating separately from the manufacturer or seller

examples.en: I visited an independent repair shop near campus to ask about the battery replacement.
examples.zh: 我去校园附近一家「独立维修店」咨询更换电池。

examples.en: The independent repair shop gave a separate estimate for the screen and the hinge.
examples.zh: 「独立维修店」分别给屏幕和铰链报了价。

words.enDefinition: words written in ink on the inside of a book

examples.en: The postcard album had an ink inscription on the inside of the cover.
examples.zh: 明信片册的封面内侧有一处「墨水题字」。

examples.en: The seller showed a photo of the ink inscription on the first page.
examples.zh: 卖家发来一张照片，能看到第一页上的「墨水题字」。

words.enDefinition: damage to the packaging immediately around the item inside a shipping carton

examples.en: I reported inner packaging damage after finding a torn sleeve around the glass.
examples.zh: 发现玻璃外面的护套破了后，我报告了「内包装损坏」。

examples.en: The support team asked for a photograph showing the inner packaging damage clearly.
examples.zh: 客服团队请我提供一张能清楚看出「内包装损坏」的照片。

words.enDefinition: the distance from the crotch seam to the lower edge of a trouser leg

examples.en: The attendant checked the inseam length before bringing me another pair of trousers.
examples.zh: 服务员先看了「裤腿内侧长度」，然后给我拿了另一条裤子。

examples.en: I wrote down the inseam length after finding a pair that fit.
examples.zh: 找到合身的裤子后，我记下了它的「裤腿内侧长度」。

words.enDefinition: A rebate deducted from the purchase amount at the time of purchase.

examples.en: The instant rebate appeared in the summary for the printer before I submitted the order.
examples.zh: 我提交订单前，打印机的订单摘要里显示了「即时减免」。

examples.en: I saw an instant rebate on the larger model when comparing prices after class.
examples.zh: 下课后比价时，我看到大款型号有「即时减免」。

words.enDefinition: The measurements of the usable space inside an item.

examples.en: I checked the interior dimensions before choosing a box for my camera and charger.
examples.zh: 为相机和充电器挑盒子之前，我查看了「内部尺寸」。

examples.en: The interior dimensions mattered more than the outside width because the folders had rigid covers.
examples.zh: 文件夹的封面是硬的，所以「内部尺寸」比外部宽度更重要。

words.enDefinition: a note visible to staff rather than the customer

examples.en: The adviser said she had added an internal note about the extra parcel.
examples.zh: 客服说，她已经就多出的那个包裹加了一条「客服内部备注」。

examples.en: An internal note helped the second agent find the photos I had sent.
examples.zh: 一条「客服内部备注」让第二位客服找到了我发过的照片。

collocations: save an internal note to the case

words.enDefinition: an edition of a textbook published for distribution in international markets

examples.en: The seller had the international edition of our economics textbook at the flea market.
examples.zh: 卖家在跳蚤市场上卖我们经济学教材的「国际版」。

examples.en: I asked my tutor whether the international edition had the same chapter numbers.
examples.zh: 我问老师，「国际版教材」的章节编号是否相同。

words.enDefinition: A promotion code that the shop does not accept for the attempted use.

examples.en: The invalid code message appeared because I had copied a space at the end.
examples.zh: 我复制时带上了末尾的空格，所以页面提示「无效优惠码」。

examples.en: I saw an invalid code warning when I tried to use the online offer in the app.
examples.zh: 我尝试在应用里用网站优惠时，看到「无效优惠码」提示。

words.expression: is the rest of the order coming separately
words.lemma: is the rest of the order coming separately
words.zhGloss: 剩下的商品会另外寄吗
words.enDefinition: a question about whether outstanding items will arrive in another shipment
acceptedZhAnswers: 剩下的商品会另外寄吗
acceptedEnVariants: is the rest of the order coming separately

examples.en: “Is the rest of the order coming separately?” I asked after opening the box.
examples.zh: 我打开箱子后问「剩下的商品会另外寄吗？」

examples.en: The student asked, “Is the rest of the order coming separately?” when contacting support.
examples.zh: 那名学生联系客户支持时问「剩下的商品会另外寄吗？」

collocations: ask “Is the rest of the order coming separately?”
“Is the rest of the order coming separately in a second box?”
“Is the rest of the order coming separately from these items?”

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether a register is serving shoppers

examples.en: “Is this checkout open?” I asked when the cashier glanced up at me.
examples.zh: 收银员抬头看我时，我问「这台收银台开着吗？」

examples.en: My friend asked, “Is this checkout open?” while I held our shopping basket.
examples.zh: 我提着我们的购物篮时，朋友问「这台收银台开着吗？」

words.enDefinition: a question checking whether any other units are available

examples.en: “Is this the last one?” I asked after noticing a dent in the box.
examples.zh: 我看到盒子有个凹痕，就问「这是最后一件吗？」

examples.en: I held up the lamp and asked the assistant, “Is this the last one?”
examples.zh: 我拿起台灯问店员「这是最后一件吗？」

collocations: “Is this the last one on display?”
“Is this the last one in this colour?”

words.enDefinition: a label showing that a problem has been dealt with

examples.en: I selected “issue resolved” after the correct lamp finally arrived on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二终于收到正确的台灯后，我选了「问题已解决」。

examples.en: The case displayed “issue resolved” below the latest note from support.
examples.zh: 工单在客服最新备注下方显示「问题已解决」。

words.enDefinition: The measurements of the item itself, such as its width, height, or depth.

examples.en: I checked the item dimensions to see if the organizer would fit on my shelf.
examples.zh: 我查看了「商品尺寸」，想知道收纳架能不能放在我的层架上。

examples.en: The item dimensions were listed below the photos on the page for the pen tray.
examples.zh: 笔盘页面的照片下方列出了「商品尺寸」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of items accepted at a particular checkout

examples.en: I checked the item limit before taking my basket to the express lane.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「结账商品件数上限」，然后才提着篮子去快结通道。

examples.en: The item limit was printed on the sign above the checkout.
examples.zh: 「结账商品件数上限」印在收银台上方的标牌上。

collocations: an item limit for the express lane

words.enDefinition: one product that should be present in a delivered package

examples.en: The clerk asked me to identify the item missing from the parcel.
examples.zh: 店员请我说一下「包裹里少的是哪件商品」。

examples.en: The seller compared the item missing from the parcel with the packing slip.
examples.zh: 卖家把「包裹里少的那件商品」和装箱单对照了一下。

collocations: report an item missing from the parcel
tell us which item is missing from the parcel
an item missing from the parcel when it arrived

words.enDefinition: a return reason saying the product differs from what the listing represented

examples.en: I chose item not as described because the listing had shown a different material.
examples.zh: 商品页显示的是另一种材质，所以我选了「商品与描述不符」。

examples.en: The return form asked for a short explanation below item not as described.
examples.zh: 退货表格在「商品与描述不符」下方要求加一句简短说明。

words.enDefinition: an order problem where the buyer has not received a product

examples.en: I selected “item not received” after checking whether my roommate had taken the parcel.
examples.zh: 我确认室友没代收包裹后，选了「未收到商品」。

examples.en: The store lists “item not received” separately from damage to an item.
examples.zh: 店家把「未收到商品」和商品损坏分开列出。

collocations: respond to an “item not received” report

words.enDefinition: A notice saying that selected items are not being held for a particular shopper.

examples.en: The cart displayed “Items are not reserved” below the notebook I had selected earlier.
examples.zh: 购物车在我先前选的笔记本下方显示「商品未预留」。

examples.en: The site reminded shoppers that items are not reserved while they remain in the cart.
examples.zh: 网站提醒顾客，商品还在购物车里时，「商品未预留」。

collocations: a note saying items are not reserved
items are not reserved until checkout
a message reading items are not reserved

words.enDefinition: a group of goods sold together in one transaction

examples.en: My flatmate bought a job lot of kitchen utensils at a local auction.
examples.zh: 室友在本地拍卖会上买了「成批出售」的一组厨具。

examples.en: The poster offered the old records as a job lot rather than individually.
examples.zh: 帖子说那些旧唱片是「成批出售」的。

words.enDefinition: to save the box and wrapping instead of throwing them away

examples.en: The seller asked me to keep the packaging while they checked the photos.
examples.zh: 卖家让我先「保留包装」，他们要看一下照片。

examples.en: I decided to keep the packaging until the shop had looked at the damage.
examples.zh: 我决定「保留包装」，等店家看过损坏情况再说。

collocations: ask a customer to keep the packaging
keep the packaging until the case is reviewed

words.enDefinition: a membership that stopped being valid because it was not renewed

examples.en: I found an old number while looking up my lapsed membership in the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用里查看「已失效的会员资格」时找到了一个旧编号。

examples.en: The clerk asked whether I wanted to reactivate the lapsed membership after moving back.
examples.zh: 店员问我搬回来后，是否想恢复「已失效的会员资格」。

words.enDefinition: An announcement that an offer or discounted stock is about to become unavailable.

examples.en: The sale page called it a last chance to buy the organizer at that price.
examples.zh: 促销页称，这是以这个价格买收纳盒的「最后机会」。

examples.en: I saw the last chance banner after the store added an end date to the deal.
examples.zh: 店铺给促销加了截止日期后，我看到了「最后机会」横幅。

words.enDefinition: the one remaining piece of a product on display

examples.en: I picked up the last one on the shelf and checked the box.
examples.zh: 我拿起「架上剩下的最后一件」，看了看包装盒。

examples.en: The student asked whether the last one on the shelf had been reserved.
examples.zh: 那名学生问「架上剩下的最后一件」是不是被预留了。

collocations: take the last one on the shelf
check the last one on the shelf
buy the last one on the shelf

words.enDefinition: The price set when a product first becomes available to buy.

examples.en: The launch price was higher than the amount now shown for the same keyboard online.
examples.zh: 这款键盘「上市时的价格」比目前网上显示的同款价格高。

examples.en: A review from last year mentioned the launch price of the lamp I wanted.
examples.zh: 去年一条评价提到我想买的台灯「上市时的价格」。

words.enDefinition: to hand over an item without putting it in a bag

examples.en: Could you leave it unbagged so I can carry it by the handle?
examples.zh: 可以「不用给它装袋」吗？我能直接提着把手走。

examples.en: I asked her to leave it unbagged because it fitted in my backpack.
examples.zh: 我请她「不用给它装袋」，因为它放得进我的背包。

collocations: ask someone to leave it unbagged

words.enDefinition: to keep an item inside the cart while it is scanned

examples.en: Could I leave this in the cart while you scan the label?
examples.zh: 您扫标签时，我能「把这件留在购物车里」吗？

examples.en: The cashier said I could leave this in the cart because it was heavy.
examples.zh: 收银员说这件比较重，我可以「把它留在购物车里」。

collocations: can I leave this in the cart
please leave this in the cart
ask if I can leave this in the cart

words.enDefinition: an offer from support to look up a customer's purchase

examples.en: “Let me check your order,” she said after I spelled my surname.
examples.zh: 我把姓氏拼给她听后，她说「我帮你查一下订单」。

examples.en: The adviser said, “Let me check your order,” before asking when I bought it.
examples.zh: 客服说「我帮你查一下订单」，然后问我是什么时候买的。

collocations: “Let me check your order against the receipt”

words.enDefinition: a warranty described as lasting for a lifetime defined by its terms

examples.en: I checked what lifetime warranty meant in the booklet for my new backpack.
examples.zh: 我查看了新背包手册，想知道里面的「终身保修」是什么意思。

examples.en: The brand's lifetime warranty page explained whether lifetime referred to the product or its owner.
examples.zh: 品牌的「终身保修」页面说明了这里是指产品的使用寿命还是所有者的寿命。

words.enDefinition: showing only small marks from being used or worn

examples.en: The seller described the trainers as lightly worn and photographed both soles.
examples.zh: 卖家说运动鞋「有轻微磨损」，并拍了两只鞋的鞋底。

examples.en: I found a lightly worn denim jacket that was just my size.
examples.zh: 我找到一件「有轻微磨损」的牛仔夹克，正好合身。

words.enDefinition: A comparison using items or offers matched for relevant features and conditions.

examples.en: A like-for-like comparison was possible once I found two pens with the same number of refills.
examples.zh: 找到两支附带相同数量替芯的笔后，我才能「按同等条件比较」。

examples.en: We checked the delivery terms before making a like-for-like comparison of the two desk chairs.
examples.zh: 我们先核对配送条件，再对两把书桌椅「按同等条件比较」。

collocations: a like-for-like comparison of two offers

words.enDefinition: in a condition that closely resembles a new item

examples.en: The seller listed the desk lamp as like new after barely using it.
examples.zh: 卖家几乎没用过这盏台灯，标注为「成色如新」。

examples.en: The textbook looks like new apart from the name written inside the cover.
examples.zh: 除了封面内侧写了名字，这本课本看起来「成色如新」。

words.enDefinition: A small quantity remaining available to order.

examples.en: A limited stock notice appeared beside the gray chair after I selected the seat color.
examples.zh: 我选好座椅颜色后，灰色椅子旁出现了「库存有限」的提示。

examples.en: The store had limited stock of the narrower lamp, which fit my side table.
examples.zh: 能放在我边桌上的窄款台灯，店里「库存有限」。

words.enDefinition: A deal available only for a stated or brief period.

examples.en: I checked the closing time of the limited-time offer before choosing notebooks for the project.
examples.zh: 为项目选笔记本前，我查看了「限时优惠」的结束时间。

examples.en: The shop described the lamp bundle as a limited-time offer in its email this morning.
examples.zh: 店铺在今天上午的邮件中将台灯组合标成「限时优惠」。

words.enDefinition: a warranty that restricts its coverage or remedies in specified ways

examples.en: The limited warranty covered the main unit but listed separate conditions for the cable.
examples.zh: 「有限保修」涵盖主机，不过线缆另有条款。

examples.en: I read the limited warranty to see how long the replacement keyboard was covered.
examples.zh: 我看了「有限保修」，想知道替换键盘能保修多久。

words.enDefinition: to associate a rewards card with an account or app

examples.en: The cashier explained how to link a loyalty card when I replaced my phone.
examples.zh: 我换手机时，收银员解释了如何「绑定积分卡」。

examples.en: The app asked if I wanted to link a loyalty card before the checkout page.
examples.zh: 应用进入结账页前，问我是否要「绑定积分卡」。

collocations: link a loyalty card to an account
choose to link a loyalty card
prompt to link a loyalty card

words.enDefinition: damage due to contact with water or another liquid

examples.en: The report recorded liquid damage after the technician inspected the keyboard and its connectors.
examples.zh: 维修人员检查键盘和接口后，报告记录了「液体造成的损坏」。

examples.en: I asked whether the estimate for liquid damage included the cost of a new keyboard.
examples.zh: 我问处理「液体造成的损坏」的报价里包不包含新键盘的费用。

words.enDefinition: to publish an advertisement offering something to buyers

examples.en: I have two extra chairs to list for sale in our student group.
examples.zh: 我有两把多余的椅子，想在学生群里「挂出出售」。

examples.en: Which books from last semester do you still have to list for sale?
examples.zh: 你上学期还有哪些课本要「挂出出售」？

words.enDefinition: advertised as new rather than used in a product listing

examples.en: The jacket was listed as new, but the cuffs were already worn.
examples.zh: 那件夹克「标为全新」，袖口却已经磨旧了。

examples.en: I sent a screenshot showing that the lamp had been listed as new.
examples.zh: 我发了张截图，显示那盏台灯曾「标为全新」。

collocations: listed as new on the website
something listed as new but opened

words.enDefinition: a saved image showing what the product listing displayed

examples.en: My listing screenshot showed that the cable was included at the time.
examples.zh: 我的「商品页面截图」显示，那时电线是随商品附送的。

examples.en: I attached the listing screenshot so staff could compare it with the receipt.
examples.zh: 我附上「商品页面截图」，让工作人员和收据对照。

words.enDefinition: a real staff member available through a support channel

examples.en: A live agent joined the chat after I gave the order number.
examples.zh: 我提供订单号后，一名「人工客服」接入了聊天。

examples.en: The pop-up said no live agent was available until the following morning.
examples.zh: 弹窗提示，要到第二天早上才有「人工客服」。

collocations: a live agent joins the chat

words.enDefinition: an online exchange with a staff member in real time

examples.en: I used live chat to ask about a parcel during my lunch break.
examples.zh: 我趁午休用「在线人工聊天」问了一下包裹的情况。

examples.en: The website offered live chat after I chose a topic on the help page.
examples.zh: 我在帮助页面选好主题后，网站提供了「在线人工聊天」。

collocations: speak to someone through live chat

words.enDefinition: a temporary device provided while someone's own equipment is being repaired

examples.en: The repair centre offered a loaner device so I could finish my coursework.
examples.zh: 维修中心提供了「临时借用设备」，这样我还能完成课程作业。

examples.en: I returned the loaner device when my repaired computer was ready on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五自己的电脑修好后，我归还了「临时借用设备」。

words.enDefinition: to search a system for a person's membership details

examples.en: The clerk offered to look up a membership using my registered phone number.
examples.zh: 店员提出可以用我登记的手机号码「查找会员记录」。

examples.en: Could you look up a membership if I've left the loyalty card at home?
examples.zh: 如果我把积分卡落在家里了，你能「查找会员记录」吗？

collocations: look up a membership by name
look up a membership by phone number
ask staff to look up a membership

words.enDefinition: to find the record of my existing support request

examples.en: Could you look up my case using the reference in this email?
examples.zh: 你能用这封邮件里的编号「查一下我的工单」吗？

examples.en: I asked the adviser to look up my case from the previous week.
examples.zh: 我请客服「查一下我上周的工单」。

collocations: ask someone to look up my case
use this reference to look up my case
can you look up my case

words.enDefinition: having more room than wanted around the waist

examples.en: The trousers were loose around the waist even with my usual belt.
examples.zh: 这条裤子就算系上我平时用的皮带也「腰部偏松」。

examples.en: I showed my friend how loose around the waist the skirt was.
examples.zh: 我给朋友看了看这条裙子「腰部有多松」。

words.enDefinition: a book spine or fastening that no longer holds pages tightly

examples.en: The seller mentioned a loose binding and sent photos of the book's spine.
examples.zh: 卖家说这本书「装订松动」，并发来了书脊的照片。

examples.en: I could feel the loose binding when I opened the old cookbook fully.
examples.zh: 我把那本旧菜谱完全摊开时，感觉到它「装订松动」。

words.enDefinition: thread that has started to come away along a seam

examples.en: The coat's description mentioned loose stitching just below the left pocket.
examples.zh: 外套的描述写着，左侧口袋下方有「松脱的缝线」。

examples.en: I found some loose stitching near the zip when I inspected the backpack.
examples.zh: 我检查背包时，在拉链附近看到了「松脱的缝线」。

words.enDefinition: a proposed price far below what the seller expects

examples.en: The seller ignored the lowball offer and answered my question about the case.
examples.zh: 卖家没理会那个「过低的出价」，回复了我关于盒子的问题。

examples.en: I thought it was a lowball offer for a bike in such good condition.
examples.zh: 这辆自行车成色这么好，我觉得那是个「过低的出价」。

words.enDefinition: The minimum price shown in the previous thirty days for an item.
acceptedEnVariants: lowest price in the last 30 days

examples.en: The product page showed the lowest price in 30 days beneath the current selling price.
examples.zh: 商品页在当前售价下方显示了「近30天最低价」。

examples.en: I compared the sale price with the lowest price in 30 days on the chart.
examples.zh: 我把促销价跟图表上的「近30天最低价」作了比较。

collocations: show the lowest price in 30 days
a label stating lowest price in 30 days
compare with the lowest price in 30 days

words.enDefinition: a personal account holding a shopper's rewards and programme information

examples.en: The cashier couldn't find my loyalty account until I gave my old email address.
examples.zh: 我报出旧邮箱后，收银员才找到我的「会员奖励账户」。

examples.en: I checked my loyalty account after buying the headphones at a participating store.
examples.zh: 我在参与活动的商店买完耳机后，查看了「会员奖励账户」。

collocations: sign in to a loyalty account

words.enDefinition: a card that identifies a shopper for a rewards scheme

examples.en: My loyalty card was still in the pocket of the coat I wore yesterday.
examples.zh: 我的「积分卡」还在昨天穿的外套口袋里。

examples.en: The cashier asked for my loyalty card before putting the shopping through the till.
examples.zh: 收银员在收银机上录入商品前，找我要了「积分卡」。

words.enDefinition: units earned for purchases or other activity in a rewards programme

examples.en: I checked my loyalty points before choosing which branch to visit after class.
examples.zh: 决定下课后去哪家门店前，我查了「会员积分」。

examples.en: The retailer let me exchange loyalty points for cinema vouchers in the app.
examples.zh: 零售商允许我在应用中用「会员积分」兑换电影券。

words.enDefinition: a system that gives shoppers benefits for returning to a retailer

examples.en: I joined the loyalty programme because I bought groceries there every weekend.
examples.zh: 我每周末都去那家店买菜，于是加入了「会员奖励计划」。

examples.en: The loyalty programme let us earn points at both shops near the residence.
examples.zh: 通过这项「会员奖励计划」，我们在宿舍附近的两家店都能赚积分。

words.enDefinition: Produced after a customer orders it instead of being stocked in advance.

examples.en: The print was made to order, so the seller gave a separate estimate for preparation.
examples.zh: 那幅印刷画是「按订单制作」的，所以卖家单独给了预计备货时间。

examples.en: I chose a folder made to order with my initials printed below the class name.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「按订单制作」的文件夹，能在班级名称下方印姓名缩写。

words.enDefinition: A repayment a buyer can claim by sending the required materials through the post.

examples.en: The label mentioned a mail-in rebate, so I read the conditions for claiming it.
examples.zh: 标签上提到了「邮寄申请返款」，所以我读了申领条件。

examples.en: I compared the price of the headphones with and without the advertised mail-in rebate.
examples.zh: 我分别比较了把广告上的「邮寄申请返款」算进去和不算进去时的耳机价格。

words.enDefinition: repair service arranged by sending the item to a service centre by mail

examples.en: The shop offered a mail-in repair because the authorized centre was in another city.
examples.zh: 授权维修中心在另一座城市，所以店里提供「邮寄送修」选项。

examples.en: I checked what to include with a mail-in repair before packing the laptop carefully.
examples.zh: 把笔记本电脑仔细装好前，我查看了「邮寄送修」需要随附哪些东西。

words.enDefinition: a return made by sending the item to the seller through a mail service

examples.en: The store offered a mail-in return because its nearest branch was across town.
examples.zh: 最近的门店在城郊另一头，商店提供了「邮寄退货」选项。

examples.en: I chose a mail-in return and checked which documents belonged inside the parcel.
examples.zh: 我选择了「邮寄退货」，随后确认哪些文件要放进包裹。

words.enDefinition: to meet the continuing requirements to keep your membership level

examples.en: The statement showed how many points you need to maintain your status next year.
examples.zh: 结算单显示，明年要「保住当前会员等级」需要多少积分。

examples.en: Could you maintain your status if you took a semester off and rarely shopped there?
examples.zh: 如果你休学一学期，很少去那儿买东西，还能「保住当前会员等级」吗？

collocations: spend enough to maintain your status
earn points to maintain your status

words.enDefinition: a code marked on a product showing when it was made

examples.en: The product notice told me where to find the manufacture date code on the lamp.
examples.zh: 产品通知告诉我在台灯的什么位置可以找到「生产日期编码」。

examples.en: The technician checked the manufacture date code before ordering a part for my mixer.
examples.zh: 维修人员核对了「生产日期编码」，才为我的搅拌机订购零件。

words.enDefinition: a part the product maker has accepted as suitable for use in a repair

examples.en: The service center ordered a manufacturer-approved part after checking the laptop's model number.
examples.zh: 维修中心核对笔记本电脑的型号后，订购了「厂商认可部件」。

examples.en: The estimate said a manufacturer-approved part would be used for the damaged connector.
examples.zh: 报价注明，损坏的接口会使用「厂商认可部件」来更换。

words.enDefinition: a written or stated promise from the maker about covering specified product problems

examples.en: The manufacturer's warranty came in the box alongside a small instruction booklet.
examples.zh: 「厂商保修」说明和一本小指南一起装在盒子里。

examples.en: I asked whether the manufacturer's warranty applied to the battery as well as the screen.
examples.zh: 我问「厂商保修」是否同时涵盖电池和屏幕。

words.enDefinition: help or advice provided by the maker of a product

examples.en: I contacted manufacturer support when the store could not identify the correct replacement cable.
examples.zh: 商店无法辨认合适的替换线缆时，我联系了「厂商技术支持」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed a separate email address for manufacturer support on its last page.
examples.zh: 宣传单最后一页另列了一个「厂商技术支持」的电子邮件地址。

words.enDefinition: a fault introduced during the manufacture or assembly of an item

examples.en: The customer service team suspected a manufacturing defect in the loose hinge on my laptop.
examples.zh: 客服团队怀疑，我笔记本电脑的铰链松动属于「制造缺陷」。

examples.en: The report separated a manufacturing defect from damage to the box during shipping.
examples.zh: 报告把「制造缺陷」和运输途中外箱损坏分开记录。

words.enDefinition: to show in a listing that someone has bought the item

examples.en: I marked my desk as sold but forgot to mark as sold the chair.
examples.zh: 我把书桌标为已售了，却忘了把椅子也「标为已售」。

examples.en: The group asks sellers to mark as sold any listings for items already collected.
examples.zh: 群里请卖家把商品已被取走的帖子「标为已售」。

collocations: mark as sold in the app

words.enDefinition: Describes an item whose seller has reduced the previous price.

examples.en: The plain notebooks had been marked down by the time I returned from my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 我下午听完课回来时，素面笔记本已经「调低了售价」。

examples.en: The shelf label showed which colors of the same pencil case had been marked down.
examples.zh: 货架标签显示，同款笔袋中哪些颜色「已调低售价」。

collocations: marked down from the original price

words.enDefinition: a set of items that go together in design or intended use

examples.en: The seller offered a matched set of shelves from the same student flat.
examples.zh: 卖家出售一套「配套的置物架」，都是同一间学生公寓里用过的。

examples.en: I bought the plates as a matched set from the campus swap meet.
examples.zh: 我在校园交换集市买了一组「配套的盘子」。

words.enDefinition: Information naming the materials an item is made from, often with percentages.

examples.en: The material composition showed that the pencil pouch was made mostly from recycled fabric.
examples.zh: 「材料成分」说明这个笔袋主要由再生面料制成。

examples.en: I checked the material composition because I wanted a notebook cover I could wipe clean.
examples.zh: 我想买一款能擦干净的笔记本封套，所以查看了「材料成分」。

words.enDefinition: a fault in the material used to make a product or component

examples.en: The repair shop traced the cracking handle to a material defect in the plastic.
examples.zh: 维修店查明，把手开裂是塑料的「材料缺陷」造成的。

examples.en: The manufacturer sent a report describing the material defect found under the outer layer.
examples.zh: 厂商发来报告，说明了外层下面发现的「材料缺陷」。

words.enDefinition: A surface treatment that gives an item little or no shine.

examples.en: I chose the notebook with a matte finish because I preferred how it looked.
examples.zh: 我选了「哑光表面」的笔记本，因为我更喜欢它的外观。

examples.en: The photo of the desk tray showed its matte finish clearly in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 桌面托盘的照片在太阳光下清楚地展示了它的「哑光表面」。

collocations: a cover with a matte finish

words.enDefinition: to meet somewhere roughly between two people's starting places

examples.en: Would you be willing to meet halfway so neither of us needs the bus?
examples.zh: 你愿意「各走一半路碰面」吗？这样我们谁都不用坐公交。

examples.en: The seller offered to meet halfway because we lived on opposite sides of campus.
examples.zh: 我们住在校园两头，所以卖家提议「各走一半路碰面」。

words.enDefinition: to see one another physically in the same place

examples.en: We decided to meet in person once we both finished our afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 我们决定等两个人都上完下午的课，再「当面碰面」交接东西。

examples.en: Would you rather meet in person to exchange the books on Friday afternoon?
examples.zh: 你想周五下午「当面碰面」交换那几本书吗？

collocations: meet in person to exchange items

words.enDefinition: a scannable code identifying a customer as a programme member

examples.en: My phone screen dimmed while the cashier was scanning the member barcode at checkout.
examples.zh: 收银员结账时扫「会员条码」，我的手机屏幕变暗了。

examples.en: The app displayed the member barcode beneath my name on the account page.
examples.zh: 应用在账户页我的名字下方显示了「会员条码」。

words.enDefinition: messages a programme sends to its members about the account or benefits

examples.en: The shop moved updates about points expiry into member communications in the app.
examples.zh: 商店把积分到期消息移到了应用里「发送给会员的通知」栏目。

examples.en: I looked at member communications for the date of the next preview event.
examples.zh: 我看了「发送给会员的通知」，查找下一次预览活动的日期。

words.enDefinition: a promotion available only to members of a programme

examples.en: The email showed a member-exclusive offer for the new line of backpacks.
examples.zh: 邮件显示，新款背包有一项「会员专属优惠」。

examples.en: I missed the member-exclusive offer because I opened the message after the deadline.
examples.zh: 我在截止日期后才打开消息，错过了「会员专属优惠」。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled delivery time reserved for customers in a programme

examples.en: I booked a member-only delivery slot because I had a late class that evening.
examples.zh: 当晚有晚课，我预约了一个「会员专用配送时段」。

examples.en: The app offered a member-only delivery slot near the end of the afternoon.
examples.zh: 应用提供了一个接近傍晚的「会员专用配送时段」。

words.enDefinition: extra advantages available because someone belongs to a membership programme

examples.en: I used one of the member perks to book a delivery time after class.
examples.zh: 我用了其中一项「会员专属福利」，预约下课后的配送时段。

examples.en: The member perks included early access to the new products at our branch.
examples.zh: 「会员专属福利」包括可以提前买到我们门店的新商品。
