words.enDefinition: an opportunity for members to see products before the wider public

examples.en: The clothing store sent a member preview of its new collection on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 服装店周三发来了新系列的「会员提前预览」。

examples.en: I saved the shoes from the member preview to look at again later.
examples.zh: 我把「会员提前预览」里看到的鞋收藏起来，打算以后再看。

words.enDefinition: the contact details and preferences saved for a participant in a programme

examples.en: I changed the address in my member profile after moving into the new flat.
examples.zh: 搬进新公寓后，我改了「会员资料」里的地址。

examples.en: The cashier checked the phone number in my member profile during the enquiry.
examples.zh: 查询时，收银员核对了「会员资料」里的电话号码。

words.enDefinition: an event that only people belonging to a particular programme can attend

examples.en: The shop held a members-only event before its new collection went on sale.
examples.zh: 新系列正式开卖前，商店举行了一场「会员专场活动」。

examples.en: I signed up for the members-only event because it was near the library.
examples.zh: 那场「会员专场活动」在图书馆附近，我就报名了。

words.enDefinition: a label introducing the date when membership stops being active

examples.en: The account page read membership ends on June first after I turned off renewal.
examples.zh: 我关闭续费后，账户页面显示「会员资格结束于」六月一日。

examples.en: I copied the date after membership ends on into my notes about the plan.
examples.zh: 我把「会员资格结束于」后面的日期抄进了记录方案的笔记。

collocations: membership ends on the stated date

words.enDefinition: products or situations to which membership benefits do not apply

examples.en: I looked at the membership exclusions before ordering a rechargeable battery for class.
examples.zh: 给课堂买充电电池前，我查看了「会员福利除外项」。

examples.en: The help page listed membership exclusions separately from the rules for earning points.
examples.zh: 帮助页把「会员福利除外项」与攒积分的规则分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the amount charged for belonging to a membership programme

examples.en: I split the membership fee with my sister when we signed up together.
examples.zh: 我和姐姐一起注册时，平摊了「会员费」。

examples.en: The membership fee was due in the same week as our first grocery order.
examples.zh: 「会员费」与我们第一笔杂货订单在同一周到期。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying an individual membership record

examples.en: The support adviser asked me to read out my membership number over the phone.
examples.zh: 客服请我在电话里念出「会员编号」。

examples.en: I found the membership number above my name on the welcome email from the shop.
examples.zh: 我在商店发来的欢迎邮件里，在名字上方找到了「会员编号」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing membership is temporarily inactive pending a decision or change

examples.en: The membership office left my membership on hold while I sent updated university details.
examples.zh: 我提交更新的学校资料期间，会员办公室把我的「会员资格暂时搁置」。

examples.en: My account said membership on hold after the shop requested a new verification letter.
examples.zh: 商店要求提供新的核验函后，我的账户显示「会员资格暂时搁置」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a member has asked to suspend their benefits temporarily

examples.en: My account showed “Membership paused” after I requested a break during my exchange.
examples.zh: 我申请在交换学习期间暂停会员后，账户显示「会员已暂停」。

examples.en: I checked the membership paused notice after changing my travel plans for the summer.
examples.zh: 暑期出行计划变了以后，我查看了「会员已暂停」的通知。

words.enDefinition: a message sent before a membership is due to be renewed

examples.en: The membership renewal reminder arrived the week before I was due to leave campus.
examples.zh: 我预定离校的前一周，收到了「会员续费提醒」。

examples.en: I opened the membership renewal reminder to check which plan I had selected.
examples.zh: 我打开「会员续费提醒」，核对选择的是哪个方案。

words.enDefinition: the current standing of a membership, such as active or expired

examples.en: My membership status still showed as active after the payment deadline had passed.
examples.zh: 付款截止日过去后，我的「会员状态」仍显示有效。

examples.en: The cashier checked my membership status before applying the student offer to the order.
examples.zh: 收银员查看了我的「会员状态」，才在订单上应用学生优惠。

words.enDefinition: the period of time covered by a particular membership

examples.en: I checked how much time was left in my membership term after changing plans.
examples.zh: 更换方案后，我查看「会员有效期」还剩多久。

examples.en: The membership term ended during the week we were moving into our new flat.
examples.zh: 我们搬进新公寓的那一周，「会员有效期」结束了。

words.enDefinition: a level within a membership programme with its own benefits or requirements

examples.en: The app showed my membership tier beside the points needed for the next level.
examples.zh: 应用在「会员等级」旁显示了升到下一级还需多少积分。

examples.en: I checked which membership tier included free delivery for large orders to campus.
examples.zh: 我查了哪个「会员等级」包含大订单校园免费配送。

words.enDefinition: a change to a higher membership level or a plan with more benefits

examples.en: The membership upgrade took effect just before I placed my first large order.
examples.zh: 我下第一笔大订单前不久，「会员升级」生效了。

examples.en: The cashier explained what a membership upgrade would change on my shared account.
examples.zh: 收银员说明了「会员升级」会给我的共享账户带来哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: a voucher that can be exchanged for a membership or membership period

examples.en: I entered the membership voucher from the welcome pack after creating a shopping account.
examples.zh: 创建购物账户后，我输入了迎新材料里的「会员兑换券」号码。

examples.en: The membership voucher covered my first term but needed to be used before October.
examples.zh: 「会员兑换券」覆盖我的第一个学期，但必须在十月前使用。

words.enDefinition: the twelve-month period used to count activity or benefits on a membership

examples.en: The membership year began when I joined the programme in the middle of term.
examples.zh: 我在学期过半时加入计划，「会员年度」就从那时开始。

examples.en: I checked whether last week's order counted towards the new membership year or the old one.
examples.zh: 我确认了上周的订单算在新的「会员年度」还是上一个。

words.enDefinition: the area of a store that sells men's clothing

examples.en: The menswear department was on the same floor as the fitting rooms.
examples.zh: 「男装部」和试衣间在同一层。

examples.en: I asked the staff in the menswear department where to find interview clothes.
examples.zh: 我问「男装部」的店员到哪里找面试穿的衣服。

words.enDefinition: to combine separate accounts for the same rewards programme into one account

examples.en: I asked the shop whether it could merge loyalty accounts created under two emails.
examples.zh: 我问商店能否「合并用两个邮箱开的会员积分账户」。

examples.en: The help page explained which points would transfer when staff merge loyalty accounts.
examples.zh: 帮助页说明了工作人员「合并会员积分账户」时，哪些积分会跟着转移。

words.enDefinition: messages previously exchanged in a conversation or account

examples.en: I checked the message history to see whether the seller had replied yesterday.
examples.zh: 我查看了「历史消息记录」，想知道卖家昨天有没有回复。

examples.en: The staff member could only see the message history for this order.
examples.zh: 工作人员只能看到这笔订单的「历史消息记录」。

collocations: a reply in the message history

words.enDefinition: the smallest number of points allowed in a transfer between accounts

examples.en: I checked the minimum points per transfer before deciding whether to share my balance.
examples.zh: 决定要不要分享积分余额前，我查看了「每次转移积分的下限」。

examples.en: The form showed the minimum points per transfer below the recipient's membership number.
examples.zh: 表格在收取方会员编号下方标明了「每次转移积分的下限」。

collocations: check the minimum points per transfer
raise the minimum points per transfer
state the minimum points per transfer

words.enDefinition: The smallest number of items needed to order something or qualify for an offer.

examples.en: The minimum quantity was three folders, so I asked if my classmates needed extras.
examples.zh: 「最低购买数量」是三个文件夹，所以我问同学还要不要多买几个。

examples.en: I checked the minimum quantity before choosing the smaller notebook design for our team.
examples.zh: 为小组选小号笔记本款式前，我查看了「最低购买数量」。

words.enDefinition: screws or other fittings needed for assembly that are absent

examples.en: The listing mentioned missing hardware, including the screws that attach the legs.
examples.zh: 商品页注明「缺少安装五金」，包括用来固定桌腿的螺丝。

examples.en: I asked the seller to list any missing hardware before reserving the shelf.
examples.zh: 我在预留搁架前，请卖家列出「缺少的安装五金」。

words.enDefinition: pages that are absent from a book or printed document

examples.en: I checked for missing pages while looking through the atlas at the stall.
examples.zh: 我在摊位翻看地图册时，检查了有没有「缺页」。

examples.en: The seller mentioned missing pages at the end of the used workbook online.
examples.zh: 卖家在网上注明，那本旧练习册的末尾有「缺页」。

words.enDefinition: pieces expected to come with an item that are not present

examples.en: I took a photo of the box before reporting the missing parts online.
examples.zh: 我先拍了盒子的照片，才在线报告「缺少的零件」。

examples.en: The assembly guide helped me identify which missing parts to mention in my email.
examples.zh: 组装指南让我弄清楚邮件里该说明哪些「缺少的零件」。

words.enDefinition: points expected from eligible activity that have not been credited

examples.en: I reported missing points after the receipt failed to appear in my account.
examples.zh: 收据没有出现在账户里，便提交了「积分未到账」的查询。

examples.en: The adviser asked which purchase was connected to the missing points I had reported.
examples.zh: 客服询问，我报的「未到账积分」对应哪笔消费。

words.enDefinition: without the charger normally expected to come with a device

examples.en: The tablet was missing the charger, so the seller let me test it first.
examples.zh: 那台平板「没有附充电器」，于是卖家先让我试用。

examples.en: I told my flatmate the camera was missing the charger before we collected it.
examples.zh: 去取相机前，我告诉室友，那台相机「没有附充电器」。

collocations: check if it's missing the charger

words.enDefinition: use of a product in a way it was not designed or intended for

examples.en: The warranty booklet gave examples of misuse under the heading about excluded damage.
examples.zh: 保修手册在除外损坏一节中列举了「不当使用」的例子。

examples.en: The technician asked how the appliance had been used before deciding whether there was misuse.
examples.zh: 维修人员询问了电器的使用情况，再判断是否有「不当使用」。

words.enDefinition: A code that identifies one design or version of a product.

examples.en: I copied the model number from the bottom of my keyboard before shopping for parts.
examples.zh: 我在买配件前抄下了键盘底部的「型号」。

examples.en: The product page listed the model number beside the photo of the charger I needed.
examples.zh: 商品页在我需要的充电器照片旁列出了「型号」。

words.enDefinition: A specific amount subtracted from the price of an item or order.

examples.en: The voucher gave me money off my stationery order once it reached the required amount.
examples.zh: 文具订单达到规定金额后，优惠券给了我「定额减免」。

examples.en: I compared the money off that order with the percentage discount from the other shop.
examples.zh: 我把那个订单的「定额减免」和另一家店的按比例折扣作了比较。

collocations: take money off the listed price

words.enDefinition: a membership billed or provided one month at a time

examples.en: I picked a monthly membership while I was living near the shop for summer.
examples.zh: 暑假住在店附近时，我选择了「按月会员」。

examples.en: The monthly membership was a better fit because my exchange ended in June.
examples.zh: 我的交换项目六月份就结束了，「按月会员」更合适。

words.enDefinition: more units of a product expected in the shop soon

examples.en: The assistant said there was more stock coming in later that week.
examples.zh: 店员说那周晚些时候「还有一批货会到」。

examples.en: I asked about more stock coming in before our next club meeting.
examples.zh: 我问下次社团开会前是不是「还有一批货会到」。

collocations: ask about more stock coming in

words.enDefinition: The reviews submitted nearest to the present time.

examples.en: I checked the most recent reviews to see whether anyone mentioned the redesigned pencil case.
examples.zh: 我查看了「最近发布的评价」，想看看有没有人提到改版后的笔袋。

examples.en: The most recent reviews were about the new version with a longer power cord.
examples.zh: 「最近发布的评价」说的都是带较长电源线的新款。

collocations: show the most recent reviews first

words.enDefinition: An offer giving a lower price for buying multiple eligible items together.

examples.en: The multibuy offer made sense because our study group needed six folders of the same size.
examples.zh: 自习小组需要六个同样大小的文件夹，所以用「多买优惠」合适。

examples.en: I read the multibuy offer carefully to learn whether different colors counted toward the deal.
examples.zh: 我仔细看了「多买优惠」，想知道不同颜色能不能算在同一单里。

words.enDefinition: a phrase saying the person speaking has not yet received the money back

examples.en: I wrote, “My refund has not arrived,” in a message to the online seller.
examples.zh: 我给网上卖家留言说：「我的退款还没到账。」

examples.en: My refund has not arrived even though the shop sent a confirmation on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 商店周二就发了确认通知，但「我的退款还没到账」。

collocations: my refund has not arrived yet
my refund has not arrived in my account
tell the seller my refund has not arrived

words.enDefinition: the amount actually returned after any fees or deductions are taken out

examples.en: The net refund was lower than the original amount because the label cost extra.
examples.zh: 标签另收费，所以「实退金额」低于原金额。

examples.en: I compared the net refund with the total shown at the top of the receipt.
examples.zh: 我把「实退金额」与收据顶部显示的总额作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A product recently added to a store's selection.

examples.en: The pen set was a new arrival, so the site displayed it near the top.
examples.zh: 那套笔是「新上架商品」，所以网站把它放在了靠上的位置。

examples.en: I browsed the new arrivals to find a notebook with paper thick enough for markers.
examples.zh: 我浏览了「新上架商品」，想找一本纸张够厚、适合用马克笔的笔记本。

words.enDefinition: A discount offered to shoppers who sign up for or receive a seller's email newsletter.

examples.en: I used a newsletter discount from the email that announced the new stationery range.
examples.zh: 我用了文具上新邮件里的「订阅邮件优惠」。

examples.en: The site advertised a newsletter discount beside the form for signing up to receive emails.
examples.zh: 网站在邮件订阅表单旁宣传「订阅邮件优惠」。

words.enDefinition: a call for the next shopper in line to approach

examples.en: The cashier called, “Next customer, please,” after the previous shopper left.
examples.zh: 前一位顾客走后，收银员喊道「请下一位顾客」。

examples.en: I heard “Next customer, please” from the checkout beside the door.
examples.zh: 我听见门边的收银台传来「请下一位顾客」。

words.enDefinition: A condition stating that the benefit offered cannot be exchanged for money.

examples.en: The voucher stated “No cash alternative” below the picture of the free pencil case.
examples.zh: 优惠券在免费笔袋的图片下方注明了「不可折现」。

examples.en: I noticed “No cash alternative” in the small print under the welcome offer.
examples.zh: 我在新客优惠下的小字里留意到「不可折现」。

collocations: a note saying no cash alternative
an offer marked no cash alternative
a voucher with no cash alternative

words.enDefinition: a label indicating an offer or benefit cannot be used as money itself

examples.en: The voucher said no cash value in small print below the expiry date.
examples.zh: 优惠券在到期日下面用小字写着「无现金价值」。

examples.en: I noticed the words no cash value after I opened the digital reward.
examples.zh: 打开电子奖励后，我注意到有「无现金价值」几个字。

words.enDefinition: an exchange for which the buyer pays no additional amount

examples.en: The shop offered a no-cost exchange after checking the model number on the box.
examples.zh: 店家核对盒子上的型号之后，提出可以「免费换货」。

examples.en: I asked whether a no-cost exchange was possible if the other colour cost more.
examples.zh: 我问，如果另一种颜色更贵，还能不能「免费换货」。

words.enDefinition: a report outcome indicating that inspection detected no identifiable problem

examples.en: The result read no fault found even though the printer stopped again at home.
examples.zh: 检测结果写着「未发现故障」，但打印机回到家后又停了。

examples.en: I kept the no fault found report with the notes from the second inspection.
examples.zh: 我把「未发现故障」的报告与第二次检查的记录放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a service promise saying that no repair fee is due if the problem is not fixed

examples.en: The shop window advertised no fix no fee for repairs of certain models.
examples.zh: 店面橱窗写着，某些型号的维修「修不好不收费」。

examples.en: I asked what no fix no fee covered before leaving the speaker at the desk.
examples.zh: 把音箱留在柜台前，我问了「修不好不收费」包括哪些费用。

collocations: a no fix no fee policy

words.enDefinition: a label meaning the customer no longer has a use for the item

examples.en: I selected no longer needed because my department lent me a monitor for the term.
examples.zh: 系里已经借给我一台显示器供本学期使用，所以我选了「不再需要」。

examples.en: The options listed no longer needed separately from reasons relating to damage or defects.
examples.zh: 选项把「不再需要」和损坏或故障等原因分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a calculation leaves no amount to be refunded

examples.en: The statement showed “No refund due” because I had paid nothing for the sample.
examples.zh: 那份账单显示「没有应退款项」，因为这件样品原本不收费。

examples.en: I asked why the account said “No refund due” for the cancelled item.
examples.zh: 我问账户为什么显示取消的商品「没有应退款项」。

collocations: explain why there is no refund due

words.enDefinition: A message stating that the search produced no matching items.

examples.en: The site displayed “No results found” until I removed a space from the model number.
examples.zh: 我去掉型号中的一个空格之前，网站一直显示「未找到结果」。

examples.en: I saw “No results found” after filtering the selection down to a single color.
examples.zh: 把选项筛到只剩一种颜色后，我看到了「未找到结果」。

collocations: a page saying no results found

words.enDefinition: indicating the seller will not send an item by post or courier

examples.en: The listing said no shipping because the mirror was too bulky to pack.
examples.zh: 镜子太大，不好打包，所以商品页写着「不提供邮寄」。

examples.en: I was already nearby when I saw no shipping on the seller's post.
examples.zh: 我看到卖家帖子写着「不提供邮寄」时，人已经在附近了。

words.enDefinition: a buyer who fails to arrive for an arranged meeting

examples.en: The seller put the plant stand back up after a no-show buyer.
examples.zh: 有位「买家爽约」后，卖家重新挂出了花架。

examples.en: I bought the bike after a no-show buyer missed the morning pickup.
examples.zh: 原本约好上午来取货的「买家爽约」了，后来我买下了那辆自行车。

words.enDefinition: a part not made or supplied as an original component by the product manufacturer

examples.en: The independent shop explained why it had fitted a non-genuine part in the printer.
examples.zh: 独立维修店解释了为什么在打印机里装了「非原厂部件」。

examples.en: I asked whether the estimate named the maker of the non-genuine part being offered.
examples.zh: 我问报价里有没有写所提供的「非原厂部件」由谁制造。

words.enDefinition: a shipping fee identified as excluded from the refund

examples.en: The quote listed nonrefundable shipping separately from the main price of the purchase.
examples.zh: 报价中把「不能退回的运费」和商品价格分开列出。

examples.en: I asked why the email included nonrefundable shipping when the seller sent the wrong model.
examples.zh: 我问卖家发错型号，为什么邮件还写有「不能退回的运费」。

words.enDefinition: marked or treated as ineligible for ordinary returns

examples.en: The retailer described the personalised notebook as nonreturnable on the order page.
examples.zh: 零售商在订单页面上注明，这本定制笔记本「不接受退货」。

examples.en: An accessory was marked nonreturnable even though the main purchase could go back.
examples.zh: 其中一件配件标注为「不接受退货」，同单的主商品则可以退回。

words.enDefinition: excluded from the protection provided by the warranty

examples.en: The message said the damaged cable was not covered under warranty for this product.
examples.zh: 消息说，该产品损坏的线缆「不在保修范围内」。

examples.en: The service team listed the repairs not covered under warranty on a separate page.
examples.zh: 服务团队另用一页列出了「不在保修范围内」的维修。

words.enDefinition: not meeting the requirements to receive help under a buyer program

examples.en: The app said the purchase was not eligible for buyer protection but gave no explanation.
examples.zh: 应用说这笔交易「不符合买家保障条件」，但没说明原因。

examples.en: I asked why the item was marked not eligible for buyer protection.
examples.zh: 我问为什么这件商品被标成「不符合买家保障条件」。

collocations: marked not eligible for buyer protection
an order not eligible for buyer protection
a purchase listed as not eligible for buyer protection

words.enDefinition: A condition excluding products already reduced in price from a separate offer.

examples.en: The coupon was marked “Not valid on sale items” below the store's name.
examples.zh: 优惠券在店名下方注明「不适用于打折商品」。

examples.en: I read “Not valid on sale items” before trying the code on a discounted lamp.
examples.zh: 我准备给打折台灯用优惠码时，看到了「不适用于打折商品」。

collocations: a voucher marked not valid on sale items
a code that is not valid on sale items
read not valid on sale items

words.enDefinition: An interface option to request a message when an item becomes available.

examples.en: I selected “Notify me when available” for the blue folder rather than choosing another color.
examples.zh: 我给蓝色文件夹选了「到货时通知我」，没有换其他颜色。

examples.en: The page displayed “Notify me when available” next to the campus planner I had chosen.
examples.zh: 页面在我选好的校园手账旁显示「到货时通知我」。

collocations: a notify me when available button
a link marked notify me when available

words.enDefinition: a status showing someone agreed to the proposed price

examples.en: The app showed offer accepted before the seller contacted me about pickup.
examples.zh: 卖家联系我约取货之前，应用已经显示「出价已接受」。

examples.en: I received an offer accepted notification just before our morning language class.
examples.zh: 上午的语言课快开始时，我收到一条「出价已接受」的通知。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that someone turned down a proposed price

examples.en: The notification read offer declined after I suggested a price for the bike.
examples.zh: 我给自行车提出购买价后，通知显示「出价被拒」。

examples.en: I saw offer declined on the listing before I could arrange a viewing.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及约看，就在商品页上看到了「出价被拒」。

collocations: notification that an offer was declined

words.enDefinition: a status showing a price proposal is no longer active

examples.en: The screen showed offer expired when I opened the message after my lecture.
examples.zh: 上完课打开消息时，屏幕显示「出价已过期」。

examples.en: I saw offer expired beside my offer on the small dining table.
examples.zh: 我在小餐桌的出价旁看到了「出价已过期」。

words.enDefinition: indicating that a seller is willing to consider proposed prices

examples.en: I noticed offers considered underneath the asking price for the old guitar.
examples.zh: 我在旧吉他的标价下面看到了「愿意考虑买家出价」。

examples.en: The advert said offers considered, so my roommate sent the seller a message.
examples.zh: 广告写着「愿意考虑买家出价」，于是室友给卖家发了消息。

collocations: offers considered on the whole set

words.enDefinition: A shop operated by a brand or someone it has authorized to represent it.

examples.en: I opened the official store to see which refills would fit my favorite pen.
examples.zh: 我打开「官方店铺」，想看看哪些替芯适合我最喜欢的那支笔。

examples.en: The official store listed the replacement pieces individually, which was helpful for our dorm room.
examples.zh: 「官方店铺」单独出售每个配件，这对我们宿舍来说很方便。

words.enDefinition: shown for customers to look at rather than offered for sale

examples.en: The small sign said the red coffee maker was on display only.
examples.zh: 小标牌写着，红色咖啡机「仅供展示」。

examples.en: I asked about the chairs marked on display only near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我问了入口旁标着「仅供展示」的那几把椅子。

words.enDefinition: work carried out by a technician at the customer's location

examples.en: I asked about on-site service because the printer was attached to a large desk.
examples.zh: 打印机固定在大桌子上，所以我咨询了「上门维修服务」。

examples.en: The company arranged on-site service for the shared washing machine in the residence.
examples.zh: 公司为宿舍共用洗衣机安排了「上门维修服务」。

words.enDefinition: A rule allowing only one coupon on each order.

examples.en: The checkout said “One coupon per order” just below the box for entering a code.
examples.zh: 结算页面的优惠码输入框正下方写着「每单限用一张优惠券」。

examples.en: My roommate noticed “One coupon per order” before trying to use our second voucher.
examples.zh: 室友准备使用第二张券之前，看到了「每单限用一张优惠券」。

collocations: a rule saying one coupon per order
limit shoppers to one coupon per order

words.enDefinition: an item has had only one owner since it was new

examples.en: The advert said one owner from new and showed the bike's original shop receipt.
examples.zh: 广告写着那辆车「只有一任物主」，并展示了店铺原始收据。

examples.en: I saw one owner from new in the advert for the used guitar amplifier.
examples.zh: 我在二手吉他音箱的广告上看到了「只有一任物主」。

collocations: listed as one owner from new
described as one owner from new
bike with one owner from new

words.enDefinition: A label indicating that an item is offered in just one standard size.

examples.en: The rain cover came in one size, and the page listed its exact measurements below.
examples.zh: 那款防雨罩只有「均码」，页面在下方列出了具体尺寸。

examples.en: The pouch was marked one size instead of offering separate small and large versions online.
examples.zh: 那款小包网上标的是「均码」，没有单独的小号和大号可选。

words.enDefinition: an exception an organization agrees to for one particular situation

examples.en: The supervisor said the extra delivery would be a one-time exception for my order.
examples.zh: 主管说，这笔订单追加一次配送是「仅此一次的例外」。

examples.en: The adviser offered a one-time exception after checking the earlier messages.
examples.zh: 客服翻看之前的消息后，提出可以作「仅此一次的例外」处理。

words.enDefinition: a benefit that can be earned or used only once

examples.en: The signup email included a one-time reward to use on my next purchase.
examples.zh: 注册邮件附有一项「一次性奖励」，下次购物可以用。

examples.en: I checked the one-time reward before deciding which order to apply it to.
examples.zh: 我查看了「一次性奖励」，才决定把它用在哪一笔订单上。

words.enDefinition: A rule allowing each customer to use an offer on just one occasion.

examples.en: The note said “One use per customer” below the first week of term offer.
examples.zh: 开学第一周的优惠下方写着「每位顾客限用一次」。

examples.en: We read “One use per customer” before deciding who would buy the project supplies.
examples.zh: 我们看到「每位顾客限用一次」，再决定由谁来买项目用品。

collocations: a rule marked one use per customer
limit an offer to one use per customer

words.enDefinition: a sale on the internet where buyers compete by bidding

examples.en: I won the online auction for an old film camera last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚，我在「在线拍卖」中拍到了一台旧胶片相机。

examples.en: The student society held an online auction for donated instruments in June.
examples.zh: 学生社团六月为捐赠来的乐器举办了一次「在线拍卖」。

words.enDefinition: An item available for purchase only through an online shop.

examples.en: The gray desk mat was labeled an online exclusive beside the other colors on the site.
examples.zh: 网站上，灰色桌垫在其他颜色旁标为「线上专供款」。

examples.en: I saved the online exclusive because I could not find the design at the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我在校园商店找不到那个款式，就把这个「线上专供款」收藏了。

words.enDefinition: A website where multiple sellers offer goods to shoppers.

examples.en: An online marketplace showed the same lamp offered by three sellers on one page.
examples.zh: 一家「电商交易平台」在同一页面列出了三个卖家出售的同款台灯。

examples.en: I found replacement inserts for my planner on an online marketplace for stationery enthusiasts.
examples.zh: 我在面向文具爱好者的「电商交易平台」找到了能替换到手账里的内页。

words.enDefinition: a membership whose benefits apply through online channels only

examples.en: I chose an online-only membership because the nearest store was across the city.
examples.zh: 最近的门店在城市另一头，所以我选了「仅限线上使用的会员」。

examples.en: The online-only membership offered delivery benefits rather than discounts at the physical checkout.
examples.zh: 「仅限线上使用的会员」提供送货福利，店内结账没有优惠。

collocations: sign up for an online-only membership

words.enDefinition: An offer available through a website or app and unavailable in the shop itself.

examples.en: The online-only offer appeared on the website but the campus shop still displayed the usual price.
examples.zh: 网站有这项「仅限网上的优惠」，校园店铺仍显示平时的价格。

examples.en: My roommate used an online-only offer for the same notebook she had examined in class.
examples.zh: 室友用了「仅限网上的优惠」买下和她上课时看过的同款笔记本。

words.enDefinition: The amount a seller charges for an item purchased through its website or app.

examples.en: I checked the online price while standing beside the same lamp in the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我在校园店看到同款台灯时，查了它的「线上售价」。

examples.en: The online price was lower for the green folder, although the shelf label showed no reduction.
examples.zh: 绿色文件夹的「线上售价」较低，但货架标签没有显示降价。

collocations: compare the online price with the shelf label

words.enDefinition: The part of a seller's website that shoppers see and buy from.

examples.en: My roommate found the storage boxes through the brand's online storefront during our move.
examples.zh: 我们搬家时，室友在该品牌的「线上店面」找到了那些收纳盒。

examples.en: The campus shop's online storefront showed more notebook designs than the display near the register.
examples.zh: 校园商店的「线上店面」展示的笔记本款式比收银台附近陈列的更多。

words.expression: only the outer box was damaged
words.lemma: only the outer box was damaged
words.enDefinition: a report that the box was damaged but its contents were intact
acceptedEnVariants: only the outer box was damaged

examples.en: Only the outer box was damaged, so I reported that the lamp inside was fine.
examples.zh: 「只有外箱受损」，所以我报告说里面的台灯完好无损。

examples.en: “Only the outer box was damaged,” I wrote after checking each bowl in the set.
examples.zh: 我检查完套装里的每个碗后写道「只有外箱受损」。

collocations: say “Only the outer box was damaged”
“Only the outer box was damaged in transit”
“Only the outer box was damaged as far as I can tell”

words.enDefinition: to begin a formal process for addressing a disputed purchase

examples.en: The platform showed me where to open a dispute about the missing parcel.
examples.zh: 平台给我看了在哪里针对丢失的包裹「发起纠纷申请」。

examples.en: I asked what information the site needed to open a dispute about this purchase.
examples.zh: 我问，要针对这次购物「发起纠纷申请」，网站需要哪些信息。

collocations: open a dispute with the seller
open a dispute through the platform

words.enDefinition: a support request that is still active in the system

examples.en: I added the second photo to my open ticket for the damaged lamp.
examples.zh: 我把第二张照片加到了那盏损坏台灯的「尚未关闭的工单」里。

examples.en: The agent found an open ticket from when I called last week.
examples.zh: 客服找到了我上周打电话时创建的「尚未关闭的工单」。

collocations: an open ticket for the same issue

words.enDefinition: packaging that has been opened even if the product has not been used

examples.en: The clerk looked at the opened box before checking whether all accessories were inside.
examples.zh: 办事员看了看「打开过的包装盒」，才检查配件是否齐全。

examples.en: The opened box still had both protective inserts and the cable ties inside.
examples.zh: 「打开过的包装盒」里还留着两块保护衬垫和扎线带。

words.enDefinition: to actively choose to receive or take part in an offer

examples.en: I opened the member dashboard to opt into an offer before buying the printer.
examples.zh: 买打印机之前，我打开会员页面，「主动参加了一项优惠活动」。

examples.en: The assistant asked if I wanted to opt into an offer for campus delivery.
examples.zh: 关于校园配送，店员问我是否愿意「主动参加优惠活动」。

collocations: choose to opt into an offer
prompt to opt into an offer

words.enDefinition: to choose to stop receiving marketing messages by email

examples.en: I decided to opt out of promotional emails after moving away from the local branch.
examples.zh: 搬离那家门店附近后，我决定「退订促销邮件」。

examples.en: The store let me opt out of promotional emails while keeping my digital receipts.
examples.zh: 商店允许我「退订促销邮件」，电子收据仍照常接收。

collocations: choose to opt out of promotional emails
option to opt out of promotional emails
click to opt out of promotional emails

words.enDefinition: indicating that the seller may accept the best alternative price offered

examples.en: The notice said eighty dollars or best offer for the old kitchen table.
examples.zh: 告示说，旧餐桌要价八十美元，「或接受最合适出价」。

examples.en: I asked what or best offer meant in the listing for the used bike.
examples.zh: 我问那辆旧自行车商品页上的「或接受最合适出价」是什么意思。

collocations: price shown as or best offer

words.enDefinition: To tell an online shop that the order is intended as a gift for someone.

examples.en: The shop let me order as a gift when I bought the notebook for my sister.
examples.zh: 我给姐姐买笔记本时，店铺允许我「按礼品下单」。

examples.en: I chose “Order as a gift” before adding a note for my roommate's graduation.
examples.zh: 我先选择「按礼品下单」，再附上一条祝贺室友毕业的留言。

collocations: choose to order as a gift
an option to order as a gift
a box marked order as a gift

words.enDefinition: the process or result of stopping an order from being fulfilled

examples.en: The order cancellation appeared in my account but the parcel still showed as shipped.
examples.zh: 我的账户里显示了「订单取消」，但包裹状态仍是已发货。

examples.en: I got an order cancellation email after the shop ran out of my size.
examples.zh: 店里没有我的尺码后，我收到了一封「订单取消」邮件。

words.enDefinition: the email address associated with a particular purchase

examples.en: The agent asked for my order email address before looking up the purchase.
examples.zh: 客服先问了我「下单时用的邮箱」，然后才查这笔交易。

examples.en: I had entered my school account as the order email address by mistake.
examples.zh: 我误把学校账号当成了「下单时用的邮箱」。

words.enDefinition: A list of orders previously placed through an account.

examples.en: I found the pen I wanted to buy again by looking through my order history.
examples.zh: 我翻了「历史订单」，找到了想再买一支的笔。

examples.en: My order history showed that I had chosen the smaller size on my previous purchase.
examples.zh: 「历史订单」显示我上次买的是较小的尺寸。

collocations: find an item in your order history

words.enDefinition: finding a purchase record by its details in a system

examples.en: The order lookup showed the desk and the chair as separate purchases.
examples.zh: 「订单查询」显示，书桌和椅子是分开买的。

examples.en: A store associate used order lookup to find the sale in their system.
examples.zh: 一名门店店员用「订单查询」在系统里找到了这笔交易。

collocations: an order lookup by email address

words.enDefinition: Additional information a shopper adds to an order for the seller to read.

examples.en: I wrote in the order notes that the folders were for a classroom project.
examples.zh: 我在「订单备注」里写明，这些文件夹是课堂项目用的。

examples.en: The box for order notes was below the list of colors I had selected.
examples.zh: 「订单备注」输入框在我选好的颜色列表下方。

words.enDefinition: The unique reference used to identify a particular order.

examples.en: I wrote down the order number before closing the tab for the stationery store.
examples.zh: 我记下了「订单编号」，才关掉文具店网站的标签页。

examples.en: The order number appeared beside my name at the top of the confirmation email.
examples.zh: 确认邮件的顶部，我的姓名旁边显示了「订单编号」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying an order has been successfully submitted to the seller.

examples.en: The status changed to “Order placed” after I submitted our request for the binder clips.
examples.zh: 我提交长尾夹订单后，状态改成了「已下单」。

examples.en: I took a screenshot of the page marked “Order placed” for our group's records.
examples.zh: 我给标着「已下单」的页面截了图，留作小组记录。

words.enDefinition: A short overview of the items and details in an order.

examples.en: The order summary listed both colors, although I was expecting to buy only the blue one.
examples.zh: 「订单摘要」列了两种颜色，虽然我原本只想买蓝色的。

examples.en: I checked the order summary carefully to make sure the two folders were the same size.
examples.zh: 我仔细检查「订单摘要」，确认两个文件夹的尺寸一样。

collocations: an item in the order summary

words.enDefinition: a label meaning the customer bought the wrong item by accident

examples.en: The note said ordered by mistake because I'd selected the version for another phone.
examples.zh: 我误选了另一个手机型号对应的版本，于是备注写了「误下单」。

examples.en: I marked it ordered by mistake after seeing two identical orders in my account.
examples.zh: 我看见账户里有两个完全相同的订单后，把这笔标成了「误下单」。

words.enDefinition: the state an item was in when the buyer first received it

examples.en: The seller asked me to return the bag in original condition with both straps.
examples.zh: 卖家请我把包按「原有状态」连同两条包带一起退回。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the book was still in original condition before accepting it.
examples.zh: 店员收下书前，检查了它是否仍保持「原有状态」。

collocations: return an item in original condition

words.enDefinition: parts supplied by the company that originally made the item

examples.en: The bike still had its original parts except for the seat and tyres.
examples.zh: 除了车座和轮胎，那辆自行车还保留着「原厂零件」。

examples.en: I asked whether the old coffee grinder still had its original parts.
examples.zh: 我问那台旧咖啡研磨机是否还装着「原厂零件」。

words.enDefinition: the person who initially bought the item from the retailer

examples.en: The shop contacted the original purchaser before changing the delivery address on the order.
examples.zh: 商店先联系了「原购买人」，才变更订单上的配送地址。

examples.en: The original purchaser received the refund confirmation even though I returned the gift.
examples.zh: 虽然礼物是我退的，退款确认还是发给了「原购买人」。

words.enDefinition: the fee initially paid to ship a purchase to the customer

examples.en: I checked whether the original shipping charge would come back along with the item's price.
examples.zh: 我确认了「原订单运费」是否会随商品价款一起退回。

examples.en: The receipt listed the original shipping charge on the line above the tax.
examples.zh: 收据在税费上一行列出了「原订单运费」。

words.enDefinition: no longer covered because the warranty period has ended

examples.en: My laptop was out of warranty when the screen stopped turning on that week.
examples.zh: 那周屏幕无法点亮时，我的笔记本电脑「已超出保修期」。

examples.en: The shop said the original speaker was out of warranty by a few months.
examples.zh: 店家说原来的音箱已经「过了保修期」几个月。

words.enDefinition: repair work arranged for an item whose warranty has already expired

examples.en: The shop gave me a separate price for an out-of-warranty repair on the old printer.
examples.zh: 店家另报了旧打印机的「过保维修」价格。

examples.en: I compared the out-of-warranty repair with the cost of replacing the device that week.
examples.zh: 我把「过保维修」与那周更换设备的费用做了比较。

words.enDefinition: to offer more than another person in an auction

examples.en: I thought my classmate might outbid me for the used guitar.
examples.zh: 我以为同学竞拍那把旧吉他时可能「出价比我高」。

examples.en: The same bidder managed to outbid me on both camera lenses.
examples.zh: 同一个竞买人在两个相机镜头上的「出价都高于」我。

words.enDefinition: the outer layer that encloses a product or its inner box

examples.en: The adviser asked for a photo of the outer packaging beside the broken jar.
examples.zh: 客服请我拍一张「外包装」和破罐子放在一起的照片。

examples.en: The outer packaging looked fine, but the bottle inside was cracked.
examples.zh: 「外包装」看着没问题，但里面的瓶子裂了。

collocations: a photo of the outer packaging

words.enDefinition: a deliberately large cut intended to look loose on the body

examples.en: I liked the oversized fit until I saw how far the sleeves hung.
examples.zh: 我本来喜欢这种「廓形偏大的版型」，后来发现袖子垂得太长。

examples.en: The sweatshirt had an oversized fit even in my usual size.
examples.zh: 这件卫衣就算买我平时的尺码，也是「廓形偏大的版型」。

words.enDefinition: The external measurements of a package or box rather than the item inside.

examples.en: The package dimensions were much larger than the dimensions of the lamp shown in the listing.
examples.zh: 「包装尺寸」比商品页上那盏台灯本身的尺寸大得多。

examples.en: I checked the package dimensions to see whether the box might fit in my locker.
examples.zh: 我查看了「包装尺寸」，想知道箱子能不能放进储物柜。

words.enDefinition: a mistake in what a warehouse or seller puts in a package

examples.en: The seller traced the extra mug to a packing error at the warehouse.
examples.zh: 卖家查到多出来的马克杯是仓库的「装箱差错」造成的。

examples.en: I thought it was a packing error because both boxes had my name.
examples.zh: 两个箱子都写着我的名字，所以我觉得是「装箱差错」。

words.enDefinition: a document enclosed in a package listing the goods inside

examples.en: I checked the packing slip to see which cable should have been in the box.
examples.zh: 我查看「装箱清单」，确认盒里本来应该有哪条线。

examples.en: The cashier used the packing slip to match the shoes to the online order.
examples.zh: 收银员用「装箱清单」核对了鞋子和网上订单。

words.enDefinition: participation in a programme for which the member pays a fee

examples.en: The paid membership included delivery benefits that I rarely used during the summer.
examples.zh: 「付费会员资格」包含配送福利，不过我暑假很少用。

examples.en: I compared the paid membership with the free plan when my flatmate moved away.
examples.zh: 室友搬走后，我比较了「付费会员资格」和免费方案。

collocations: sign up for a paid membership

words.enDefinition: a bag made of paper for carrying purchases

examples.en: The clerk offered me a paper carrier bag for the notebooks.
examples.zh: 店员提出用「纸质手提袋」给我装笔记本。

examples.en: I carried the two mugs home in a small paper carrier bag.
examples.zh: 我用一个小「纸质手提袋」把两个马克杯提回了家。

collocations: a paper carrier bag with handles

words.enDefinition: A measure of how heavy a type of paper is, often given in grams per square metre.

examples.en: I looked at the paper weight before buying sketch paper for our afternoon art workshop.
examples.zh: 为下午的美术研讨活动买素描纸前，我查看了「纸张克重」。

examples.en: The product page showed the paper weight just below a close-up of the notebook pages.
examples.zh: 商品页在笔记本内页的特写正下方注明了「纸张克重」。

collocations: paper weight in grams per square metre

words.enDefinition: a status showing the manufacturer no longer produces a component

examples.en: The service page showed part discontinued when I entered the old camera's model number.
examples.zh: 我输入旧相机的型号时，服务页面显示「零件已停产」。

examples.en: The technician wrote part discontinued beside the replacement socket in her estimate that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，维修人员在报价单上的替换插口旁写了「零件已停产」。

words.enDefinition: collection of only part of an order now, with the rest collected later

examples.en: I asked about a partial pickup because only the notebook was ready.
examples.zh: 因为只有笔记本准备好了，我问能不能「部分商品先自提」。

examples.en: The partial pickup left the desk lamp listed as a separate collection.
examples.zh: 「部分商品先自提」后，台灯仍单独列为待取货。

words.enDefinition: using only part of a points or reward balance in a transaction

examples.en: I chose a partial redemption and saved some points for the next order.
examples.zh: 我用「部分兑换」，留了一些积分给下一笔订单。

examples.en: The statement recorded a partial redemption even though the order contained several different items.
examples.zh: 虽然订单里有好几件不同的商品，结算单还是只记录了一次「部分兑换」。

words.enDefinition: The stores where a particular campaign or offer is available.

examples.en: I checked the list of participating stores before walking to the shop near campus.
examples.zh: 走去校园附近那家店之前，我先查看了「参与活动的店铺」名单。

examples.en: The voucher was accepted at participating stores, including the branch next to my bus stop.
examples.zh: 优惠券在「参与活动的店铺」可用，公交站旁那家分店也参加。

words.enDefinition: an advantage a member gets from a business associated with the programme

examples.en: My favourite partner benefit was a discount at the cinema near our flat.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的「合作商家福利」是公寓附近电影院的优惠。

examples.en: The partner benefit showed under my membership details after I linked the two accounts.
examples.zh: 我关联两个账户后，「合作商家福利」显示在会员资料下方。

words.enDefinition: replacement materials and the work involved in making a repair

examples.en: The shop's estimate included parts and labour for the repair of my desk lamp.
examples.zh: 店家的报价包括维修台灯的「零件及人工」。

examples.en: I asked whether parts and labour were both covered for the speaker replacement.
examples.zh: 我问更换音箱时，「零件及人工」是否都在保障范围内。

words.enDefinition: whether the parts needed for a repair can be obtained in time

examples.en: The technician checked parts availability before giving me a date to collect the equipment.
examples.zh: 维修人员先查了「零件供应情况」，再给我取设备的日期。

examples.en: The shop said its estimate depended on parts availability after the holiday break.
examples.zh: 店家说，报价取决于假期后的「零件供应情况」。

words.enDefinition: a status meaning the required parts have been ordered and are yet to arrive

examples.en: The account showed parts on order after the technician checked the laptop's hinge.
examples.zh: 维修人员检查笔记本电脑的铰链后，账户显示「零件已订购」。

examples.en: The parts on order notice included an expected delivery date for the spare socket.
examples.zh: 「零件已订购」的通知中包括备用插口的预计到货日期。

collocations: parts on order from the supplier

words.enDefinition: offered as a source of usable components rather than a complete item

examples.en: The camera with the broken body was listed for parts only online.
examples.zh: 那台机身损坏的相机在网上标为「仅供拆件」。

examples.en: The sign marked the old deck parts only after the motor failed.
examples.zh: 电机坏了以后，这个老式卡座被标为「仅供拆件」。

words.enDefinition: a warranty covering specified replacement parts without paying for the installation work

examples.en: The invoice mentioned a parts-only warranty below the cost of replacing the battery.
examples.zh: 发票在换电池的费用下标明了「仅保零件的保修」。

examples.en: I checked whether the parts-only warranty applied to the new power supply as well.
examples.zh: 我确认了「仅保零件的保修」是否也适用于新的电源。

words.enDefinition: a section in a service record naming components that were removed and replaced

examples.en: The report listed parts replaced just above the results of the final test.
examples.zh: 报告在最终测试结果上方列出了「已更换的零件」。

examples.en: I checked the parts replaced section to see whether the new cable was included.
examples.zh: 我查看了「已更换的零件」一栏，确认是否包括新线缆。

words.enDefinition: To pay the amount by which the chosen option costs more than an available credit or allowance.

examples.en: I could use the voucher and pay the difference for the larger poster board.
examples.zh: 我可以用这张券，再「补付差额」买大一点的海报板。

examples.en: My roommate agreed to pay the difference after choosing the sturdier version of the organizer.
examples.zh: 室友选了更结实的收纳架后，同意「补付差额」。

collocations: pay the difference for the larger model

words.enDefinition: the cancellation of a payment so that the original charge is undone

examples.en: My bank showed a payment reversal rather than a separate credit for the cancelled order.
examples.zh: 订单取消后，银行显示的是「支付撤销」，没有另列退款入账。

examples.en: I checked the date of the payment reversal against the seller's cancellation email.
examples.zh: 我对照卖家的订单取消邮件，核对了「支付撤销」的日期。

words.enDefinition: reserved or sold but still waiting to be collected

examples.en: The desk was marked pending pickup by the time I checked the listing.
examples.zh: 我查看商品页时，那张桌子已经标为「待买家取货」。

examples.en: The notice showed pending pickup, so I asked to be next in line.
examples.zh: 告示显示「待买家取货」，于是我留言说想排下一位。

words.enDefinition: points that have been recorded but are not yet available to spend

examples.en: The pending points appeared after I collected my order from the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我从校园商店取完订单后，页面显示了「待入账积分」。

examples.en: I checked whether the pending points would become available before my next grocery trip.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，「待入账积分」能否在下次买菜前到账。

words.enDefinition: A label giving a price for a standard volume of one hundred millilitres.

examples.en: The shelf label showed a price per 100 ml below the total for each bottle.
examples.zh: 货架标签在每瓶总价的下方显示了「每100毫升」的价格。

examples.en: I compared the two shampoos per 100 ml because the bottles were different sizes.
examples.zh: 两瓶洗发水大小不同，我按「每100毫升」对比了两种价格。

words.enDefinition: A label giving the amount charged for each pair of items.

examples.en: I checked whether the socks were priced per pair before buying enough for the trip.
examples.zh: 买足旅行要用的袜子前，我核对了是不是「按双计价」。

examples.en: The large text showed the total, and the smaller text showed the cost per pair.
examples.zh: 大字标总价，小字标「每双的价格」。

words.enDefinition: A percentage of a stated price that is taken off the amount charged.

examples.en: The sign said ten percent off the listed price for selected backpacks that weekend.
examples.zh: 牌子写着，当周周末指定背包的标价「减免百分之十」。

examples.en: I calculated what fifteen percent off would save me on the blue lamp in the sale.
examples.zh: 我算了算，促销中的蓝色台灯「减免百分之十五」能省多少钱。

collocations: twenty percent off the listed price

words.enDefinition: goods likely to spoil or decay within a short time

examples.en: I checked which return rules the shop applied to perishable goods such as fresh flowers.
examples.zh: 我查看了商店对鲜花这类「易腐商品」适用的退货规则。

examples.en: The order summary listed perishable goods separately from the rest of the shopping.
examples.zh: 订单摘要把「易腐商品」与其他购物项目分开列出。

words.enDefinition: an item adapted for a particular customer by adding chosen details such as a name

examples.en: The mug was a personalised item with my flatmate's name on the side.
examples.zh: 那个马克杯是「个性化定制商品」，杯身上有我室友的名字。

examples.en: The seller listed the return conditions for a personalised item below the engraving options.
examples.zh: 卖家在刻字选项下方列出了「个性化定制商品」的退货条件。

words.enDefinition: A choice that lets a shopper add personal details to an item.

examples.en: The personalization option let me add my initials to the cover of the project notebook.
examples.zh: 「个性化定制选项」让我可以在项目笔记本封面上加上姓名缩写。

examples.en: I looked at the personalization option but decided to leave the front of the folder blank.
examples.zh: 我看了「个性化定制选项」，最后还是决定把文件夹正面留白。

words.enDefinition: a household where no pets are kept

examples.en: My roommate wanted to know whether the rug came from a pet-free home.
examples.zh: 室友想知道地毯是否来自「无宠物家庭」。

examples.en: The seller described the couch as coming from a pet-free home in the description.
examples.zh: 卖家在商品介绍里写明，这张沙发来自「无宠物家庭」。

words.enDefinition: clothing sizes proportioned for shorter people

examples.en: I tried petite sizing after finding the regular trousers too long again.
examples.zh: 常规版的裤子又太长了，我便试了「小个子尺码」。

examples.en: The store assistant showed me where they kept jackets in petite sizing.
examples.zh: 店员指给我看「小个子尺码」的夹克放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a photograph showing the information printed on a physical label

examples.en: Could you send a photo of the label so I can see the coat size?
examples.zh: 你能发张「标签照片」，让我看看这件外套的尺码吗？

examples.en: The seller posted a photo of the label next to the pictures of the chair.
examples.zh: 卖家在椅子的照片旁放了一张「标签照片」。

collocations: request a photo of the label
send a photo of the label
include a photo of the label

words.enDefinition: pictures showing what was broken, marked or otherwise damaged

examples.en: I uploaded photos of the damage and a picture of the address label.
examples.zh: 我上传了「受损照片」和一张地址标签的照片。

examples.en: The store said the photos of the damage were visible in the chat.
examples.zh: 店家说，他们能在聊天里看到「受损照片」。

words.expression: pick up at a different branch
words.lemma: pick up at a different branch
words.enDefinition: to collect an order at a store location other than the original choice
acceptedEnVariants: pick up at a different branch

examples.en: Can I pick up at a different branch closer to my new flat?
examples.zh: 我能「换一家离新住处更近的门店自提」吗？

examples.en: I asked whether I could pick up at a different branch that evening.
examples.zh: 我问当晚能不能「换一家门店自提」。

collocations: ask to pick up at a different branch
arrange to pick up at a different branch
choose to pick up at a different branch

words.enDefinition: a marked parking space for customers collecting store orders

examples.en: I parked in a pickup bay and waited for the attendant to arrive.
examples.zh: 我把车停进一个「自提专用停车位」，等店员过来。

examples.en: My roommate read the number painted on the pickup bay near the entrance.
examples.zh: 室友读了入口附近「自提专用停车位」地面上漆的号码。

words.enDefinition: a code used to confirm that an item was collected

examples.en: The marketplace app displayed a pickup code after I paid for the lamp.
examples.zh: 我付了台灯的钱后，二手交易应用显示了一个「取货核验码」。

examples.en: The seller scanned my pickup code when I took the desk away.
examples.zh: 我搬走书桌时，卖家扫描了我的「取货核验码」。

words.enDefinition: details explaining where and how to collect an order

examples.en: I checked the pickup instructions because the shop had two separate entrances.
examples.zh: 这家店有两个入口，我就看了下「自提说明」。

examples.en: The pickup instructions gave the name of the shopping centre's side entrance.
examples.zh: 「自提说明」里写了商场侧面入口的名称。

words.enDefinition: to state the amount you will pay in an auction

examples.en: I wanted to place a bid on the bike before the auction ended.
examples.zh: 我想在拍卖结束前给那辆自行车「出价竞拍」。

examples.en: My flatmate decided to place a bid after the seller measured the table.
examples.zh: 卖家量过桌子的尺寸后，室友决定「出价竞拍」。

collocations: place a bid on a lot

words.enDefinition: assistance from a marketplace in trying to resolve a dispute between users

examples.en: The seller agreed to platform mediation after we both uploaded our photos.
examples.zh: 我们双方上传照片后，卖家同意「平台调解」。

examples.en: I read about platform mediation while waiting for the seller to reply.
examples.zh: 我等卖家回复时，读了「平台调解」的介绍。

collocations: a case referred to platform mediation

words.enDefinition: to connect something to an outlet so it receives electricity

examples.en: Can we plug it in at the counter to see whether the lamp works?
examples.zh: 我们能在柜台这儿「插上电源」，看看台灯亮不亮吗？

examples.en: The vendor offered to plug it in before I made up my mind.
examples.zh: 摊主说，可以「插上电源」给我看看，我再决定。

collocations: plug it in at the counter

words.enDefinition: the history of points earned, used, or removed from an account

examples.en: The app showed a new line in my points activity after the returned item was scanned.
examples.zh: 退回的商品被扫码后，应用里的「积分变动记录」多了一行。

examples.en: I reviewed my points activity to see which rewards I had already used.
examples.zh: 我查看了「积分变动记录」，确认哪些奖励已经用掉。

words.enDefinition: a change made to fix or update the points on an account

examples.en: The store made a points adjustment after confirming someone had entered my account details incorrectly.
examples.zh: 商店确认有人填错我的账户信息后，做了「积分调整」。

examples.en: I noticed a points adjustment in the account history after sending the support team my receipt.
examples.zh: 我把小票发给客服后，在账户记录里看到了「积分调整」。

words.enDefinition: the number of points remaining credited to a member's account

examples.en: The app updated my points balance a day after I returned the jacket.
examples.zh: 我退回夹克一天后，应用更新了我的「积分余额」。

examples.en: I checked my points balance before joining the queue at the campus branch.
examples.zh: 在校园门店排队前，我查了「积分余额」。

words.enDefinition: a status saying points were removed from the account's balance

examples.en: The app showed points deducted after I returned the shoes to the store.
examples.zh: 我把鞋退回商店后，应用显示「积分已扣除」。

examples.en: I checked the points deducted line against the voucher I used the previous week.
examples.zh: 我用上一周用掉的优惠券核对了「积分已扣除」这一行。

words.enDefinition: the day when a group of earned points can no longer be used

examples.en: I copied the points expiration date into my calendar beside the next holiday.
examples.zh: 我把「积分失效日期」抄进了日历，记在下一个假期旁边。

examples.en: The points expiration date shown on the receipt was different from the one online.
examples.zh: 小票上的「积分失效日期」与网上看到的不一样。

words.enDefinition: a phrase saying points stop being usable after a stated time

examples.en: The app told me my points expire just after the start of term.
examples.zh: 应用告诉我，「我的积分将于开学后不久失效」。

examples.en: I checked whether unused points expire when I take a break from shopping there.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，一段时间不去那儿购物，「未用的积分会不会失效」。

collocations: points expire at the end of the year

words.enDefinition: a status showing points were lost because programme conditions were not met

examples.en: The closing statement showed points forfeited beside the amount I had never redeemed.
examples.zh: 结算单在我一直没兑换的数量旁写着「积分已被取消」。

examples.en: I checked why the account said points forfeited after the membership was closed.
examples.zh: 我查了为何会员注销后，账户显示「积分已被取消」。

collocations: points forfeited under the programme rules

words.enDefinition: a number used to multiply the points normally earned on a transaction

examples.en: The points multiplier for online orders changed when the spring promotion finished last month.
examples.zh: 上个月春季活动结束时，线上订单的「积分倍数」变了。

examples.en: I checked which points multiplier applied before splitting the order with my flatmate.
examples.zh: 和室友分单前，我查了适用的「积分倍数」。

words.enDefinition: a payment option combining points with money for the remaining price

examples.en: I selected points plus cash because my points did not cover the entire order.
examples.zh: 我的积分不够付整单，便选择了「积分加现金」。

examples.en: The points plus cash option was listed below the voucher price in the app.
examples.zh: 应用把「积分加现金」列在优惠券价格下方。

words.enDefinition: the date on which earned points are credited to an account

examples.en: The points posting date was one day later than the date on my receipt.
examples.zh: 「积分入账日期」比小票上的日期晚一天。

examples.en: I checked the points posting date before asking the store about the missing reward.
examples.zh: 我查了「积分入账日期」，才向店家询问没有收到的奖励。

words.enDefinition: a status showing previously removed points were returned to the balance

examples.en: The app showed points reinstated after the shop cancelled the order I had placed.
examples.zh: 商店取消我下的订单后，应用显示「积分已恢复」。

examples.en: I compared the points reinstated entry with the amount taken off my earlier balance.
examples.zh: 我把「积分已恢复」这一项与之前从余额扣掉的数量进行了比较。

words.enDefinition: a status saying unused points were carried into a new collection period

examples.en: The app listed the points rolled over from December on the first January statement.
examples.zh: 应用在一月第一张结算单里列出了十二月「已结转的积分」。

examples.en: When I checked my balance, I saw that my points rolled over into January.
examples.zh: 我查余额时看到，自己的「积分已结转」到一月。

collocations: points rolled over from last month
points rolled over into the next period

words.enDefinition: a statement summarizing points earned or used over a period

examples.en: My points statement arrived after the programme closed the monthly collection period on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五计划结束当月攒积分周期后，我收到了「积分结算单」。

examples.en: The points statement showed the points from each visit to the supermarket near campus.
examples.zh: 「积分结算单」列出了我每次去校园附近超市获得的积分。

words.enDefinition: to put points from several people into a shared balance for redemption

examples.en: Our household could pool points for a larger reward at the end of each year.
examples.zh: 我们家可以「合并多人积分使用」，在每年年底换一项更大的奖励。

examples.en: I asked whether flatmates were allowed to pool points under the membership rules.
examples.zh: 我问根据会员规则，室友能不能「合并积分使用」。

words.enDefinition: collection of an item left on a seller's porch

examples.en: The listing offered porch pickup for a box of free plant pots.
examples.zh: 帖子说，可以到「门廊自取」一箱免费的花盆。

examples.en: The neighbour asked if porch pickup would suit me before the weekend.
examples.zh: 邻居问我周末前「门廊自取」方不方便。

words.enDefinition: a check performed after a repair to confirm the product functions properly

examples.en: The technician ran a post-repair test before returning the printer to the front desk.
examples.zh: 维修人员进行了「维修后测试」，才把打印机拿回前台。

examples.en: A copy of the post-repair test results came with the repaired headphones on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二收到修好的耳机时，附有一份「维修后测试」结果。

words.enDefinition: owned before, as commonly stated on resale labels

examples.en: The camera shop keeps its pre-owned lenses in a separate display case.
examples.zh: 照相器材店把「二手」镜头放在单独的展示柜里。

examples.en: I chose a pre-owned clarinet that my music tutor had tried already.
examples.zh: 我选了一支音乐老师已经试过的「二手」单簧管。

words.enDefinition: a higher membership level offering additional or better benefits

examples.en: The premium tier included a delivery option I needed when I moved into residence.
examples.zh: 「高级会员等级」有一项配送福利，正好是我搬进宿舍时需要的。

examples.en: My flatmate checked the cost of a premium tier before upgrading her account.
examples.zh: 室友升级账户前，查了「高级会员等级」的费用。

words.enDefinition: To order a product before it becomes generally available.

examples.en: I decided to preorder the planner because it was scheduled for release before term started.
examples.zh: 这款手账定于开学前上市，我决定现在就「预订」。

examples.en: The store let me preorder the book when only the cover design had been announced.
examples.zh: 商店只公布了封面设计，就允许我「预订」这本书。

words.enDefinition: A price reduction offered for placing an order before the item's general release.

examples.en: The bookstore advertised a preorder discount for the new edition of the drawing guide.
examples.zh: 书店为新版绘画指南宣传「预购折扣」。

examples.en: I checked the publication date before choosing whether to use the preorder discount on the textbook.
examples.zh: 我先查看了出版日期，再决定要不要用这本教材的「预购折扣」。

collocations: a preorder discount on the new edition

words.enDefinition: a shipping label for a return whose postage has already been arranged or paid

examples.en: The seller sent a prepaid return label after accepting my request about the backpack.
examples.zh: 卖家接受我关于背包的退货申请后，发来了「邮费已付的退货标签」。

examples.en: I printed my prepaid return label at the library before walking to the parcel shop.
examples.zh: 去包裹代收点前，我在图书馆打印了「邮费已付的退货标签」。

words.enDefinition: the person who owned an item before its current owner

examples.en: The previous owner had put a small name label under the seat.
examples.zh: 「前任物主」在座位底下贴了一张小姓名标签。

examples.en: The shop said the previous owner had kept the camera in its case.
examples.zh: 店家说，「前任物主」一直把相机放在相机盒里。

words.enDefinition: A message sent when a watched item changes price or reaches a chosen price.

examples.en: I set a price alert for the calculator before I left the library that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午离开图书馆前，我设置了计算器的「价格变动提醒」。

examples.en: The price alert arrived during class, so I waited until the break to check it.
examples.zh: 「价格变动提醒」是在上课时收到的，所以我等到课间才查看。

collocations: a price alert for a laptop

words.enDefinition: A list showing how the different parts of a price add up.

examples.en: The price breakdown showed separate lines for the notebook, gift wrapping, and the shipping charge.
examples.zh: 「价格组成明细」把笔记本、礼品包装和配送费分别列了三行。

examples.en: I checked the price breakdown before deciding whether to order the supplies with my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先查看「价格组成明细」，再决定要不要跟室友一起订购这些用品。

collocations: check the price breakdown before ordering

words.enDefinition: A quick lookup to find or confirm the price of an item.

examples.en: I asked for a price check because the notebook did not have a shelf label.
examples.zh: 那本笔记本没有货架标签，所以我请人帮忙「查价」。

examples.en: The cashier did a price check before ringing up the remaining supplies for our workshop.
examples.zh: 收银员先「查价」，再给研讨活动剩下的用品结算。

words.enDefinition: A website showing prices for the same or similar products from several sellers.

examples.en: I used a price comparison site to see which store had the cheapest desk lamp.
examples.zh: 我用「比价网站」查看哪家店的台灯最便宜。

examples.en: The price comparison site showed three offers for the exact calculator model listed on my syllabus.
examples.zh: 「比价网站」显示了课程大纲上那款计算器的三家报价。

collocations: list a product on a price comparison site

words.enDefinition: The amount by which one price is higher or lower than another.

examples.en: The price difference was small enough that I chose the larger box for our project.
examples.zh: 「价差」很小，所以我选了大号盒子用于小组项目。

examples.en: I noticed the price difference only after checking what came with each lamp.
examples.zh: 我在核对每盏灯随附的东西后，才注意到「价差」。

collocations: explain the price difference between two models

words.enDefinition: the difference in price between the returned item and the one supplied instead

examples.en: The cashier showed me the price difference on exchange before I chose the other model.
examples.zh: 我选另一款前，收银员先给我看了「换货差价」。

examples.en: The receipt listed the price difference on exchange in a separate line below the items.
examples.zh: 收据在商品下方单列一行「换货差价」。

collocations: pay the price difference on exchange
refund a price difference on exchange
calculate the price difference on exchange

words.enDefinition: An unexpected difference between two prices shown for the same item.

examples.en: I noticed a price discrepancy between the shelf label and the amount shown at the register.
examples.zh: 我发现货架标价和收银系统显示的「价格不一致」。

examples.en: The price discrepancy disappeared when I switched the page back to the smaller size.
examples.zh: 我把页面切回较小的尺寸后，「价格不一致」的情况就消失了。

words.enDefinition: A noticeable increase in the price of something.

examples.en: The price hike meant the refill cartridges cost more than the whole printer during last year's sale.
examples.zh: 「价格大幅上涨」后，替换墨盒比去年促销时的整台打印机还贵。

examples.en: There was a price hike on poster paper just before our final exhibition.
examples.zh: 期末展览前，海报纸的「价格大幅上涨」。

collocations: a price hike on basic supplies

words.enDefinition: A record of the prices charged for an item at different times.

examples.en: The price history showed that the speaker had cost less earlier in the semester.
examples.zh: 「历史价格记录」显示，这款音箱在本学期早些时候更便宜。

examples.en: I checked the price history to see whether the advertised discount looked unusual for that backpack.
examples.zh: 我查看了「历史价格记录」，想知道这款背包标出的折扣力度是否少见。

collocations: a chart of the price history

words.enDefinition: A price expressed in the currency used in the buyer's current location.

examples.en: I looked for the price in local currency before comparing the two stationery sites.
examples.zh: 比较两个文具网站之前，我先找了「本币标价」。

examples.en: The website displayed the price in local currency beneath the amount in the seller's currency.
examples.zh: 网站在以卖家货币标出的金额下方显示了换算后的「本币标价」。

collocations: display the price in local currency
show the price in local currency
compare the price in local currency

words.enDefinition: the seller is unwilling to accept a lower price

examples.en: The seller said the price is firm because she included the folding stand.
examples.zh: 卖家说「价格不议」，因为已经把折叠支架算在里面了。

examples.en: The message under the photo said the price is firm for both chairs together.
examples.zh: 照片下方的消息写着，两把椅子合卖的「价格不议」。

collocations: the price is firm at that amount
ask whether the price is firm

words.enDefinition: A sorting option that lists the least expensive items first.

examples.en: I selected “Price low to high” and found several cheaper cases for my laptop.
examples.zh: 我选了「价格从低到高」，找到了几款更便宜的电脑保护套。

examples.en: The page stayed on “Price low to high” after I removed the filter for color.
examples.zh: 取消颜色筛选后，页面仍然用「价格从低到高」来排序。

collocations: a menu option marked price low to high
sort using price low to high

words.enDefinition: Indicates that a seller gives the price only when someone asks.

examples.en: The custom poster frame was marked “Price on request” on the art shop's website.
examples.zh: 美术用品店网站上，定制海报框标着「价格请询问」。

examples.en: I saw “Price on request” next to the larger display boards in the seller's catalogue.
examples.zh: 我在卖家目录的大号展示板旁看到了「价格请询问」。

collocations: a listing saying price on request
a label reading price on request

words.enDefinition: the amount to pay for one of several items

examples.en: I checked the price per item because the stall had six matching cups.
examples.zh: 摊位上有六个一样的杯子，我确认了「每件单价」。

examples.en: The seller wrote the price per item on a tag beside the bowls.
examples.zh: 卖家在碗旁边的价签上写了「每件单价」。

collocations: ask for the price per item

words.enDefinition: The cost of one sheet when a pack price is divided by its sheet count.

examples.en: I calculated the price per sheet because the packs contained different numbers of sheets.
examples.zh: 两包纸张数不同，所以我算了算「每张的价格」。

examples.en: The price per sheet was lower in the larger pack my classmate had found online.
examples.zh: 同学在网上找到的大包装「每张的价格」更低。

words.enDefinition: The extra amount charged for one option compared with a similar alternative.

examples.en: There was a price premium for the padded sleeve, so I checked the difference in materials.
examples.zh: 带加厚夹层的内胆包有「溢价」，所以我查看了两款材料的差别。

examples.en: I did not want to pay a price premium just to get a different color.
examples.zh: 我不想仅为了换个颜色就付「溢价」。

collocations: a price premium for a color

words.enDefinition: The span between the lowest and highest prices being considered.

examples.en: I set a price range before browsing lamps because my dorm desk only needed something simple.
examples.zh: 我在浏览台灯之前设好了「价格区间」，因为宿舍书桌有盏简单的台灯就够了。

examples.en: Most of the scientific calculators in my price range were suitable for the course.
examples.zh: 在我能接受的「价格区间」内，大部分科学计算器都适合这门课。

collocations: a price range for student laptops

words.enDefinition: A tool that monitors how the price of an item changes over time.

examples.en: I put the headphones into a price tracker while I waited for my next paycheck.
examples.zh: 发下一次工资前，我把那副耳机加进了「价格追踪工具」。

examples.en: The price tracker picked up a change in the cost of the lamp late last night.
examples.zh: 「价格追踪工具」昨晚很晚才检测到台灯价格变化。

collocations: add an item to a price tracker

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the final date for which a stated price remains in effect.

examples.en: The tag said “Price valid through Friday” below the amount printed in larger letters.
examples.zh: 标签在大字标出的金额下方写着「标价有效至星期五」。

examples.en: The webpage listed “Price valid through June” beside the specific notebook design we needed.
examples.zh: 网页在我们需要的那款笔记本旁写着「标价有效至六月底」。

collocations: mark a price valid through June
a label reading price valid through

words.enDefinition: Introduces the lowest advertised price among a group of items or options.

examples.en: The advert said “Prices start at ten dollars” above the selection of tablet cases.
examples.zh: 平板保护套选项上方的广告写着「价格低至十美元」。

examples.en: The line reading “Prices start at” referred to the smallest size shown on the page.
examples.zh: 写着「价格低至」的一行指的是页面上最小的尺寸。

collocations: a banner saying prices start at
prices start at the base rate

words.enDefinition: the person responsible for the main membership on a shared account

examples.en: The primary member received the renewal email before the other cardholders were notified.
examples.zh: 其他持卡人收到通知前，「主会员」先收到了续费邮件。

examples.en: Only the primary member could view the billing details on our shared plan.
examples.zh: 在我们的共享方案里，只有「主会员」能查看账单详情。

words.enDefinition: a return method that does not require the customer to print a label

examples.en: I selected a printerless return because my printer had run out of ink.
examples.zh: 打印机没墨了，我选了「免打印退货」。

examples.en: The website listed a printerless return alongside the option to print a label at home.
examples.zh: 网站把「免打印退货」和在家打印标签两个选项列在一起。

words.enDefinition: an individual selling something independently of a business

examples.en: The phone was offered by a private seller who lived near our campus.
examples.zh: 那部手机是住在校园附近的一位「个人卖家」挂出来的。

examples.en: I asked the private seller when she had last used the sewing machine.
examples.zh: 我问这位「个人卖家」上次使用这台缝纫机是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: a refund calculated in proportion to the unused part of a purchase or service

examples.en: I asked whether I qualified for a pro rata refund for the unused months.
examples.zh: 我问未使用的几个月能否获得「按比例退款」。

examples.en: The pro rata refund was based on the number of classes left that term.
examples.zh: 这次「按比例退款」按本学期剩余课时计算。

words.enDefinition: To continue from the selected items to the next steps in placing an order.

examples.en: I clicked “Proceed to checkout” after making sure the two covers were both the right size.
examples.zh: 确认两个封套的尺寸都对后，我点了「前往结算」。

examples.en: The site asked me to proceed to checkout to review my order and delivery choices.
examples.zh: 网站提示我「前往结算」以核对订单和配送选项。

words.enDefinition: A status showing that the seller is preparing an order before dispatch or collection.

examples.en: The page showed “Processing order” while the shop was preparing our group purchase of folders.
examples.zh: 店铺为我们的小组采购准备文件夹时，页面显示「正在处理订单」。

examples.en: I saw “Processing order” next to the notebook before the dispatch details appeared online.
examples.zh: 发货信息显示前，我在笔记本旁看到了「正在处理订单」。

collocations: see processing order on the page

words.enDefinition: Written information about an item's features, materials, or intended use.

examples.en: The product description said the notebook was refillable, which mattered more to me than the color.
examples.zh: 「商品详情说明」写着笔记本可以更换内页，这对我来说比颜色更重要。

examples.en: I checked the product description to see whether the desk lamp could tilt forward.
examples.zh: 我查看了「商品详情说明」，想知道台灯能不能向前倾斜。

words.enDefinition: The group of images or videos that show a product from different views.

examples.en: The product gallery included a short video showing the desk stand from several angles.
examples.zh: 「商品图库」里有一段从不同角度展示桌面支架的短视频。

examples.en: I opened the product gallery to see the stitching on the inside of the bag.
examples.zh: 我打开「商品图库」，想看包内侧的针脚。

collocations: a video in the product gallery

words.enDefinition: A visual showing an item on a product page or listing.

examples.en: The first product image showed the entire bag, and the next showed the inside pockets.
examples.zh: 第一张「商品图片」展示整个包，下一张展示内袋。

examples.en: I enlarged the product image so my roommate could see where the cable came out.
examples.zh: 我放大了「商品图片」，让室友能看见线缆从哪里伸出来。

words.enDefinition: An entry showing an item offered for sale online.

examples.en: The product listing showed a close-up of the clip on the reading light near the bottom.
examples.zh: 「商品刊登信息」下方有阅读灯夹子的特写照片。

examples.en: I shared the product listing with my roommate so she could check the organizer’s dimensions.
examples.zh: 我把「商品刊登信息」发给了室友，让她看看收纳架的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: The web page containing details and buying options for a particular product.

examples.en: The product page showed which colors were available for the larger pencil case.
examples.zh: 「商品详情页」显示了大号笔袋有哪些颜色可以买。

examples.en: I left the product page open while I measured the shelf in my room again.
examples.zh: 我再次测量房间里的架子时，让「商品详情页」保持打开。

words.enDefinition: a notice identifying a recalled product and explaining the available response

examples.en: The product recall notice listed the affected models and the dates of manufacture.
examples.zh: 「产品召回通知」列出了受影响的型号和生产日期。

examples.en: I forwarded the product recall notice to my flatmate because we shared the appliance.
examples.zh: 电器是和室友共用的，我把「产品召回通知」转发给了室友。

collocations: affected items on a product recall notice

words.enDefinition: the process of recording the buyer and a specific product with its maker or seller

examples.en: I completed product registration after finding the serial number on the bottom of the device.
examples.zh: 我在设备底部找到序列号后，完成了「产品登记」。

examples.en: The confirmation email arrived shortly after I submitted the product registration for my headphones.
examples.zh: 我提交耳机的「产品登记」后不久，就收到了确认邮件。

words.enDefinition: an action to remove a potentially unsafe product from use or offer a remedy

examples.en: I checked the model numbers listed in a product safety recall for kitchen appliances.
examples.zh: 我对照了厨房电器「产品安全召回」中列出的型号。

examples.en: The store posted details of a product safety recall beside the customer service desk.
examples.zh: 商店在客服台旁张贴了「产品安全召回」的详情。

collocations: affected by a product safety recall

words.enDefinition: A small image representing a product in a list or gallery.

examples.en: I clicked the product thumbnail to see a bigger picture of the backpack's front pocket.
examples.zh: 我点了「商品缩略图」，想看背包前袋的放大图。

examples.en: The product thumbnail showed the organizer closed, so I opened the listing for more pictures.
examples.zh: 「商品缩略图」里收纳架是合上的，于是我打开商品页查看更多图片。

words.enDefinition: The name displayed at the top of an online product listing.

examples.en: The product title mentioned a set, but the description explained exactly how many pieces were included.
examples.zh: 「商品标题」写的是套装，而详情说明了具体包含几件。

examples.en: I searched for the exact product title after my classmate sent me a screenshot.
examples.zh: 同学发来截图后，我搜索了完整的「商品标题」。

collocations: include details in the product title
a product title on the results page

words.enDefinition: the written rules describing how a membership programme works

examples.en: I read the programme terms before agreeing to link my shopping account with the app.
examples.zh: 同意把购物账户与应用关联前，我读了「计划条款」。

examples.en: The programme terms explained when the store would remove points after a return.
examples.zh: 「计划条款」说明了退货后商家什么时候会扣回积分。

words.enDefinition: A code a shopper enters to receive a particular offer.

examples.en: I copied the promo code from the welcome email before ordering my notebook that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上订笔记本前，我从欢迎邮件里复制了「促销码」。

examples.en: The promo code worked for one color of the lamp but had no effect on the other.
examples.zh: 「促销码」对台灯的一种颜色有效，但对另一种没有作用。

words.enDefinition: The time for which a particular deal or campaign is offered.

examples.en: The promotional period ended before the weekend, even though the product remained on the same page.
examples.zh: 「促销期间」在周末前结束，商品却仍然留在同一个页面上。

examples.en: I checked the promotional period before telling my project group about the discounted folders.
examples.zh: 向项目小组介绍打折文件夹前，我查看了「促销期间」。

words.enDefinition: Evidence that another eligible seller is offering the same product for less.

examples.en: I saved the current listing as proof of a lower price for the same calculator.
examples.zh: 我保存了当前商品信息，作为同款计算器「较低报价的凭证」。

examples.en: The page listed examples of proof of a lower price that shoppers could submit.
examples.zh: 网页列出了顾客可以提交的「较低报价的凭证」示例。

collocations: provide proof of a lower price
ask for proof of a lower price
show proof of a lower price

words.enDefinition: evidence showing when or where something was bought

examples.en: The cashier accepted my online order email as proof of purchase for the return.
examples.zh: 办理退货时，收银员接受网上订单邮件作为「购买凭证」。

examples.en: I found the proof of purchase saved in a folder on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机的一个文件夹里找到了保存的「购买凭证」。

words.enDefinition: evidence showing that a customer returned an item or gave it to a carrier

examples.en: The clerk asked for proof of return while looking up the status of my claim.
examples.zh: 工作人员查询进展时，请我提供「退货寄回凭证」。

examples.en: I kept the courier's receipt as proof of return until the seller issued credit.
examples.zh: 我把承运商的收据留作「退货寄回凭证」，直到卖家发放购物额度。

words.enDefinition: a suggested way to settle the problem under discussion

examples.en: The seller's proposed resolution was to send the compatible cable the next day.
examples.zh: 卖家的「建议的解决方案」是第二天寄一根兼容的电线。

examples.en: I asked for the proposed resolution in writing before replying to the case.
examples.zh: 回复工单前，我要了一份书面的「建议的解决方案」。

words.enDefinition: a separately offered plan covering specified breakdowns, damage, or service costs

examples.en: I compared the protection plan with the cover included in the original warranty.
examples.zh: 我把「产品保障方案」与原保修承诺中的保障做了比较。

examples.en: The shop printed the protection plan terms on a sheet apart from the receipt.
examples.zh: 店家把「产品保障方案」的条款单独打印，没有和收据印在一起。

words.enDefinition: material placed around an item to protect it from damage

examples.en: The clerk added protective wrapping around the corners of the picture frame.
examples.zh: 店员在相框的几个角外加了「防护包装」。

examples.en: I asked for protective wrapping because the glass bowl had no box.
examples.zh: 那个玻璃碗没有盒子，所以我请店员加一些「防护包装」。

words.enDefinition: to be stretched tightly over the chest when worn

examples.en: I felt the shirt pull across the chest when I buttoned it.
examples.zh: 我扣上扣子，就觉得这件衬衫「胸前绷紧了」。

examples.en: The clerk asked whether the jacket would pull across the chest with a sweater underneath.
examples.zh: 店员问里面套件毛衣后，这件夹克会不会「胸前被绷紧」。

collocations: start to pull across the chest
clothes that pull across the chest
pull across the chest when closed

words.enDefinition: The largest number of units a shopper is allowed to buy under the stated terms.

examples.en: The listing showed a purchase limit of two for the popular campus notebooks today.
examples.zh: 今天，商品页显示这款热门校园笔记本的「购买数量上限」是两本。

examples.en: I read the purchase limit before offering to order folders for the whole group.
examples.zh: 我看了「购买数量上限」，才提出帮整个小组买文件夹。

words.enDefinition: a purchase meeting the stated conditions of a promotion

examples.en: The offer required a qualifying purchase from the school supplies section that week.
examples.zh: 那一周，要参加活动得在学习用品区完成一笔「符合促销条件的消费」。

examples.en: I checked whether the notebooks counted as a qualifying purchase for the weekend deal.
examples.zh: 我查了买这些笔记本算不算周末活动的「符合促销条件的消费」。

words.enDefinition: the part of spending that counts towards a benefit or target

examples.en: My qualifying spend excluded the delivery fee shown at the bottom of the receipt.
examples.zh: 「可计入门槛的消费额」不包括收据底部的配送费。

examples.en: The programme showed my qualifying spend for the month in the account summary.
examples.zh: 计划在账户摘要里显示了我当月「可计入门槛的消费额」。

words.enDefinition: A section where people ask and answer questions about an item.

examples.en: I found the cord length in the questions and answers section below the lamp reviews.
examples.zh: 我在台灯评价下方的「商品问答」里找到了线缆长度。

examples.en: The questions and answers section included several replies from people who owned the same organizer.
examples.zh: 「商品问答」里有几条拥有同款收纳架的人给出的回复。

words.enDefinition: your place in a line waiting to be served

examples.en: I checked my queue position after the page said several people were ahead.
examples.zh: 页面说前面还有几个人后，我看了自己的「排队顺位」。

examples.en: The chat window stopped showing my queue position when an agent became available.
examples.zh: 有客服可以接入时，聊天窗口就不再显示我的「排队顺位」。

words.enDefinition: A display showing how many ratings fall into each score or star level.

examples.en: The rating breakdown showed a mix of very positive and very negative scores for the lamp.
examples.zh: 「各档评分分布」显示，这盏灯的评分里有很高的，也有很低的。

examples.en: I opened the rating breakdown to see how many buyers had given just one star.
