examples.zh: 我打开「各档评分分布」，想看看有多少买家只给了一星。

collocations: a chart with the rating breakdown

words.enDefinition: to restore a membership that has expired or been inactive

examples.en: The app explains how to reactivate your membership using the email you registered before.
examples.zh: 应用说明了怎样用之前登记的邮箱「重新开通会员」。

examples.en: Could you reactivate your membership before making the first big purchase of the term?
examples.zh: 本学期第一笔大额购买前，你能先「重新开通会员」吗？

words.enDefinition: Already prepared and available to be sent out to the buyer.

examples.en: The listing marked the blue notebook as ready to ship, unlike the personalized version.
examples.zh: 商品页把蓝色笔记本标为「可立即发货」，个性化款则不同。

examples.en: I chose the lamp that was ready to ship because the other one was still being made.
examples.zh: 我选了「可立即发货」的那款台灯，因为另一款还在制作。

collocations: be ready to ship by Monday

words.enDefinition: Prepared so it can be used without assembly or other setup.

examples.en: The desk organizer came ready to use, with no pieces for me to put together.
examples.zh: 这个桌面收纳架到手「可直接使用」，我不需要组装任何部件。

examples.en: The listing said the pen was ready to use and showed the refill already inside.
examples.zh: 商品页显示替芯已装在笔里，注明这支笔「可直接使用」。

words.enDefinition: to transfer an existing support request from one handler to another

examples.en: The shop had to reassign the case after the first adviser went off shift.
examples.zh: 第一位客服下班后，商家不得不「把工单转给另一位客服处理」。

examples.en: They offered to reassign the case to someone who handled online purchases.
examples.zh: 他们提出，可以「把工单转给网购客服处理」。

collocations: reassign the case to another adviser
ask staff to reassign the case

words.enDefinition: A form buyers may need to fill in to request an advertised rebate.

examples.en: The shop linked to a rebate form under the specifications for the small printer.
examples.zh: 店铺在小型打印机规格下方附上了「返款申请表」链接。

examples.en: I opened the rebate form to see which model numbers were covered by the offer.
examples.zh: 我打开「返款申请表」，想看看活动包括哪些型号。

words.enDefinition: a search of a retailer's records to find a receipt or purchase

examples.en: The clerk did a receipt lookup after I gave the date of the purchase.
examples.zh: 我报出购买日期后，办事员做了一次「交易凭条查询」。

examples.en: The online receipt lookup showed the total but left out the item names.
examples.zh: 在线「交易凭条查询」显示了总额，但没列出商品名称。

words.enDefinition: a device that prints the paper record of a sale

examples.en: The receipt printer made a noise before the paper came out.
examples.zh: 收据出来前，「收据打印机」响了一声。

examples.en: The cashier changed the roll in the receipt printer next to the till.
examples.zh: 收银员换了收银台旁「收据打印机」里的纸卷。

collocations: replace a roll in the receipt printer
a receipt printer beside the register

words.enDefinition: A website label for items the shopper has looked at lately.

examples.en: The recently viewed section showed the two laptop stands I had considered the night before.
examples.zh: 「最近浏览」栏显示了我前一晚考虑过的两款电脑支架。

examples.en: I found the blue pencil case again through the recently viewed list on the homepage.
examples.zh: 我在首页的「最近浏览」列表里重新找到了蓝色笔袋。

words.enDefinition: a used component restored to a condition in which it can work again

examples.en: The estimate listed a reconditioned part as an option for the older appliance.
examples.zh: 针对这台较旧的电器，报价列了「修复再用部件」这一选项。

examples.en: I checked whether the shop gave a warranty on the reconditioned part it installed.
examples.zh: 我查了店里是否为安装的「修复再用部件」提供保修。

words.enDefinition: to claim or use a benefit that has been made available

examples.en: I chose to redeem a reward for a free drink after my seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课结束后，我选择「使用一项奖励」，领了一杯免费的饮料。

examples.en: Ask the cashier if you want to redeem a reward from the app.
examples.zh: 如果想「使用一项奖励」，可以问收银员能否使用应用里的奖励。

collocations: choose when to redeem a reward

words.enDefinition: To use a voucher to receive the offered price, item, or other benefit.

examples.en: I tried to redeem a voucher when I bought the larger folder after class.
examples.zh: 下课后买大号文件夹时，我试着「使用优惠券」。

examples.en: The site explained where to redeem a voucher for a free notebook with my order.
examples.zh: 网站说明了在哪里「使用优惠券」，给订单加一本免费笔记本。

collocations: redeem a voucher at the store
redeem a voucher before it expires

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the last date for using a coupon or offer.

examples.en: The voucher said “Redeem by Friday” underneath the instructions for claiming the free notebook.
examples.zh: 优惠券在领取免费笔记本的说明下方写着「最迟于星期五兑换」。

examples.en: I checked the “Redeem by” date before putting the paper voucher in my desk drawer.
examples.zh: 把纸质券放进书桌抽屉前，我看了「最迟兑换日期」。

collocations: a voucher marked redeem by Friday
a label saying redeem by June

words.enDefinition: to use points in exchange for a reward or a reduction in price

examples.en: I waited until the app showed my balance before trying to redeem points.
examples.zh: 我等应用显示余额后，才试着「使用积分兑换」商品。

examples.en: The cashier asked if I wanted to redeem points toward the cost of my order.
examples.zh: 收银员问我是否要「使用积分兑换」抵扣这笔订单的部分金额。

words.enDefinition: the amount of value or reward obtained for a set number of points

examples.en: I compared the redemption rate for groceries with the rate for cinema vouchers.
examples.zh: 我对比了杂货和电影券的「积分兑换比率」。

examples.en: The app showed a higher redemption rate when I selected an offer from a partner.
examples.zh: 我选合作商家的优惠时，应用显示了较高的「积分兑换比率」。

words.enDefinition: the minimum balance or other level required before a reward can be claimed

examples.en: I reached the redemption threshold after buying textbooks at one of the partner shops.
examples.zh: 我在一家合作商店买完教材后，达到了「兑换门槛」。

examples.en: The redemption threshold for a cinema voucher was lower than I had expected.
examples.zh: 电影券的「兑换门槛」比我预想的低。

words.enDefinition: to invite a friend to join a programme as your referral

examples.en: The store let me refer a friend using a link from my account page.
examples.zh: 商店让我用账户页上的链接「推荐朋友加入」。

examples.en: I saw the refer a friend button beside my membership details in the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用的会员资料旁看到了「推荐朋友加入」的按钮。

collocations: refer a friend to the programme

words.enDefinition: an extra benefit for introducing a new member who meets programme rules

examples.en: My referral bonus appeared after my classmate made her first eligible purchase at the shop.
examples.zh: 同学在店里完成第一笔符合条件的消费后，我收到了「推荐入会奖励」。

examples.en: I read the conditions for the referral bonus before inviting my flatmate to join.
examples.zh: 邀请室友加入之前，我读了「推荐入会奖励」的条件。

words.enDefinition: a link that records who invited a new member to sign up

examples.en: My flatmate sent me her referral link when I asked about the shop's rewards.
examples.zh: 我问起商店的奖励时，室友把她的「推荐注册链接」发给了我。

examples.en: I opened the referral link to read the signup terms before joining the programme.
examples.zh: 我在加入计划前打开「推荐注册链接」，阅读了注册条款。

collocations: sign up through a referral link

words.enDefinition: A package of supplies designed to replenish an existing item or container.

examples.en: I ordered a refill pack of notebook pages after filling the ones from orientation week.
examples.zh: 我写满了迎新周领到的笔记本内页后，订了一份内页「补充装」。

examples.en: The refill pack used the same size of insert as the planner on my desk.
examples.zh: 这份「补充装」的内页尺寸和我桌上的手账相同。

words.enDefinition: given a new surface finish to improve appearance

examples.en: Our neighbour sold us a refinished table with a darker wood finish.
examples.zh: 邻居卖给我们一张「表面已翻新」的桌子，木色比原来深。

examples.en: The refinished dresser still had its original yellow handles and wooden feet.
examples.zh: 这只「表面已翻新」的斗柜还保留着原来的黄色把手和木脚。

words.enDefinition: the amount a retailer displays, offers, or returns for a particular purchase

examples.en: The email showed a refund amount that was lower than the one in the app.
examples.zh: 邮件显示的「退款金额」比应用中的低。

examples.en: I asked the cashier to explain how the refund amount was calculated that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我请收银员解释了「退款金额」是怎么计算的。

words.enDefinition: an itemized account of how the refunded total was calculated

examples.en: I requested a refund breakdown because the order had two items and a discount.
examples.zh: 订单里有两件商品，还用了折扣，所以我索要了「退款明细」。

examples.en: The refund breakdown listed the tax separately from the amount paid for the shoes.
examples.zh: 「退款明细」把税费与鞋款分开列出。

words.enDefinition: an email notifying the customer that a refund was arranged or processed

examples.en: The refund confirmation email showed the date when the money was sent back.
examples.zh: 「退款确认邮件」写明了款项退回的日期。

examples.en: I forwarded the refund confirmation email to my flatmate because we had shared the order.
examples.zh: 订单是我和室友一起下的，所以我把「退款确认邮件」转发给了室友。

words.enDefinition: an amount subtracted before a refund is sent

examples.en: The refund summary showed a refund deduction for the return label I had used.
examples.zh: 退款摘要显示，我使用的退货标签产生了一笔「退款扣除额」。

examples.en: I asked the seller to explain the refund deduction on the second item.
examples.zh: 我请卖家解释第二件商品的「退款扣除额」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a request for money back was declined

examples.en: The app displayed refund denied after the clerk reviewed the images of the case.
examples.zh: 办事员查看盒子的照片后，应用显示「退款遭拒」。

examples.en: My refund denied notice said the staff would explain the reason if I called.
examples.zh: 「退款遭拒」通知写着，打电话就有工作人员说明原因。

words.enDefinition: the payment account, card, or credit balance a refund goes to

examples.en: I verified the refund destination before closing the return page on my phone.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「退款去向」，才关闭手机上的退货页面。

examples.en: The email listed my oldest gift card as the refund destination for the order.
examples.zh: 邮件把我最早的礼品卡列为这笔订单的「退款去向」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing an attempted refund transaction did not go through

examples.en: The refund failed status appeared after the seller tried using the old card number.
examples.zh: 卖家尝试按旧卡号退款后，出现了「退款未成功」的状态。

examples.en: I received a refund failed email while checking my order history on the train.
examples.zh: 我在火车上查订单记录时，收到了一封「退款未成功」的邮件。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a seller has sent the money through the refund system

examples.en: The account showed refund issued before my bank displayed the amount on the statement.
examples.zh: 账户先显示「退款已发出」，银行对账单后来才显示金额。

examples.en: The email labelled refund issued included a reference number and the amount for my return.
examples.zh: 标为「退款已发出」的邮件中有退货的查询编号和退款金额。

words.enDefinition: a receipt that records a refund already made to the customer

examples.en: The cashier handed me a refund receipt after checking the item on the order.
examples.zh: 收银员核对订单商品后，递给我一张「退款凭条」。

examples.en: I kept the refund receipt until the money showed up on my bank statement.
examples.zh: 我留着「退款凭条」，直到银行对账单显示款项到账。

words.enDefinition: the option of having a refunded amount added to a gift card

examples.en: The clerk offered a refund to a gift card when I returned the jacket.
examples.zh: 我退夹克时，店员提出可以「退款到礼品卡」。

examples.en: I chose a refund to a gift card because I wanted to order the smaller one.
examples.zh: 我想再买小号的，所以选择「退款到礼品卡」。

collocations: choose a refund to a gift card
offer a refund to a gift card
receive a refund to a gift card

words.enDefinition: the amount that may be returned under the applicable terms

examples.en: The portal displayed a refundable amount before I selected which item to send back.
examples.zh: 我选择要寄回的商品前，办理页面显示了「可退款金额」。

examples.en: Our receipt showed a different refundable amount from the one on the phone screen.
examples.zh: 收据上的「可退款金额」与手机屏幕上显示的金额不同。

words.enDefinition: restored to a good working condition after previous use

examples.en: My lab partner bought a refurbished laptop with a newly fitted keyboard.
examples.zh: 我的实验搭档买了一台「翻新」笔记本电脑，键盘是新换的。

examples.en: The shop displays refurbished tablets beside the counter for students to try.
examples.zh: 店家把「翻新」平板摆在柜台旁，方便学生试用。

words.enDefinition: a substitute product restored and checked for use after prior use or return

examples.en: The manufacturer offered a refurbished replacement for my old monitor while it reviewed the warranty.
examples.zh: 厂商审核保修时，提出给我的旧显示器换一台「翻新替换品」。

examples.en: I asked whether the refurbished replacement would arrive with a different charging cable.
examples.zh: 我问「翻新替换品」送来时会不会配另一种充电线。

words.enDefinition: a standard cut with a moderate amount of extra room

examples.en: I tried the regular fit before comparing it with the slimmer jacket.
examples.zh: 我先试穿了「常规版型」，再和更修身的夹克比较。

examples.en: The trousers in regular fit had enough room for me to sit comfortably.
examples.zh: 「常规版型」的裤子有足够余量，坐着也舒服。

words.enDefinition: Items shown because they are similar to or connected with the one being viewed.

examples.en: I found the correct notebook refills in the related products section below the main photo.
examples.zh: 我在主图下方的「相关商品」栏里找到了合适的笔记本内页。

examples.en: The related products included several mounts designed for the same type of reading lamp.
examples.zh: 「相关商品」中有几种为同类阅读灯设计的底座。

words.enDefinition: a cut that provides extra room for comfort and movement

examples.en: The relaxed fit felt better when I lifted my arms in the mirror.
examples.zh: 我对着镜子抬了抬胳膊，觉得「宽松版型」穿着更舒服。

examples.en: The clerk showed me jeans with a relaxed fit through the hips.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了一条臀部采用「宽松版型」的牛仔裤。

collocations: a relaxed fit through the hips

words.enDefinition: to post an item for sale again

examples.en: The first buyer changed her mind, so I decided to relist an item.
examples.zh: 第一个买家改了主意，所以我决定「重新刊登商品」。

examples.en: The marketplace lets sellers relist an item when their original listing has expired.
examples.zh: 原来的帖子过期后，平台允许卖家「重新刊登商品」。

collocations: relist an item after a cancellation
relist an item at a lower price
relist an item with new photos

words.enDefinition: the part of an original warranty period that has not yet elapsed

examples.en: I asked about the remaining warranty before paying for the used coffee machine.
examples.zh: 为二手咖啡机付款之前，我问了「剩余保修期限」。

examples.en: The receipt listed the remaining warranty for the replacement item separately from its price.
examples.zh: 收据把替换品的「剩余保修期限」与价格分开列出。

words.enDefinition: To take a selected item out of an online purchase list.

examples.en: I clicked “Remove from cart” after noticing I had selected the same folder twice.
examples.zh: 发现重复选了同款文件夹后，我点了「移出购物车」。

examples.en: The “Remove from cart” option appeared beneath each of the items I had selected.
examples.zh: 我选的每件商品下方都显示了「移出购物车」选项。

words.enDefinition: the date when an existing membership is due to start another term

examples.en: The email confirmed my renewal date after I switched from the monthly plan.
examples.zh: 我换掉按月方案后，邮件确认了「会员续期日」。

examples.en: I put the renewal date in my calendar so it wouldn't surprise me during exams.
examples.zh: 我把「会员续期日」写进日历，免得考试期间突然遇到续费。

words.enDefinition: to put an item back into packaging, often for sending it back

examples.en: I had to repack the item because the original box had torn at one corner.
examples.zh: 原盒有一角破了，我只好「重新包装商品」。

examples.en: The instructions explained how to repack the item without leaving the charger out.
examples.zh: 说明写明了如何「重新包装商品」，以免漏放充电器。

collocations: repack the item in its box

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of what needs repair and whether the work is feasible

examples.en: The shop's repair assessment described the damaged hinge and the available replacement options.
examples.zh: 维修店的「维修评估」说明了铰链损坏的情况及可选的替换方案。

examples.en: I waited for the repair assessment before deciding whether to replace the printer.
examples.zh: 我等拿到「维修评估」，再决定是不是换掉打印机。

words.enDefinition: a community event where volunteers help people mend broken belongings

examples.en: A volunteer at the repair café showed me my thrifted lamp worked again.
examples.zh: 「社区修理聚会」上的一位志愿者让我看了看，我淘来的灯又能亮了。

examples.en: The student union advertised a repair café beside the furniture swap on Saturday.
examples.zh: 学生会宣传了周六的「社区修理聚会」，地点就在家具交换活动旁边。

collocations: bring an item to a repair café

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that the work on a product has finished

examples.en: The message showed repair complete and included the opening hours for pickup that week.
examples.zh: 消息显示「维修已完成」，并附上了当周可取件的营业时间。

examples.en: I saw repair complete in the app while I was waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 我等公交时，在应用里看到了「维修已完成」。

words.enDefinition: a slip listing an item accepted for repair and details of the job

examples.en: The repair docket described the cracked case and gave me a collection reference.
examples.zh: 「维修登记凭单」写明了外壳开裂的情况，还给了一个领取编号。

examples.en: I kept the repair docket in my notebook until the monitor was ready.
examples.zh: 我把「维修登记凭单」夹在笔记本里，直到显示器修好。

words.enDefinition: a promise to address certain problems related to recently completed repair work

examples.en: The shop included a repair guarantee with the receipt for the keyboard repair.
examples.zh: 维修店在键盘维修凭条上附上了一份「维修质量保证」。

examples.en: I read the repair guarantee before calling the technician about the loose hinge again.
examples.zh: 我先读了「维修质量保证」，才再次联系维修人员咨询松动的铰链。

words.enDefinition: a record of the previous repairs carried out on a product

examples.en: The technician looked up the repair history before suggesting a different replacement part.
examples.zh: 维修人员先查了「历次维修记录」，才提出用另一种替换零件。

examples.en: I requested the repair history when the same problem returned during final exams.
examples.zh: 期末考试期间同一问题再次出现时，我索要了「历次维修记录」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing work on the item has started but is unfinished

examples.en: The app displayed repair in progress after the shop received the replacement keyboard.
examples.zh: 维修店收下替换键盘后，应用显示「正在维修」。

examples.en: The repair in progress message gave no date for when the laptop would be ready.
examples.zh: 「正在维修」的消息没有写笔记本电脑哪天能修好。

words.enDefinition: the process of receiving and recording an item for repair

examples.en: The technician photographed the laptop during repair intake and asked about the damaged hinge.
examples.zh: 维修人员在「维修收件登记」时给笔记本电脑拍照，并问了铰链损坏的情况。

examples.en: The shop printed a separate receipt at repair intake after checking the serial number.
examples.zh: 店家核对序列号后，在「维修收件登记」时打印了一张单独的收件凭条。

words.enDefinition: a reference used to identify a particular repair in a service system

examples.en: I wrote the repair job number on the envelope with my warranty documents.
examples.zh: 我把「维修任务编号」写在放保修文件的信封上。

examples.en: The technician asked for the repair job number before checking the estimated finish date.
examples.zh: 维修人员先问了「维修任务编号」，再查询预计完成日期。

collocations: look up a repair job number

words.enDefinition: wording introducing when a repair estimate will no longer be valid

examples.en: The message read repair quote expires on Friday, above the revised estimate for parts.
examples.zh: 消息在修订后的零件报价上方写着周五「维修报价到期」。

examples.en: I added the date after repair quote expires to my calendar before calling the shop.
examples.zh: 给店里打电话前，我把「维修报价到期」后面的日期记进了日历。

collocations: repair quote expires on the stated date
check when a repair quote expires

words.enDefinition: the time taken from receiving an item for repair until completing the work

examples.en: I asked about the repair turnaround time before leaving the monitor at the shop.
examples.zh: 我先问了「送修到完成所需时间」，才把显示器留在店里。

examples.en: The repair turnaround time increased when the replacement hinge was no longer in stock.
examples.zh: 替换铰链缺货后，「送修到完成所需时间」变长了。

words.enDefinition: a battery put in place of one that no longer works

examples.en: The seller had fitted a replacement battery to the watch before listing it.
examples.zh: 卖家在挂出手表前，已经装上了「替换电池」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the used camera needed a replacement battery soon.
examples.zh: 室友问这台二手相机是不是很快就需要「替换电池」。

words.enDefinition: a message confirming that the seller has arranged a replacement shipment

examples.en: The replacement confirmation listed the chair cushion that hadn't arrived in the box.
examples.zh: 「补发确认通知」上列出了箱子里没收到的坐垫。

examples.en: I reread the replacement confirmation to check which address the retailer had used.
examples.zh: 我重新看了「补发确认通知」，核对零售商用的是哪个地址。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that the replacement has been sent

examples.en: The case page displayed “replacement dispatched” after the store had corrected the address.
examples.zh: 店家改正地址后，工单页面显示「补发商品已寄出」。

examples.en: I saw “replacement dispatched” when I checked the app after class on Thursday.
examples.zh: 周四下课后我查看应用，看到了「补发商品已寄出」。

words.enDefinition: an item sent or offered to take the place of another purchase

examples.en: The replacement item reached my dorm before the shop updated the tracking link.
examples.zh: 商店还没更新追踪链接，「替换商品」就送到了我的宿舍。

examples.en: I checked that the replacement item used the same charger as the original.
examples.zh: 我确认了「替换商品」和原商品使用相同的充电器。

words.enDefinition: an order to send a substitute for an item that was lost, damaged, or incorrect

examples.en: The seller created a replacement order after confirming that the first parcel was damaged.
examples.zh: 卖家确认第一个包裹损坏后，创建了「补发订单」。

examples.en: I copied the replacement order number into my calendar entry for the delivery.
examples.zh: 我把「补发订单」的编号抄进了日历上的收货事项里。

words.enDefinition: a delivery sent to replace or supply an affected order item

examples.en: The seller confirmed the replacement shipment would contain just the missing table legs.
examples.zh: 卖家确认，「补发的货件」里只有漏发的桌腿。

examples.en: I checked whether the replacement shipment could go to the campus mail desk.
examples.zh: 我确认了「补发的货件」能不能寄到学校的邮件收发台。

collocations: a replacement shipment for the missing items

words.enDefinition: A new tip designed to replace a worn or damaged one on a pen or stylus.

examples.en: I looked for a replacement tip for the stylus I use to annotate lecture slides.
examples.zh: 我想给用来批注课件的触控笔买一个「替换笔尖」。

examples.en: The product gallery showed the replacement tip alongside the stylus it was made for.
examples.zh: 商品图片库把「替换笔尖」和它适配的触控笔放在一起展示。

collocations: a replacement tip for a stylus

words.enDefinition: a code used to follow a replacement parcel in transit

examples.en: The replacement tracking number arrived in a separate email from the retailer.
examples.zh: 零售商另发了一封邮件，给了「补发包裹的物流单号」。

examples.en: I copied the replacement tracking number from the support message into my notes.
examples.zh: 我把客服消息里的「补发包裹的物流单号」复制到了笔记里。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a seller cannot currently provide a replacement item

examples.en: My order page said replacement unavailable after the shop stopped carrying that colour.
examples.zh: 商店不再销售那个颜色后，我的订单页显示「暂无替换商品」。

examples.en: The seller sent a replacement unavailable notice after checking both warehouses for my size.
examples.zh: 卖家查看两座仓库有没有我的尺码后，发来了「暂无替换商品」的通知。

words.enDefinition: a complete product supplied to replace a faulty or damaged one

examples.en: The repair centre sent a replacement unit after it inspected the broken power switch.
examples.zh: 维修中心检查损坏的电源开关后，寄来了一台「用于替换的整机」。

examples.en: I compared the serial number on the replacement unit with the one in the email.
examples.zh: 我把「用于替换的整机」上的序列号和邮件中的号码对了一下。

words.enDefinition: a warranty covering the unit supplied in place of an earlier one

examples.en: The replacement unit warranty was explained separately from the coverage for my original monitor.
examples.zh: 商家单独说明了「替换整机的保修」，与原显示器的保障分开。

examples.en: I asked if the replacement unit warranty covered the charger packed with it.
examples.zh: 我问「替换整机的保修」是否包括随附的充电器。

words.enDefinition: the amount a used item could sell for

examples.en: The tutor said the lens had a reasonable resale value even after years of use.
examples.zh: 老师说，那支镜头用了多年，还有不错的「转售价值」。

examples.en: When our couch faded in the sun, its resale value dropped considerably.
examples.zh: 沙发被阳光晒褪色后，「转售价值」大幅下降。

words.enDefinition: to sell something that you have bought or received

examples.en: I plan to resell my desk after the end of term.
examples.zh: 我打算学期结束后「转售」自己的书桌。

examples.en: The group collects old bicycles to repair and resell through its workshop.
examples.zh: 这个小组收集旧自行车，在工坊修好后再「转售」。

words.enDefinition: to post an item that did not arrive with the rest

examples.en: I asked the shop to resend the missing item to the same address.
examples.zh: 我请店家把「漏寄的商品补发」到同一个地址。

examples.en: The seller offered to resend the missing item after checking the packing slip.
examples.zh: 卖家核对装箱单后，提出「补发漏寄的商品」。

collocations: offer to resend the missing item
agree to resend the missing item

words.enDefinition: a service that sets an item aside for purchase in person

examples.en: I chose reserve and collect so I could look at the jacket first.
examples.zh: 我选了「线上预留到店取货」，这样可以先看一下夹克。

examples.en: The shop's reserve and collect page let me choose a branch near campus.
examples.zh: 店家的「线上预留到店取货」页面让我选了学校附近的门店。

words.enDefinition: to send the parcel again after an earlier sending problem

examples.en: The retailer offered to reship the parcel after finding its address label was unreadable.
examples.zh: 零售商发现地址标签无法辨认后，提出「重新寄出包裹」。

examples.en: The agent asked whether to reship the parcel to my term-time address.
examples.zh: 客服问要不要把「包裹重新寄」到我学期内住的地址。

collocations: reship the parcel to a new address

words.enDefinition: a platform area for managing disputes and claims

examples.en: I opened the resolution center to see the seller's reply to my claim.
examples.zh: 我打开「纠纷处理中心」，查看卖家对我申请的回复。

examples.en: The notice linked to the resolution center rather than the general help page.
examples.zh: 通知链接到的是「纠纷处理中心」，不是普通帮助页面。

collocations: a message in the resolution center

words.enDefinition: to send a reply on or before a stated deadline

examples.en: The message asked me to respond by Friday if I had more photos.
examples.zh: 消息说，如果我还有照片，要「最晚周五回复」。

examples.en: I emailed the seller because the case asked me to respond by noon.
examples.zh: 工单要求我「最晚中午回复」，所以我给卖家发了邮件。

collocations: ask the seller to respond by Friday

words.enDefinition: showing no reply was received by the expected time

examples.en: The case page showed “response overdue” beside the seller's last message.
examples.zh: 工单页面在卖家的最后一条消息旁显示「回复已超期」。

examples.en: I saw “response overdue” when checking whether the marketplace had heard from the seller.
examples.zh: 我在查看平台有没有收到卖家消息时，看到了「回复已超期」。

collocations: a case with a response overdue

words.enDefinition: a fee a retailer may charge for accepting and restocking a returned item

examples.en: The employee explained why the order page listed a restocking fee for the monitor.
examples.zh: 店员解释了为什么显示器的订单页列有「退货入库费」。

examples.en: I compared the restocking fee at both shops before deciding where to order.
examples.zh: 决定去哪里下单前，我比较了两家店的「退货入库费」。

words.enDefinition: to start using a membership again after it was paused

examples.en: The app showed a button to resume your membership on the plan settings page.
examples.zh: 应用在方案设置页显示了「恢复会员资格」按钮。

examples.en: The email said you could resume your membership whenever you returned to campus.
examples.zh: 邮件说，只要回到学校，就可以「恢复会员资格」。

words.enDefinition: a promise from the seller to handle specified faults with purchased goods

examples.en: The shop offered a retailer warranty on the refurbished monitor I needed for class.
examples.zh: 店里为我上课需要的翻新显示器提供「零售商保修」。

examples.en: I checked which address to use for repairs covered by the retailer warranty.
examples.zh: 我确认了「零售商保修」范围内的维修要寄到哪个地址。

words.enDefinition: to send back the original purchase and place a separate new order

examples.en: The cashier suggested I return and reorder because the larger model had a different price.
examples.zh: 大一号的型号价格不同，收银员建议我「退货后重新下单」。

examples.en: I chose to return and reorder after finding the correct size on the website.
examples.zh: 我在网站上找到合适的尺码后，选择「退货后重新下单」。

collocations: offer to let someone return and reorder
return and reorder in another size

words.enDefinition: a status showing the seller accepted a request to return an item

examples.en: The order page showed return approved after I uploaded a picture of the box.
examples.zh: 我上传盒子的照片后，订单页面显示「退货已获准」。

examples.en: The next email said return approved and included a map of nearby drop-off locations.
examples.zh: 下一封邮件写着「退货已获准」，并附有附近交寄点的地图。

words.enDefinition: a scannable code used to identify a return or confirm its authorization

examples.en: The attendant scanned the return barcode from my phone at the parcel counter.
examples.zh: 工作人员在包裹柜台扫描了我手机上的「退货条码」。

examples.en: I saved the return barcode in case my connection failed inside the shop.
examples.zh: 我先保存了「退货条码」，以防店里网络断开。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the retailer has finished processing the return

examples.en: The account only showed return completed once the replacement was handed to the courier.
examples.zh: 替换商品交给快递员后，账户才显示「退货已办结」。

examples.en: I saved the screen showing return completed before I closed the browser window.
examples.zh: 关闭浏览器窗口前，我保存了显示「退货已办结」的页面。

words.enDefinition: a message verifying receipt or acceptance of a request to return goods

examples.en: I received a return confirmation before downloading the label for the package that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，我先收到「退货确认通知」，然后下载了包裹标签。

examples.en: The return confirmation showed one listed item instead of the two I had selected.
examples.zh: 「退货确认通知」上只列了一件商品，我本来选了两件。

words.enDefinition: the last date by which an item can be returned

examples.en: I put the return deadline in my calendar as soon as the package arrived.
examples.zh: 包裹一到，我就把「退货截止日」记进了日历。

examples.en: The email listed a different return deadline from the date shown in the app.
examples.zh: 邮件列出的「退货截止日」与应用里显示的日期不同。

words.enDefinition: the act of leaving a return parcel at a designated location

examples.en: I planned my return drop-off for the walk home from the library that evening.
examples.zh: 我打算那晚从图书馆走回家的路上完成「到指定点交退件」。

examples.en: The parcel shop printed a receipt after my return drop-off on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我周六上午完成「到指定点交退件」后，包裹代收点打印了一张收据。

words.enDefinition: a purchase or situation subject to different rules from the usual return policy

examples.en: The cashier pointed out a return exception for personalised items on the receipt.
examples.zh: 收银员指出收据上有一条关于定制品的「退货例外情形」。

examples.en: The listed return exception affected how long I had to send the item back.
examples.zh: 列出的「退货例外情形」影响了我可以寄回商品的时间。

words.enDefinition: a form used to give the seller information about a returned item

examples.en: The return form asked me to explain which size I was sending back.
examples.zh: 「退货表格」要求我说明要寄回哪个尺码。

examples.en: I filled in the return form before checking the label on the new box.
examples.zh: 我先填好了「退货表格」，才查看新盒子上的标签。

words.enDefinition: a check of a returned item's condition or contents

examples.en: The seller performed a return inspection before deciding whether a cable was missing.
examples.zh: 卖家先做了「退货查验」，才确定是否少了一根线。

examples.en: The return inspection confirmed that the serial number matched the original order details.
examples.zh: 「退货查验」确认序列号与原订单详情一致。

words.enDefinition: directions from a seller explaining how to send or bring an item back

examples.en: The return instructions said which documents to put inside the padded envelope with the cable.
examples.zh: 「退货说明」写明了要把哪些文件和线缆一起放进缓冲信封。

examples.en: I saved the return instructions on my phone before heading to the drop-off shop.
examples.zh: 去代收点前，我把「退货说明」存到了手机里。

words.enDefinition: to take a purchase back to a different branch of the same retailer

examples.en: The cashier said I could return it to another branch closer to my flat.
examples.zh: 收银员说，我可以把它「退到另一家门店」，离我住的地方更近。

examples.en: I checked whether I could return it to another branch with the original receipt.
examples.zh: 我确认了是否可以凭原始收据把它「退到另一家门店」。

collocations: ask to return it to another branch
allow a customer to return it to another branch
choose to return it to another branch

words.enDefinition: official approval from a seller to return merchandise, often identified by a number

examples.en: I printed the return merchandise authorization before bringing the monitor to the service desk.
examples.zh: 我先打印了「退货授权」，才把显示器带到服务台。

examples.en: The seller emailed the return merchandise authorization along with the package label that evening.
examples.zh: 当天晚上，卖家将「退货授权」和包裹标签一起发来。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying the retailer is not asking for the item back

examples.en: The seller sent a replacement with a note saying “Return not required” for the damaged shade.
examples.zh: 卖家寄了一个替换件，附带的说明写着损坏的灯罩「无需寄回商品」。

examples.en: I saved the “Return not required” message beside the email confirming my refund.
examples.zh: 我把「无需寄回商品」的消息与退款确认邮件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: materials or a container used to pack an item being sent back

examples.en: I checked whether the store could send return packaging for the fragile lamp.
examples.zh: 我问商店能否给易碎台灯寄来「退货用包装」。

examples.en: The return packaging included a padded insert that held the glass shade in place.
examples.zh: 「退货用包装」里有一块软垫，可以固定玻璃灯罩。

words.enDefinition: collection of a returned item from the customer's address

examples.en: The large desk required a return pickup because it could not fit in my car.
examples.zh: 书桌太大，装不进我的车，需要「上门取退件」。

examples.en: I moved the return pickup to Friday because my flatmates would be home.
examples.zh: 室友周五会在家，我就把「上门取退件」改到那天。

words.enDefinition: an online service used to register and manage returns

examples.en: I opened the return portal from the order details page during my lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休时，我从订单详情页打开了「退货办理页面」。

examples.en: The return portal didn't show the item until I selected the right order date.
examples.zh: 我选对订单日期后，「退货办理页面」才显示了那件商品。

collocations: submit a return through the return portal

words.enDefinition: the postage charged for sending a purchase back to a retailer

examples.en: The website said the buyer would pay return postage for a change of mind.
examples.zh: 网站说，如果是买家改变主意，「退货邮费」由买家承担。

examples.en: I asked whether my refund would include return postage for the wrong item.
examples.zh: 卖家发错了货，我问退款是否会包含「退货邮费」。

words.enDefinition: the explanation a customer gives for sending a purchase back

examples.en: I had to choose a return reason before the website generated a label.
examples.zh: 我得先选「退货原因」，网站才会生成标签。

examples.en: The return reason on the form was different from the one I had entered.
examples.zh: 表格上的「退货原因」和我填写的不一样。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the seller has taken delivery of the returned item

examples.en: The app showed return received the morning after the package reached the warehouse.
examples.zh: 包裹到达仓库的次日上午，应用显示「退货已收到」。

examples.en: I saved the return received update until the refund appeared in my account.
examples.zh: 我留着「退货已收到」的进度通知，直到退款入账。

words.enDefinition: an identifier used by a seller to find a particular return

examples.en: The clerk found my parcel after I gave the return reference number by phone.
examples.zh: 我在电话上报出「退货查询编号」后，办事员找到了我的包裹。

examples.en: I wrote the return reference number next to the dates in my notebook.
examples.zh: 我把「退货查询编号」记在笔记本的日期旁。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the seller declined to accept a return

examples.en: The app showed return rejected before I had a chance to update the photos.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及更新照片，应用就显示「退货申请被拒」。

examples.en: The message marked return rejected included a number to call with questions about my case.
examples.zh: 标为「退货申请被拒」的消息附了一个联系电话，有疑问可以打过去。

words.enDefinition: a customer application asking to return a purchase

examples.en: The seller received my return request before I packed the boots for shipping.
examples.zh: 卖家收到我的「退货申请」后，我才把靴子装箱准备寄出。

examples.en: I added a photo of the broken strap to my return request that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我给「退货申请」附上了断掉的背带照片。

words.enDefinition: conditions that limit which items can be returned or how

examples.en: I read the return restrictions before ordering both sizes for the same event.
examples.zh: 为同一个活动买下两个尺码之前，我看了「退货限制」。

examples.en: The product page showed the return restrictions next to the delivery information at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时，商品页在配送信息旁显示了「退货限制」。

words.enDefinition: a slip sent with a returned item to identify the purchase

examples.en: The clerk found the return slip folded inside the shoe box beneath the tissue.
examples.zh: 办事员在鞋盒衬纸下面找到了折起来的「退货随附单」。

examples.en: I put the return slip beside the charger so it would be easy to see.
examples.zh: 我把「退货随附单」放在充电器旁，这样比较容易看到。

words.enDefinition: the current stage or outcome of a return

examples.en: I checked the return status after the carrier delivered the parcel back to the store.
examples.zh: 承运商把包裹送回商店后，我查看了「退货进度」。

examples.en: The app updated my return status when the warehouse finished checking the returned monitor.
examples.zh: 仓库查验完退回的显示器后，应用更新了我的「退货进度」。

words.enDefinition: the service or information used to follow a parcel being returned

examples.en: The return tracking showed that the parcel had reached a sorting centre overnight.
examples.zh: 「退件物流追踪」显示，包裹夜里已到达分拣中心。

examples.en: I opened the return tracking link after the shop confirmed that my label was valid.
examples.zh: 商店确认我的标签有效后，我打开了「退件物流追踪」链接。

words.enDefinition: a status showing someone is examining a return request or returned item

examples.en: The app said return under review after I sent the seller the requested photos.
examples.zh: 我把卖家要求的照片发去后，应用显示「退货审核中」。

examples.en: I saw return under review on both orders when I checked my account.
examples.zh: 我查看账户时，看到两笔订单都显示「退货审核中」。

words.enDefinition: the length of time a retailer allows a customer to return an item

examples.en: I checked the return window because the shoes were a gift for next month.
examples.zh: 鞋子是下个月要送的礼物，所以我查了「退货期限」。

examples.en: The return window for my headphones ended while I was away from campus.
examples.zh: 我离校期间，耳机的「退货期限」到了。

words.enDefinition: a return requested without presenting the original receipt

examples.en: The store offered a return without a receipt after it looked up my order online.
examples.zh: 店里在线查到我的订单后，提出可以办理「无凭条退货」。

examples.en: I asked how a return without a receipt would appear in my account.
examples.zh: 我问「无凭条退货」会怎样显示在我的账户里。

collocations: accept a return without a receipt
process a return without a receipt
request a return without a receipt

words.enDefinition: a status stating that the service provider sent an item back without repairing it

examples.en: The tracking page showed “Returned without repair” after the manufacturer inspected the monitor.
examples.zh: 生产商检查显示器后，追踪页面显示「未经维修已退回」。

examples.en: A note marked “Returned without repair” explained that the replacement part was no longer available.
examples.zh: 标为「未经维修已退回」的说明写着，替换零件已无法供应。

words.enDefinition: a refund given without asking the customer to send the item back

examples.en: The seller offered a returnless refund for the cracked dish I had photographed.
examples.zh: 我给裂开的盘子拍了照片，卖家给出了「免退货退款」方案。

examples.en: I checked the returnless refund message to see whether the seller wanted the packaging back.
examples.zh: 我查看了「免退货退款」消息，确认卖家是否要求退回包装。

words.enDefinition: a counter where shop staff process returned items and exchanges

examples.en: The returns counter moved closer to the entrance while the shop was being refurbished.
examples.zh: 商店翻修期间，「退换货柜台」挪到了更靠近入口的位置。

examples.en: I showed the order number at the returns counter and waited for the clerk.
examples.zh: 我在「退换货柜台」出示了订单号，然后等办事员处理。

words.enDefinition: a facility where returned merchandise is received, checked, and processed

examples.en: The parcel reached the returns warehouse two days after I sent it back.
examples.zh: 包裹寄出两天后到达了「退货处理仓库」。

examples.en: The returns warehouse checked that the serial number matched the one on the order.
examples.zh: 「退货处理仓库」核对了序列号与订单上的编号是否一致。

words.enDefinition: covered again with new fabric or leather on padded furniture

examples.en: We bought a reupholstered armchair after seeing the new green fabric in person.
examples.zh: 我们现场看了新换的绿色布料，买下了这把「重新包过面」的扶手椅。

examples.en: The seller showed me an older photo of the reupholstered dining chairs.
examples.zh: 卖家给我看了这些「重新包过面」的餐椅以前的照片。

words.enDefinition: to check a student's eligibility again after an earlier check

examples.en: The store said it needed to reverify student status at the start of term.
examples.zh: 商店说，开学时需要「重新核验学生身份」。

examples.en: I read the instructions on how to reverify student status after changing universities.
examples.zh: 转学后，我看了有关怎样「重新核验学生身份」的说明。

words.enDefinition: The total number of reviews shown for an item.

examples.en: The review count was low because the blue version had appeared on the site recently.
examples.zh: 蓝色版本最近刚上架，所以「评价数量」不多。

examples.en: I chose to look at the review count before reading the longer written comments.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「评价数量」，再去读较长的文字评论。

words.enDefinition: The short title at the top of a customer review.

examples.en: The review headline mentioned the short cord, and the comment explained why it mattered.
examples.zh: 「评价标题」提到了线缆短，正文解释了这为什么重要。

examples.en: The form let me add a review headline after describing how I used the lamp.
examples.zh: 我写完台灯的使用情况后，表单允许我补写「评价标题」。

words.enDefinition: to examine information supporting the different accounts of a dispute

examples.en: The platform said someone would review the evidence before issuing a decision.
examples.zh: 平台说会有人先「查阅证据材料」，然后作出决定。

examples.en: I asked if the supervisor could review the evidence from both messages.
examples.zh: 我问主管能不能「查阅两条消息里的证据材料」。

collocations: review the evidence from both sides
ask staff to review the evidence
take time to review the evidence

words.enDefinition: A product review that includes one or more photographs from the reviewer.

examples.en: A review with photos showed how the small lamp clipped onto a narrow shelf.
examples.zh: 一条「带图评价」展示了小灯是怎么夹在窄架上的。

examples.en: I left a review with photos showing the notebook after a semester of daily use.
examples.zh: 我发了一条「带图评价」，照片里是每天使用、用了一学期后的笔记本。

words.enDefinition: To look through an order and check its details before submitting it.

examples.en: The page said “Review your order” above the list of colors and quantities we had chosen.
examples.zh: 页面在我们选好的颜色和数量列表上方写着「核对订单」。

examples.en: I noticed the “Review your order” step was still available before I submitted the purchase.
examples.zh: 提交购买前，我留意到还可以回到「核对订单」这一步。

collocations: be prompted to review your order

words.enDefinition: an updated prediction of costs after the quoted work or its requirements change

examples.en: The revised estimate included an additional cable that was missing from the first quote.
examples.zh: 「修订后的报价」增加了第一份报价里没列的一根线。

examples.en: I asked the shop to email the revised estimate before ordering the replacement screen.
examples.zh: 我请店家先通过邮件发来「修订后的报价」，再订购替换屏幕。

words.enDefinition: a list of goods or benefits that members can claim as rewards

examples.en: I checked the reward catalogue for something my flatmate could use on campus.
examples.zh: 我查看了「奖励兑换目录」，想找点室友在学校用得上的东西。

examples.en: The reward catalogue listed cinema tickets and vouchers from several local shops in June.
examples.zh: 六月的「奖励兑换目录」列有电影票和几家本地商店的优惠券。

words.enDefinition: a set of characters entered to claim a particular benefit

examples.en: I copied the reward code from the membership email into the app on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五，我把会员邮件里的「奖励兑换码」复制到应用中。

examples.en: The cashier checked whether the reward code was still active before accepting the voucher.
examples.zh: 收银员先确认「奖励兑换码」是否仍有效，才收下优惠券。

words.enDefinition: a message warning that a reward will soon stop being usable

examples.en: I received a reward expiry reminder about the cinema voucher I'd saved for later.
examples.zh: 我收到了一条「奖励到期提醒」，说的是我留着以后用的电影券。

examples.en: The reward expiry reminder included a link to the list of participating branches.
examples.zh: 「奖励到期提醒」附有参加活动的门店列表链接。

words.enDefinition: a business that offers rewards or accepts benefits from another organization's programme

examples.en: I looked for a reward partner that sold the cinema tickets near campus.
examples.zh: 我找了一家出售校园附近电影票的「奖励合作商家」。

examples.en: The app listed the café as a reward partner for the summer term.
examples.zh: 应用把那家咖啡馆列为夏季学期的「奖励合作商家」。

collocations: spend vouchers with a reward partner

words.enDefinition: a status indicating a benefit has already been claimed or used

examples.en: The screen showed reward redeemed next to the voucher after I paid for lunch.
examples.zh: 我付完午餐钱后，屏幕在券旁显示「奖励已兑换」。

examples.en: I saved the reward redeemed confirmation because the cashier's receipt was hard to read.
examples.zh: 收银台的小票看不清，我保存了「奖励已兑换」的确认信息。

words.enDefinition: the process of using points or an entitlement to claim a benefit

examples.en: The reward redemption showed in my activity history on the next business day.
examples.zh: 「奖励兑换」在下一个工作日出现在我的活动记录里。

examples.en: The store's reward redemption page listed which items were available for the term.
examples.zh: 商店的「奖励兑换」页面列出了本学期可兑换的商品。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a listed reward cannot currently be claimed

examples.en: The app said reward unavailable after the partner shop used its last cinema voucher.
examples.zh: 合作商店发完最后一张电影券后，应用显示「奖励目前不可用」。

examples.en: I saw reward unavailable beside the item when I opened the catalogue that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上打开目录时，我看到商品旁写着「奖励目前不可用」。

words.enDefinition: a voucher issued through a programme to give the member a benefit

examples.en: I used a reward voucher when I picked up the order at the store.
examples.zh: 我在门店取货时用了一张「奖励兑换券」。

examples.en: The reward voucher appeared underneath my membership barcode on the phone screen.
examples.zh: 手机屏幕上，「奖励兑换券」显示在我的会员条码下方。

words.enDefinition: a page showing a member's points, offers, and reward activity

examples.en: I checked the rewards dashboard before deciding whether to use the voucher at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时决定要不要用优惠券前，我查看了「奖励管理页面」。

examples.en: My rewards dashboard still showed the bookmark I had saved before replacing my phone.
examples.zh: 换了手机之后，我的「奖励管理页面」仍显示之前收藏的那项奖励。

words.enDefinition: to enter items in a cash register and calculate what is owed

examples.en: The cashier offered to ring up the plates and towels together.
examples.zh: 收银员提出把盘子和毛巾一起「录入结账」。

examples.en: Could you ring up the notebooks before you scan the rest of the items?
examples.zh: 您能先把笔记本「录入结账」，再扫其他商品吗？

words.enDefinition: enough space under a garment to wear other clothes

examples.en: I wanted room to layer a thick jumper under my new coat.
examples.zh: 我想让新大衣有足够的「叠穿余量」，里面能穿一件厚毛衣。

examples.en: This size gave me room to layer without leaving the shoulders too loose.
examples.zh: 这个尺码给我留了「叠穿余量」，肩膀也不会太松。

words.enDefinition: enough extra space to move comfortably in clothing

examples.en: I bent my elbows to see if the jacket gave me room to move.
examples.zh: 我弯了弯胳膊，看看这件夹克有没有足够的「活动余量」。

examples.en: The larger shirt gave me room to move without pulling at the sleeves.
examples.zh: 大一点的那件衬衫有「活动余量」，动起来袖子不会被拉扯。

collocations: have plenty of room to move

words.enDefinition: to cause friction at the back of my foot

examples.en: The boots began to rub against my heel after a few steps.
examples.zh: 走了几步，这双靴子就开始「磨我的脚后跟」。

examples.en: I could feel the stiff edge rub against my heel as I walked.
examples.zh: 我走路时能感觉鞋边硬硬的，「磨我的脚后跟」。

collocations: start to rub against my heel
seem to rub against my heel
feel the shoe rub against my heel

words.enDefinition: to fit larger than the stated size would usually suggest

examples.en: The assistant said the shirts run large compared with last year's cut.
examples.zh: 店员说，这款衬衫比去年的版型「尺码偏大」。

examples.en: These jeans run large on me even though I usually buy this size.
examples.zh: 我通常买这个尺码，可穿这款牛仔裤还是觉得「尺码偏大」。

collocations: a style that can run large

words.enDefinition: to fit smaller than the stated size would usually suggest

examples.en: These trousers run small, so I want to try the next size up.
examples.zh: 这款裤子「尺码偏小」，我想试大一码。

examples.en: I asked whether the boots tend to run small in this brand.
examples.zh: 我问这个牌子的靴子是不是普遍「尺码偏小」。

words.enDefinition: A look at products or deals before the sale officially starts.

examples.en: I browsed the sale preview to see whether the calculator I needed would be included.
examples.zh: 我浏览了「促销预览」，想看需要的计算器是否会参加活动。

examples.en: The sale preview showed discounted folders and listed when the promotion would go live online.
examples.zh: 「促销预览」展示了将打折的文件夹，还列出了活动何时在网上开始。

collocations: find something in the sale preview

words.enDefinition: a state in which something is suitable to be sold

examples.en: I asked whether the opened item was still in saleable condition under the store's policy.
examples.zh: 我问店员，按店里的规定，拆过封的商品是否还处于「可再次销售的状态」。

examples.en: The clerk packed the lamp so it would stay in saleable condition during transport.
examples.zh: 办事员把台灯装好，以便它在运输中保持「可再次销售的状态」。

words.enDefinition: an option to collect an order on the day it is placed

examples.en: I checked whether the desk lamp was available for same-day pickup on Friday.
examples.zh: 我查了那盏台灯周五能不能「当日自提」。

examples.en: The app offered same-day pickup before I entered my payment details.
examples.zh: 我还没输入付款信息，应用就显示可以「当日自提」。

collocations: an item available for same-day pickup

words.enDefinition: The identical product offered at another store or on another website.

examples.en: I checked for the same item elsewhere before buying the cover for my lab notebook.
examples.zh: 在买实验记录本的封套前，我查了查「别处有没有卖同款」。

examples.en: My roommate found the same item elsewhere after searching for the lamp's exact model number.
examples.zh: 室友按准确的台灯型号搜索，「在别处找到了同款」。

collocations: check for the same item elsewhere
see the same item elsewhere for less

words.enDefinition: an outcome that addresses the problem well enough to be accepted

examples.en: The customer did not consider a generic apology a satisfactory resolution.
examples.zh: 顾客觉得一句笼统的道歉算不上「令人满意的解决结果」。

examples.en: I reached a satisfactory resolution once the missing parts arrived at reception.
examples.zh: 缺少的零件送到前台后，我得到了「令人满意的解决结果」。

words.enDefinition: To keep an item on a separate list without buying it now.

examples.en: I used “Save for later” because I still needed to measure the shelf in my room.
examples.zh: 我用了「保存供日后购买」，因为还得量一下房间里的架子。

examples.en: The “Save for later” list held the other color while I ordered the green cover.
examples.zh: 我下单买绿色封套时，另一种颜色还留在「保存供日后购买」的列表里。

collocations: move something to the save for later list

words.enDefinition: to use a reader to identify a product by its printed code

examples.en: The attendant asked me to scan the barcode on the back of the notebook.
examples.zh: 自助收银员叫我「扫笔记本背面的商品条码」。

examples.en: I couldn't scan the barcode because the sticker was partly folded.
examples.zh: 贴纸有一点折起来了，所以我没法「扫商品条码」。

collocations: ask staff to scan the barcode

words.enDefinition: The amount shown by a store system after an item's barcode is scanned.

examples.en: The scanned price for the notebook was higher than the amount shown on the shelf label.
examples.zh: 笔记本「扫码显示的价格」高于货架标签上的金额。

examples.en: I used the shop's price scanner to check the scanned price before walking to the counter.
examples.zh: 去柜台前，我用店里的查价机查看了「扫码显示的价格」。

collocations: a mismatch with the scanned price

words.enDefinition: To look for an item online by typing its model identifier.

examples.en: I chose to search by model number because the store had several nearly identical chargers.
examples.zh: 这家店有好几款几乎一模一样的充电器，所以我选择「按型号搜索」。

examples.en: The site lets you search by model number when looking for a matching tablet cover.
examples.zh: 在该网站查找配套的平板保护套时，可以「按型号搜索」。

collocations: an option to search by model number
search by model number on the site

words.enDefinition: The items or pages shown after a user searches for something.

examples.en: The search results included both the lamp itself and spare bulbs for the same model.
examples.zh: 「搜索结果」既包括整盏灯，也包括同款灯的备用灯泡。

examples.en: I scrolled through the search results and noticed several cases for the previous tablet model.
examples.zh: 我浏览了「搜索结果」，发现有好几款上一代平板的保护套。

words.enDefinition: a place online where people buy and sell used items

examples.en: Our flatmate found a used kitchen table on a local secondhand marketplace.
examples.zh: 室友在本地「二手交易平台」上找到了一张旧餐桌。

examples.en: I check the secondhand marketplace whenever someone in our flat needs a lamp.
examples.zh: 我们公寓里有人需要台灯时，我就会去「二手交易平台」看看。

words.enDefinition: a tag attached to goods to help prevent theft at a store

examples.en: The cashier noticed the security tag as she folded the jacket.
examples.zh: 收银员折夹克时注意到了上面的「商品防盗标签」。

examples.en: I showed the receipt after finding a security tag still on my coat.
examples.zh: 我发现大衣上还有「商品防盗标签」，就出示了收据。

collocations: a jacket with a security tag

words.enDefinition: to look at an item directly in the same place

examples.en: I'd like to see it in person because the fabric looks different in each photo.
examples.zh: 我想「当面看实物」，因为每张照片里的布料看起来都不一样。

examples.en: Can I see it in person before you take the listing down this evening?
examples.zh: 你今天傍晚撤掉帖子前，我能「当面看一下实物」吗？

collocations: ask to see it in person
want to see it in person
see it in person before paying

words.enDefinition: To pick the shade or color option wanted for an item.

examples.en: I had to select a color before the site showed which sizes were available.
examples.zh: 我得先「选择颜色」，网站才会显示有哪些尺寸可以买。

examples.en: The listing asked me to select a color even though the main photo showed only black.
examples.zh: 虽然主图只展示黑色，商品页还是让我「选择颜色」。

collocations: select a color before adding an item
select a color from the menu

words.enDefinition: to choose the store where your order is to be collected

examples.en: I had to select a pickup store before reaching the last page.
examples.zh: 我得先「选择自提门店」，才能进入最后一页。

examples.en: The site asked me to select a pickup store from the map.
examples.zh: 网站让我在地图上「选择自提门店」。

collocations: select a pickup store near you
select a pickup store at checkout
be asked to select a pickup store

words.enDefinition: Restricts an offer to the specific products listed or marked by the seller.

examples.en: The label “Selected items only” explained why the larger desk lamp was still full price.
examples.zh: 「仅限指定商品」的标牌说明了为什么大号台灯仍按原价卖。

examples.en: I saw “Selected items only” above the picture of the discounted pen set online.
examples.zh: 我在网上打折套笔的图片上方看到了「仅限指定商品」。

collocations: a sign reading selected items only
an offer marked selected items only
a sale on selected items only

words.enDefinition: a website area where customers can handle tasks without staff help

examples.en: I checked the self-service portal first to see whether my case had changed.
examples.zh: 我先到「自助服务入口」查看工单有没有变化。

examples.en: The self-service portal let me attach a photo without starting a new chat.
examples.zh: 在「自助服务入口」，我可以附上照片，不用重新开启聊天。

collocations: sign in to the self-service portal

words.enDefinition: to sell goods for their owners and take a share

examples.en: The vintage shop offered to sell on consignment for students leaving in June.
examples.zh: 复古店表示，可以给六月离校的学生提供「寄卖」服务。

examples.en: The charity fair did not accept books to sell on consignment that year.
examples.zh: 那一年，慈善集市不接收用于「寄卖」的书。

collocations: sell on consignment through a shop

words.enDefinition: an update stating that the seller verified part of the case

examples.en: The seller has confirmed that the spare screw should have been included.
examples.zh: 「卖家已经确认」，本该附上备用螺丝。

examples.en: Support wrote that the seller has confirmed which item was in the second parcel.
examples.zh: 客服写道，「卖家已经确认」第二个包裹里是哪件商品。

collocations: the seller has confirmed the details
the seller has confirmed the address
the seller has confirmed what was sent

words.enDefinition: A score reflecting customers' experiences with a seller rather than an individual product.

examples.en: I checked the seller rating because two shops offered the same lamp on the marketplace.
examples.zh: 交易平台上两家店都卖这款台灯，所以我查看了「卖家评分」。

examples.en: The seller rating appeared beside the shop name, above the stars for the individual notebook.
examples.zh: 「卖家评分」在店名旁边，位置高于这款笔记本的星级评分。

collocations: a seller rating based on recent orders

words.enDefinition: restored to working order by or for the seller

examples.en: The old radio was listed as seller refurbished after the shop repaired it.
examples.zh: 店家修好旧收音机后，在商品页上标注了「卖家翻新」。

examples.en: The camera is marked seller refurbished because the shop replaced a damaged switch.
examples.zh: 那家店换过相机的坏开关，所以标了「卖家翻新」。

words.enDefinition: A public reply from the seller to a shopper's review or product question.

examples.en: The seller response explained which refills fitted the older version of the notebook cover.
examples.zh: 「卖家回复」说明了旧版笔记本封套适用哪些替换内页。

examples.en: A seller response beneath one review gave the dimensions of the larger storage tray.
examples.zh: 一条评价下方的「卖家回复」给出了大号收纳托盘的尺寸。

collocations: a seller response to a review

words.enDefinition: the share of a sale kept by the person selling it

examples.en: The consignment shop explained its seller's commission before I left the coat.
examples.zh: 我把外套留在寄卖店前，店家说明了他们收取的「寄卖佣金」。

examples.en: The chair sold quickly, and the seller's commission was listed on the receipt.
examples.zh: 椅子很快卖出，收据上列了「寄卖佣金」。

words.enDefinition: Individual packages used to send different parts of the same order.

examples.en: The page showed that the lamp and the spare bulbs would arrive in separate packages.
examples.zh: 页面显示，台灯和备用灯泡会通过「分开的包裹」送达。

examples.en: My notebook and the matching refill set came in separate packages on different days.
examples.zh: 我的笔记本和配套替芯放在「不同包裹」里，在不同的日子送达。

words.enDefinition: two or more purchases rung up and paid for separately

examples.en: We asked for separate transactions because the notebooks belonged to my roommate.
examples.zh: 那些笔记本是室友的，所以我们要求「分开结账」。

examples.en: The cashier processed separate transactions for my groceries and the club's supplies.
examples.zh: 收银员把我买的食品和社团用品「分开结账」。

collocations: ring items up in separate transactions

words.enDefinition: agreement between a device's serial number and the one recorded for it

examples.en: The clerk confirmed a serial number match before processing the return at the desk.
examples.zh: 办事员确认「序列号核对一致」后，才在柜台办理退货。

examples.en: The seller waited for a serial number match on the tablet before issuing any credit.
examples.zh: 卖家等这台平板的「序列号核对一致」后，才发放购物额度。

collocations: check for a serial number match

words.enDefinition: a set of serial numbers lying between listed starting and ending values

examples.en: The recall notice gave a serial number range underneath each affected product model.
examples.zh: 召回通知在每个受影响的产品型号下列出了「序列号范围」。

examples.en: I matched the sticker on my device to the serial number range in the notice.
examples.zh: 我把设备贴纸上的号码与通知中的「序列号范围」做了比对。

collocations: fall within the serial number range

words.enDefinition: a separately purchased agreement to provide specified maintenance or repair services

examples.en: The shop offered a service contract for the printer while I was at the checkout.
examples.zh: 我在结账时，商店为这台打印机提供了「付费维修服务合约」选项。

examples.en: I asked what the service contract would cover after the original warranty ended.
examples.zh: 我问原保修期结束后，「付费维修服务合约」会涵盖什么。

words.zhGloss: 维修代用设备借用协议
words.enDefinition: a written agreement governing temporary use of a device during service
acceptedZhAnswers: 维修代用设备借用协议

examples.en: I signed the service loan agreement before taking the spare laptop back to campus.
examples.zh: 我签了「维修代用设备借用协议」，才把备用笔记本电脑带回校园。

examples.en: The service loan agreement listed the charger as part of the kit to return.
examples.zh: 「维修代用设备借用协议」把充电器列为应归还的配件。

collocations: terms of the service loan agreement

words.enDefinition: a record authorizing or tracking a particular product service or repair

examples.en: The service order listed the device's condition when I brought it to the shop.
examples.zh: 「维修服务单」记录了我把设备送到店里时的状况。

examples.en: The clerk added the missing charger to the notes on my service order.
examples.zh: 店员在我的「维修服务单」备注里补写了未随机器送来的充电器。

words.enDefinition: a written record of the work and findings from a product service visit

examples.en: The service report showed which parts had been checked by the engineer that morning.
examples.zh: 「检修报告」列出了工程师当天上午检查过的部件。

examples.en: I compared the service report with the work described on the original repair estimate.
examples.zh: 我把「检修报告」与原维修报价上描述的工作做了对照。

words.enDefinition: Dell's identifier for finding a specific device in its support system

examples.en: I found the Service Tag beside the barcode on the underside of my Dell laptop.
examples.zh: 我在戴尔笔记本电脑底面的条形码旁找到了「设备服务编号」。

examples.en: The agent used the Service Tag to find my Dell monitor in her system.
examples.zh: 客服用「设备服务编号」在系统里找到了我的戴尔显示器。

words.enDefinition: to keep an item apart from regular stock for someone to collect

examples.en: The assistant said the books were set aside for collection behind the counter.
examples.zh: 店员说，那些书「已留货待取」，放在柜台后。

examples.en: The chair had been set aside for collection by the midday shift.
examples.zh: 中午当班的店员已经把椅子放到「留货待取」的位置。

collocations: a parcel set aside for collection
get an order set aside for collection

words.enDefinition: a tag on a shelf identifying the product kept there

examples.en: I read the shelf label to check that I had the right notebook.
examples.zh: 我看了「货架标签」，确认拿的是我要找的笔记本。

examples.en: The larger boxes were blocking the shelf label for the USB cables.
examples.zh: 那些大盒子挡住了 USB 线的「货架标签」。

collocations: match a product to its shelf label

words.enDefinition: The price displayed near an item on a store shelf.

examples.en: I took a photo of the shelf price before asking which folders were included in the offer.
examples.zh: 我先拍下「货架标价」，再询问哪些文件夹参加优惠。

examples.en: The shelf price applied to the smaller pack of paper on the next row.
examples.zh: 「货架标价」适用于下一排的小包装纸。

collocations: a difference between the shelf price and the receipt

words.enDefinition: The available methods for sending a purchased item to the buyer.

examples.en: The shipping options appeared after I entered the postal code for my student residence.
examples.zh: 我输入学生宿舍的邮编后，页面显示了「配送选项」。

examples.en: I checked the shipping options early because I needed the folder before our workshop.
examples.zh: 因为研讨活动前就需要文件夹，我提前查看了「配送选项」。

words.enDefinition: Limits on which items can be sent or where they can be delivered.

examples.en: The product page listed shipping restrictions for a few colors made at a different warehouse.
examples.zh: 商品页列出了由另一个仓库供货的几种颜色的「配送限制」。

examples.en: I read the shipping restrictions before sending the art supplies to my friend's residence hall.
examples.zh: 给朋友的宿舍楼寄美术用品前，我查看了「配送限制」。

words.enDefinition: A listing label introducing the location from which an item will be sent.

examples.en: The line marked “Ships from” gave a different location than the shop’s mailing address.
examples.zh: 「发货地」一栏所列的地点与店铺通信地址不同。

examples.en: I looked at “Ships from” to see whether the notebook would come from a local warehouse.
examples.zh: 我查看了「发货地」，想知道笔记本是否从本地仓库发货。

collocations: check where an item ships from

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the estimated wait before an item is sent.

examples.en: The listing said “Ships in two days” rather than giving an exact arrival date.
examples.zh: 商品页写的是「预计两天后发货」，没有给出具体送达日期。

examples.en: I saw “Ships in one week” after choosing the print with my name on it.
examples.zh: 选了印自己姓名的印刷画后，我看到「预计一周后发货」。

collocations: a listing marked ships in two days
read ships in beside the estimate
a message saying ships in two weeks

words.enDefinition: the area of a large store where shoes are sold

examples.en: The shoe department was at the back of the store near the stairs.
examples.zh: 「鞋类区」在店铺后面，靠近楼梯。

examples.en: I compared two pairs in the shoe department after looking at the display.
examples.zh: 看完展示后，我在「鞋类区」对比了两双鞋。

words.enDefinition: To browse a store by groups such as stationery, lighting, or storage.

examples.en: I chose “Shop by category” to find storage supplies without searching for a specific item.
examples.zh: 我选了「按商品分类选购」，不用搜索某件具体商品就找到了收纳用品。

examples.en: The page offered a shop by category menu with a separate section for stationery.
examples.zh: 页面提供了「按商品分类选购」菜单，其中有单独的文具分类。

collocations: a link marked shop by category

words.enDefinition: the part of a shop where customers browse merchandise

examples.en: I checked the shop floor before asking a member of staff for help.
examples.zh: 我先在「门店销售区」找了一圈，才请店员帮忙。

examples.en: Only one lamp was left on the shop floor by late afternoon.
examples.zh: 到了傍晚前，「门店销售区」只剩下一盏台灯。

collocations: bring something onto the shop floor

words.enDefinition: a small container carried around a shop while choosing goods

examples.en: I grabbed a shopping basket because I was buying only a few things.
examples.zh: 我只买几样东西，就拿了个「手提购物篮」。

examples.en: I left the empty shopping basket beside the stack near the door.
examples.zh: 我把空的「手提购物篮」放回门边那摞篮子旁。

collocations: put something in your shopping basket

words.enDefinition: a shipment containing fewer units than were supposed to be sent

examples.en: The agent called it a short shipment after comparing the photos with the invoice.
examples.zh: 客服对照照片和发票后，说这是「发货数量不足」。

examples.en: The seller asked for a photo of the contents to review the short shipment.
examples.zh: 卖家要包裹内容物的照片，以便核查「发货数量不足」的情况。

words.enDefinition: to present the message sent about collecting an order

examples.en: I was asked to show the pickup email when I reached the counter.
examples.zh: 我到柜台时，店员请我「出示自提邮件」。

examples.en: The assistant said I could show the pickup email on my phone.
examples.zh: 店员说我可以在手机上「出示自提邮件」。

collocations: ask someone to show the pickup email
show the pickup email on your phone
be ready to show the pickup email

words.enDefinition: to appear as an entry in a financial statement

examples.en: The adviser said the refund could show up on a statement under the seller's name.
examples.zh: 顾问说，退款可能会以卖家名称「显示在对账单上」。

examples.en: I waited for the exchange charge to show up on a statement before checking the total.
examples.zh: 我等换货费「显示在对账单上」后，才核对总额。

collocations: show up on a statement as a credit
wait for a payment to show up on a statement
show up on a statement next month

words.enDefinition: to present a barcode used to identify an order at pickup

examples.en: The notice said to show your pickup barcode at the side counter.
examples.zh: 通知说要在侧面的柜台「出示取货条码」。

examples.en: “Please show your pickup barcode,” the assistant said when I reached the counter.
examples.zh: 我到柜台时，店员说「请出示取货条码」。

collocations: show your pickup barcode on your phone
be asked to show your pickup barcode

words.enDefinition: Shown alongside something familiar so viewers can judge the item's size.

examples.en: There was a pencil shown for scale beside the organizer in the second picture.
examples.zh: 第二张图片里，收纳架旁有一支铅笔「用于展示大小比例」。

examples.en: A hand was shown for scale, and I could tell the lamp base was tiny.
examples.zh: 图里有一只手「用于展示大小比例」，我看得出台灯底座非常小。

words.enDefinition: visible marks showing that something has been used or worn

examples.en: I photographed the soles because they already showed signs of wear when the shoes arrived.
examples.zh: 鞋送到时鞋底就有「使用磨损痕迹」，所以我拍了照。

examples.en: The clerk found no signs of wear and accepted the jacket for return.
examples.zh: 办事员没看到「使用磨损痕迹」，就接受了夹克的退货。

words.enDefinition: A promotion code that can be redeemed only once.

examples.en: The store sent a single-use code with the email announcing the winter notebook sale.
examples.zh: 店铺在通知冬季笔记本促销的邮件里附了一个「一次性优惠码」。

examples.en: I saved the single-use code until I knew which case would fit my tablet.
examples.zh: 我先留着「一次性优惠码」，等确定哪个保护套适合我的平板再用。

collocations: a single-use code for an order

words.enDefinition: to choose a smaller size than the one first considered

examples.en: I decided to size down after trying the two jackets side by side.
examples.zh: 把两件夹克都试过以后，我决定「选小一码」。

examples.en: The jumper already felt loose, so I wanted to see what happened if I did size down.
examples.zh: 这件套头衫已经有些松了，我想看看「选小一码」效果如何。

collocations: size down for a closer fit

words.enDefinition: a return in which the customer receives a different size of the same product

examples.en: I requested a size exchange for the jacket after trying it on at home.
examples.zh: 我在家试穿夹克后，申请了「更换尺码」。

examples.en: The shop processed the size exchange as soon as the smaller pair came back in stock.
examples.zh: 小一号的鞋一到货，商店就办理了「更换尺码」。

words.enDefinition: to choose a larger size than the one first considered

examples.en: I usually size up when I buy a jacket to wear over sweaters.
examples.zh: 买夹克打算套在毛衣外面时，我通常「选大一码」。

examples.en: The attendant asked whether I wanted to size up in that style.
examples.zh: 服务员问我这款要不要「选大一码」。

collocations: size up for a looser fit

words.enDefinition: a checkout option for an item placed outside the bagging area

examples.en: I saw a “Skip bagging” option beside the picture of the large box.
examples.zh: 我在大盒子的图片旁看到了「跳过装袋」的选项。

examples.en: The attendant pointed out “Skip bagging” on the screen beside my shopping.
examples.zh: 收银员指给我看，屏幕上、我的商品旁边有「跳过装袋」。

words.enDefinition: a cut that sits closer to the body than standard clothing

examples.en: The assistant brought a slim fit shirt for me to compare with mine.
examples.zh: 店员拿来一件「修身版型」的衬衫，让我和自己那件对比。

examples.en: I preferred the slim fit until I tried reaching over my head.
examples.zh: 我原本更喜欢「修身版型」，试着把手举过头顶后就改主意了。

words.enDefinition: a slight hollow made by a hit or pressure

examples.en: The listing mentioned a small dent in the door of the mini fridge.
examples.zh: 商品页提到小冰箱门上有一处「小凹痕」。

examples.en: I noticed a small dent near the handle when I picked up the case.
examples.zh: 我拎起箱子时，看到提手附近有一处「小凹痕」。

words.enDefinition: a household where people do not smoke indoors

examples.en: The listing said the curtains came from a smoke-free home near campus.
examples.zh: 帖子上说，这些窗帘来自校园附近的一个「无烟家庭」。

examples.en: The seller said the books had always been kept in a smoke-free home.
examples.zh: 卖家说，这些书一直放在一个「无烟家庭」里。

words.enDefinition: Available only as a group of items that are sold together.

examples.en: The two drawers were sold as a set even though I needed only the shorter one.
examples.zh: 那两个抽屉是「成套出售」的，虽然我只需要较矮的那个。

examples.en: The listing said the matching folders were sold as a set of six in total.
examples.zh: 商品页注明，这些配套的文件夹每六个一组「成套出售」。

collocations: listed as sold as a set
marked sold as a set online

words.enDefinition: No longer available to buy because all the available units have been sold.

examples.en: The small white lamp was sold out, but the black version was still available.
examples.zh: 小号白色台灯「已售罄」，黑色款仍然可以买到。

examples.en: The page said the planner was sold out after I selected the illustrated cover.
examples.zh: 我选了带插图的封面后，页面显示手账「已售罄」。

words.enDefinition: Available as a separate purchase and excluded from the item being viewed.

examples.en: The picture showed a cable, but the description said it was sold separately online.
examples.zh: 图片里有一根线，但说明写着它在网上「另售」。

examples.en: I noticed the handle was sold separately after reading the notes below the main photo.
examples.zh: 我读了主图下的说明，才注意到提手是「另售」的。

words.enDefinition: a purchase document issued to a different shopper

examples.en: I found someone else's invoice in the box and contacted the seller.
examples.zh: 我在箱子里发现了「别人的购物发票」，于是联系了卖家。

examples.en: The package contained someone else's invoice even though my name was on it.
examples.zh: 包裹上写的是我的名字，里面却是「别人的购物发票」。

collocations: find someone else's invoice in the parcel
a box containing someone else's invoice

words.enDefinition: To place recently added products at the beginning of a list.

examples.en: I used the option to sort by newest when browsing designs for this semester's planner.
examples.zh: 浏览本学期手账的款式时，我用了「按上新时间排序」选项。

examples.en: The menu let me sort by newest, so the latest lamp designs appeared first.
examples.zh: 我可以通过菜单「按上新时间排序」，这样最新款的台灯就会显示在最前面。

collocations: set results to sort by newest

words.enDefinition: To arrange a list of products according to how much they cost.

examples.en: I chose to sort by price after limiting the results to the correct calculator model.
examples.zh: 我把结果筛到只剩正确的计算器型号后，选择了「按价格排序」。

examples.en: The site lets me sort by price even when I have several brands selected.
examples.zh: 即使已经选了多个品牌，我仍能在这个网站「按价格排序」。

collocations: a menu to sort by price
sort by price before comparing models

words.enDefinition: To order results by how closely they match a search.

examples.en: I chose to sort by relevance after searching for a binder that fits narrow shelves.
examples.zh: 搜索适合窄层架的活页夹后，我选择了「按相关性排序」。

examples.en: The site will sort by relevance unless another order is selected from the menu.
examples.zh: 除非在菜单里另选一种顺序，网站会「按相关性排序」。

collocations: set results to sort by relevance

words.enDefinition: indicating that an additional key comes with the item

examples.en: The ad said spare key included in the details for the bike lock.
examples.zh: 那把自行车锁的广告详情写着「附有备用钥匙」。

examples.en: I noticed spare key included at the bottom of the post about the cabinet.
examples.zh: 我在橱柜帖子的底部看到了「附有备用钥匙」。

words.enDefinition: a component kept or sold to replace a damaged or worn part

examples.en: Our lab technician kept a spare part for the mixer in the cupboard beside the sink.
examples.zh: 实验室技术人员在水槽旁的橱柜里为搅拌机留了一个「备用零件」。

examples.en: The technician found the correct spare part after checking the model in her catalogue.
examples.zh: 维修人员在目录里核对型号后，找到了合适的「备用零件」。

words.enDefinition: to talk to a real person instead of an automated system

examples.en: I chose to speak to a human after the menu repeated itself.
examples.zh: 语音菜单开始重复后，我选了「找人工客服」。

examples.en: “Can I speak to a human?” I typed when the bot misunderstood my question.
examples.zh: 机器人误解了我的问题，我打字问「能转人工客服吗？」

collocations: ask to speak to a human
choose to speak to a human
wait to speak to a human

words.enDefinition: A deal giving buyers a temporary advantage, such as a lower price or an extra item.

examples.en: The shop posted a special offer on the folders we needed for the group presentation.
examples.zh: 店铺为我们小组展示需要的文件夹发布了「特别优惠」。

examples.en: I found a special offer that included spare clips with the planner I had chosen.
examples.zh: 我发现一项「特别优惠」，我选的手账会随附备用夹子。

collocations: take advantage of a special offer

words.zhGloss: 多种支付方式分别退款
words.enDefinition: a refund divided across the payment methods originally used for a purchase
acceptedZhAnswers: 多种支付方式分别退款

examples.en: The receipt listed two amounts because the transaction was a split-tender refund at checkout.
examples.zh: 柜台办理的是「多种支付方式分别退款」，所以收据列了两个金额。

examples.en: The cashier checked which card belonged to the order before processing a split-tender refund.
examples.zh: 收银员先核对哪张卡用于这笔订单，再办理「多种支付方式分别退款」。

words.enDefinition: A product placement that appears because the seller paid to promote it.

examples.en: The first sponsored listing appeared above the desk lamps that matched my search terms.
examples.zh: 第一条「付费推广商品条目」显示在符合我搜索词的台灯上面。

examples.en: I spotted the sponsored listing by the label next to the model's name on the page.
examples.zh: 我看到页面上型号名称旁的标识，认出了「付费推广商品条目」。

collocations: a sponsored listing near the top
mark an item as a sponsored listing

words.enDefinition: To use more than one eligible discount on the same purchase.

examples.en: I checked whether the bookstore would let me stack discounts on the calculator I needed.
examples.zh: 我想买那台计算器，先查了书店是否允许「叠加使用折扣」。

examples.en: The site let me stack discounts for two promotions on the same stationery order.
examples.zh: 网站允许我在同一个文具订单上把两个活动的「折扣叠加使用」。

words.enDefinition: to combine several rewards in the same purchase or redemption

examples.en: I asked whether I could stack rewards with my birthday voucher on this order.
examples.zh: 我问这笔订单能否和生日券一起「叠加使用奖励」。

examples.en: The shop showed which offers let members stack rewards on the same purchase.
examples.zh: 商店列出了哪些优惠允许会员在同一笔消费中「叠加使用奖励」。

words.enDefinition: a checkout run by a cashier rather than by customers

examples.en: I chose a staffed checkout because my umbrella had no barcode on it.
examples.zh: 我的伞上没有条码，所以我去了「人工收银台」。

examples.en: The sign pointed towards a staffed checkout at the end of the aisle.
examples.zh: 标牌指向过道尽头的一个「人工收银台」。

collocations: a staffed checkout near the exit

words.enDefinition: someone who runs a stall at a market

examples.en: I asked the stallholder if I could see the other plates.
examples.zh: 我问「摊主」能不能让我看看其他盘子。

examples.en: The stallholder put a sold sign on the wooden chair after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，「摊主」在木椅上放了块已售的牌子。

words.enDefinition: A score shown as a number of stars on a rating scale.

examples.en: I noticed the star rating in the results before opening the page for the organizer.
examples.zh: 打开收纳架页面之前，我就留意到了搜索结果里的「星级评分」。

examples.en: The form asked me to give a star rating before writing about the pencil case.
examples.zh: 表单要求我先给「星级评分」，再写对这个笔袋的评价。

words.enDefinition: to begin the process of sending a purchase back

examples.en: I used the order page to start a return for the lamp on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日，我在订单页为那盏台灯「发起退货」。

examples.en: She asked how to start a return without signing into the store's website.
examples.zh: 她问不用登录商店网站，怎样「发起退货」。

collocations: start a return in the app

words.enDefinition: the lowest amount at which bidding opens in an auction

examples.en: The starting bid for the bicycle was lower than I expected that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，那辆自行车的「起拍价」比我预想的低。

examples.en: I checked the starting bid before adding the camera auction to my list.
examples.zh: 我查看了「起拍价」，才把相机的拍卖加入关注列表。

words.enDefinition: Surprise or dismay on discovering that a price is much higher than expected.

examples.en: I felt sticker shock when I saw how much the required calculator cost new.
examples.zh: 看到课上指定计算器的全新售价时，我「被高价吓了一跳」。

examples.en: The cost of the replacement cartridges gave us sticker shock during our project planning.
examples.zh: 规划项目时，替换墨盒的价格让我们「吓了一跳」。

words.enDefinition: being examined without a result or decision yet

examples.en: The shop said my order problem was still under investigation on Friday.
examples.zh: 店家说，截至周五，我的订单问题「仍在调查中」。

examples.en: I got a message saying the missing parcel was still under investigation.
examples.zh: 我收到消息，说包裹丢失的情况「仍在调查中」。

collocations: confirm something is still under investigation

words.enDefinition: a room in a shop where extra products are stored

examples.en: The assistant went to the stockroom to look for a second pair.
examples.zh: 店员去了「门店储货间」，看看还有没有第二双。

examples.en: The stockroom was at the back of the shop past the fitting rooms.
examples.zh: 经过试衣间往店铺后面走，就是「门店储货间」。

words.enDefinition: an employee who helps shoppers and works in a store

examples.en: A store associate helped me find the printed order information on the receipt.
examples.zh: 一名「门店店员」帮我找到了收据上印着的订单信息。

examples.en: The store associate asked whether I had ordered through the app or website.
examples.zh: 「门店店员」问我是在应用里还是在网站上下单的。

words.enDefinition: credit given by a retailer that can be used for later purchases there

examples.en: I received store credit after returning a gift that didn't come with its original receipt.
examples.zh: 我退了一件没有原始收据的礼物，获得了「店内购物额度」。

examples.en: The cashier applied my store credit to the backpack I needed for class.
examples.zh: 收银员用我的「店内购物额度」抵扣了上课需要的背包。

words.enDefinition: a sign or guide listing stores and where to find them

examples.en: The store directory by the entrance showed a shoe shop on level two.
examples.zh: 入口处的「商场店铺导览」显示二楼有一家鞋店。

examples.en: I checked the store directory while my roommate looked for the escalator.
examples.zh: 我查看了「商场店铺导览」，室友在找自动扶梯。

collocations: look up a shop in the store directory

words.enDefinition: A sale covering a broad range of items throughout a store.

examples.en: A storewide sale was advertised, so I checked which products were excluded in the smaller print.
examples.zh: 店铺打出了「全店促销」广告，我查看了小字里哪些商品除外。

examples.en: I picked up a lamp and some notebooks during the storewide sale near campus.
examples.zh: 我在校区附近的「全店促销」活动中买了台灯和几本笔记本。

words.enDefinition: A lower price available to buyers who meet a seller's student eligibility terms.
