examples.en: I asked whether the student discount applied to the calculator required for my statistics class.
examples.zh: 我问统计课要求买的计算器能不能用「学生折扣」。

examples.en: The shop listed the student discount separately from the offers available to its other customers.
examples.zh: 店铺把「学生折扣」和向其他顾客提供的优惠分开列了出来。

words.enDefinition: the conditions someone must meet to receive a benefit offered to students

examples.en: I read the student eligibility rules before trying to join with my exchange registration.
examples.zh: 我先看了「学生资格条件」，再尝试用交换生的注册记录加入。

examples.en: The store explained its student eligibility rules next to the form for discounted membership.
examples.zh: 商店在优惠会员表格旁解释了「学生资格条件」。

words.enDefinition: an email address associated with an educational institution and issued for student use

examples.en: The form accepted my student email address before asking for the year I would finish.
examples.zh: 表格接受了我的「学生邮箱地址」，之后问我哪年毕业。

examples.en: I used a different student email address after switching to the other campus.
examples.zh: 转到另一个校区后，我用了不同的「学生邮箱地址」。

words.enDefinition: A label saying that a student identification card is needed to qualify.

examples.en: The placard said “Student ID required” underneath the offer for the smaller scientific calculator.
examples.zh: 告示在小号科学计算器的优惠下方写着「须出示学生证」。

examples.en: I saw “Student ID required” in the promotion details and checked what documents were accepted.
examples.zh: 我在活动详情看到「须出示学生证」，就查看了可以用哪些证件。

collocations: an offer marked student ID required
a sign saying student ID required
read student ID required in the terms

words.enDefinition: membership made available under a programme especially for students

examples.en: I applied for student membership when my university email account was ready to use.
examples.zh: 学校邮箱可以使用后，我申请了「学生会员资格」。

examples.en: The shop explained when my student membership would end after I left university.
examples.zh: 店家解释了我离开学校后，「学生会员资格」什么时候会结束。

words.enDefinition: a price schedule reserved for students, often for a separate plan or product

examples.en: The website displayed student pricing after I verified my university email address.
examples.zh: 验证学校邮箱地址后，网站显示了「学生专属定价」。

examples.en: I compared the student pricing with the standard monthly plan before signing up.
examples.zh: 注册前，我把「学生专属定价」与普通月费方案作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a product sent in place of what was ordered

examples.en: The seller explained why a substituted item had appeared in the order summary.
examples.zh: 卖家解释了订单总览为什么出现了一件「替代发货的商品」。

examples.en: I asked whether the substituted item had the same dimensions as the original.
examples.zh: 我问那件「替代发货的商品」和原来那件的尺寸是否相同。

words.enDefinition: a loss of colour caused by exposure to sunlight

examples.en: I noticed sun fading along the back of the sofa by the window.
examples.zh: 我发现靠窗的沙发背上有一片「日晒褪色」的痕迹。

examples.en: The curtain listing mentioned sun fading where the fabric faced the street.
examples.zh: 窗帘的商品页注明，面向街道的一侧有「日晒褪色」。

words.enDefinition: a second look at an issue or decision by a supervisor

examples.en: I asked for a supervisor review after receiving two different answers about the package.
examples.zh: 包裹的事得到两种不同答复后，我申请了「主管复核」。

examples.en: The page showed that the request had moved to supervisor review that morning.
examples.zh: 页面显示，那天上午申请已转入「主管复核」。

collocations: send a case for supervisor review

words.enDefinition: the email address used for requests for help

examples.en: I found the support email address at the bottom of my order confirmation.
examples.zh: 我在订单确认邮件的底部找到了「客服邮箱地址」。

examples.en: The store gave me a different support email address for online purchases.
examples.zh: 门店给了我另一个「客服邮箱地址」，处理线上购物问题。

collocations: write to the support email address

words.enDefinition: earlier contacts and requests recorded by a support team

examples.en: The agent looked through my support history before asking for the order number.
examples.zh: 客服先看了我的「客服联系记录」，然后才问订单号。

examples.en: I checked my support history to find the request about the desk leg.
examples.zh: 我查了「客服联系记录」，找那笔和桌腿有关的申请。

words.enDefinition: the times when people can reach a support team

examples.en: I checked the support hours before trying to reach someone after my seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课结束后，我先查了「客服在线时间」，再试着联系。

examples.en: The support hours on the website differed from the hours on my receipt.
examples.zh: 网站上的「客服在线时间」和我的收据上写的不一样。

words.enDefinition: an inbox where support messages are collected or displayed

examples.en: The reply appeared in my support inbox rather than in my email.
examples.zh: 回复出现在我的「客服收件箱」里，电子邮箱里没有。

examples.en: I opened the support inbox to read the seller's response on the platform.
examples.zh: 我打开平台上的「客服收件箱」，查看卖家的回复。

collocations: a message in the support inbox

words.enDefinition: a tracked request for help with a particular problem

examples.en: I opened a support ticket after the shop asked for more information.
examples.zh: 店家要求补充信息后，我创建了一个「客服工单」。

examples.en: The photos were attached to my support ticket by the next morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，我的「客服工单」里已经附上了照片。

words.enDefinition: The equipment models an item is made to work with.

examples.en: My tablet was near the bottom of the list of supported models for the cover.
examples.zh: 我的平板在这个保护套的「支持型号」列表靠下的位置。

examples.en: The adapter came with a link to a complete list of supported models online.
examples.zh: 那个适配器附有一个链接，可以在网上查看完整的「支持的型号」列表。

collocations: show supported models on the page

words.enDefinition: to exchange one thing for a different item

examples.en: I brought old novels to the fair to swap for books from my list.
examples.zh: 我把旧小说带到集市上，想「换取」清单里的书。

examples.en: I've got two used textbooks I could swap for a spare lamp.
examples.zh: 我有两本旧课本，可以「换取」一盏闲置台灯。

collocations: what to swap for a bike

words.enDefinition: an event where people meet to trade or sell goods

examples.en: I traded two of my old games at the student swap meet.
examples.zh: 我在学生「物品交换集市」上把两款旧游戏换了出去。

examples.en: Our neighbourhood swap meet had several tables of books people could trade.
examples.zh: 我们社区的「物品交换集市」摆了好几桌供人交换的书。

collocations: bring items to a swap meet

words.enDefinition: to remove a post offering something for sale

examples.en: I'll take down a listing once the buyer has collected the last dining chair.
examples.zh: 买家把最后一把餐椅取走后，我就会「撤下商品帖子」。

examples.en: I asked the moderator how to take down a listing after noticing a duplicate.
examples.zh: 发现同一商品发了两遍后，我问管理员怎么「撤下商品帖子」。

collocations: take down a listing after a sale
ask someone to take down a listing
take down a listing from a marketplace

words.expression: take it for a test ride
words.lemma: take it for a test ride
words.enDefinition: to ride a vehicle briefly to check how it feels
acceptedEnVariants: take it for a test ride

examples.en: Can I take it for a test ride to see whether the frame fits me properly?
examples.zh: 我能「骑上去试一圈」，看看车架的尺寸合不合适吗？

examples.en: She liked the saddle and asked if she could take it for a test ride after class.
examples.zh: 她喜欢这个车座，就问能不能下课后「骑上去试一圈」。

collocations: ask to take it for a test ride
let someone take it for a test ride
take it for a test ride around the block

words.enDefinition: a checkout instruction to collect your printed proof of payment

examples.en: The screen displayed “Take your receipt” before returning to the first page.
examples.zh: 屏幕回到首页前显示「请取走收据」。

examples.en: I heard “Take your receipt” while I was putting away my wallet.
examples.zh: 我在收钱包时听到「请取走收据」的提示。

collocations: a reminder to take your receipt

words.enDefinition: clothing sizes proportioned for people taller than average

examples.en: I asked about tall sizing because the sleeves stopped above my wrists.
examples.zh: 袖子短到手腕上方，我就问有没有「高个子尺码」。

examples.en: The shop stocked two coat styles in tall sizing on the upstairs rail.
examples.zh: 楼上的挂架上有两款「高个子尺码」的大衣。

collocations: check whether tall sizing is available

words.enDefinition: comments written by the person who inspected or repaired a product

examples.en: The clerk read the technician's notes before explaining why the fan was replaced.
examples.zh: 店员先看了「维修人员记录」，再解释为什么换了风扇。

examples.en: I asked for the technician's notes after the screen started flickering for a second time.
examples.zh: 屏幕第二次开始闪烁后，我索要了「维修人员记录」。

words.enDefinition: assistance provided over the phone

examples.en: I chose telephone support because it was easier to explain the two separate orders.
examples.zh: 我选择了「电话客服」，因为两个独立订单用电话更好说清楚。

examples.en: The store offers telephone support for both in-store and online purchases.
examples.zh: 在门店和网上买的商品，这家店都提供「电话客服」。

words.enDefinition: checked by trying it and found to operate properly

examples.en: The seller marked the used console as tested and working after playing a game.
examples.zh: 卖家用这台旧游戏机玩了一局后，标注为「经测试可正常使用」。

examples.en: The label on the donated radio said tested and working and gave a date.
examples.zh: 捐赠来的收音机标签写着「经测试可正常使用」，还标了日期。

words.enDefinition: a sample shoppers can use to try a product before buying

examples.en: I found a tester next to the sealed hand creams on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我在货架上还没拆封的护手霜旁找到了「门店试用装」。

examples.en: The assistant pointed to the tester so I could smell the fragrance.
examples.zh: 店员指了指「门店试用装」，让我可以闻一下香味。

words.enDefinition: a program that pays students for their used textbooks

examples.en: The campus textbook buyback had a table near the entrance to the library.
examples.zh: 校园「教材回购」活动在图书馆入口旁设了一张桌子。

examples.en: A friend took last semester's novels to the textbook buyback after the final.
examples.zh: 期末考试结束后，一位朋友把上学期的小说拿去了「教材回购」活动。

words.enDefinition: the reader cannot identify the item from its code

examples.en: “The barcode won't scan,” I said when the cashier came over.
examples.zh: 收银员走过来时，我说「条码扫不出来」。

examples.en: My roommate said the barcode won't scan because the box was creased.
examples.zh: 室友说盒子折出了一道印，导致「条码扫不出来」。

collocations: “This barcode won't scan on the machine”
“The barcode won't scan even when I turn it over”

words.enDefinition: a statement indicating the current listing differs from an earlier version

examples.en: The product page has changed since I placed my order last Monday.
examples.zh: 自从上周一下单后，「商品页面改过了」。

examples.en: I told the seller, “The product page has changed,” and attached my screenshot.
examples.zh: 我告诉卖家「商品页面改过了」，还附上了我的截图。

collocations: “The product page has changed since I ordered”

words.enDefinition: An independent merchant selling through an online retailer's platform.

examples.en: The backpack was listed by a third-party seller on the site my roommate usually uses.
examples.zh: 那款背包是由「第三方卖家」发布在室友常用的网站上的。

examples.en: We checked which third-party seller offered the case in the color we wanted for class.
examples.zh: 我们查看了哪家「第三方卖家」有上课时想用的那个颜色的保护套。

collocations: a third-party seller on the site

words.expression: this is my second time contacting you
words.lemma: this is my second time contacting you
words.zhGloss: 这是我第二次联系你们
words.enDefinition: a way to tell support this is a repeat contact
acceptedZhAnswers: 这是我第二次联系你们
acceptedEnVariants: this is my second time contacting you

examples.en: This is my second time contacting you about the package with the incorrect label.
examples.zh: 关于标签不对的包裹，「这是我第二次联系你们」。

examples.en: “This is my second time contacting you,” I wrote below the reference number.
examples.zh: 我在编号下面写道「这是我第二次联系你们」。

collocations: say “This is my second time contacting you”
“This is my second time contacting you about this order”
“This is my second time contacting you this week”

words.enDefinition: a confirmation that a new support request has entered the system

examples.en: The page showed “ticket created” after I sent details about the missing item.
examples.zh: 我发送漏发商品的详情后，页面显示「工单已创建」。

examples.en: I saved the message that said “ticket created” because it included a reference.
examples.zh: 我保存了显示「工单已创建」的消息，因为里面有一个编号。

collocations: a ticket created after a chat

words.enDefinition: the current stage of a request in a support system

examples.en: I checked the ticket status before contacting the shop a second time.
examples.zh: 第二次联系店家前，我先查了「工单状态」。

examples.en: The ticket status changed after the adviser added the photos to my case.
examples.zh: 客服把照片加到我的工单里后，「工单状态」变了。

words.enDefinition: the required spending or points total for reaching a membership level

examples.en: I checked my shopping receipts to see whether I had reached the tier threshold.
examples.zh: 我查了购物小票，看有没有达到「升档门槛」。

examples.en: Only purchases made after September counted towards the tier threshold for my new account.
examples.zh: 只有九月以后的消费才计入我新账户的「升档门槛」。

collocations: spending that counts towards the tier threshold

words.enDefinition: fitting too closely across the shoulder area

examples.en: The blouse felt tight across the shoulders when I reached for my bag.
examples.zh: 我伸手去够包时，觉得衬衫「肩部紧绷」。

examples.en: I told the attendant it was tight across the shoulders but fine elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我告诉服务员，这件衣服「肩部紧绷」，其他地方都合适。

words.enDefinition: thin, soft paper used to wrap or cushion an item

examples.en: She put blue tissue paper around the scarf before closing the box.
examples.zh: 她合上盒子前，用蓝色「薄页包装纸」包好了围巾。

examples.en: I asked whether they had tissue paper to go inside the gift bag.
examples.zh: 我问他们有没有能放在礼品袋里的「薄页包装纸」。

collocations: use tissue paper in a gift box

words.enDefinition: A label saying that an offer applies during the current day only.

examples.en: The message “Today only” was displayed beside the discounted folders on the bookstore's homepage.
examples.zh: 书店首页上，打折文件夹的旁边显示着「仅限今日」。

examples.en: I noticed “Today only” on the window while waiting for my friend after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后等朋友时，留意到橱窗上写着「仅限今日」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a shoe that surrounds the toes

examples.en: The toe box felt cramped when I stood up in the new shoes.
examples.zh: 穿着新鞋站起来时，我觉得「鞋头里面」很挤。

examples.en: I asked whether the other pair had more room in the toe box.
examples.zh: 我问另外那双的「鞋头内部空间」是不是更宽敞。

words.enDefinition: having trouser legs that extend farther than desired

examples.en: The jeans fitted at the waist but were too long in the leg.
examples.zh: 这条牛仔裤腰部合适，但「裤腿太长」。

examples.en: I said the trousers were too long in the leg even with boots.
examples.zh: 我说就算穿靴子，这条裤子也还是「裤腿太长」。

collocations: be too long in the leg
slightly too long in the leg
trousers that are too long in the leg

words.enDefinition: Rated more highly than most comparable products on a site or list.

examples.en: I looked at a few top-rated lamps before finding one small enough for my shelf.
examples.zh: 我看了几款「评分靠前的」台灯，才找到一款小到能放在架子上的。

examples.en: The site grouped its top-rated pencil cases under a heading near the search results.
examples.zh: 网站把「评分靠前的」笔袋归到搜索结果附近的一个栏目里。

words.enDefinition: the highest surface in a set of shelves

examples.en: The only red umbrella was on the top shelf above the backpacks.
examples.zh: 唯一一把红伞在背包上方「最上层货架」上。

examples.en: Could you get the small blue box from the top shelf for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我从「最上层货架」拿下那个小蓝盒吗？

collocations: put something on the top shelf

words.enDefinition: The combined amount saved through the discounts or reductions shown.

examples.en: The total savings in my cart changed when I removed the second pack of paper.
examples.zh: 我移除第二包纸后，购物车里的「总节省金额」变了。

examples.en: I checked the total savings before comparing the offer with the price at the campus store.
examples.zh: 把优惠和校园商店的价格作比较前，我查看了「总节省金额」。

words.enDefinition: the amount credited for an item exchanged towards a purchase

examples.en: The store checked the screen before confirming my tablet's trade-in value that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，店家检查屏幕后才确定我那台平板的「以旧换新折抵金额」。

examples.en: The quoted trade-in value of the bike was written on the shop receipt.
examples.zh: 店家把给那辆自行车估的「以旧换新折抵金额」写在了收据上。

words.expression: transfer me to the right department
words.lemma: transfer me to the right department
words.enDefinition: to route my call to the team that handles the issue
acceptedEnVariants: transfer me to the right department

examples.en: Could you transfer me to the right department for purchases from your app?
examples.zh: 应用里购买的商品，你能「把我转给负责的部门」吗？

examples.en: I asked her to transfer me to the right department instead of ending the call.
examples.zh: 我请她「把我转给负责的部门」，别把电话挂了。

collocations: could you transfer me to the right department
ask someone to transfer me to the right department
please transfer me to the right department

words.enDefinition: to move points from one member or account to another

examples.en: I checked whether the programme let me transfer points to a family member.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，这个计划是否允许「转移积分」给家人。

examples.en: The clerk asked which account should receive them before agreeing to transfer points.
examples.zh: 店员先问积分转到哪个账户，才同意「转移积分」。

words.enDefinition: a warranty that can pass from the original buyer to a later owner

examples.en: The seller included a transferable warranty with the used laptop I bought for class.
examples.zh: 卖家给我上课用的二手笔记本电脑附了一份「可转让的保修」。

examples.en: I asked whether a transferable warranty went with the camera after it was sold.
examples.zh: 我问相机卖掉后，有没有「可转让的保修」随相机一起转给买家。

words.enDefinition: temporary access to a membership programme for evaluation

examples.en: I started a trial membership to see whether delivery reached our building reliably.
examples.zh: 我开通了「试用会员资格」，想看看配送能否稳定送到我们楼。

examples.en: My trial membership ended just before I placed the first order from home.
examples.zh: 我第一次从家里下单前，「试用会员资格」刚好结束了。

words.enDefinition: A small package size intended for trying a product before buying a larger amount.

examples.en: I bought the trial size because I wanted to test the ink before buying more.
examples.zh: 我买了「试用规格」，因为想先试试这款墨水，再多买些。

examples.en: The shop offered a trial size of the hand cream beside the larger bottle.
examples.zh: 店铺在大瓶旁摆了相同护手霜的「试用规格」。

collocations: a trial size of a product

words.enDefinition: Having the same color as the color shown or advertised.

examples.en: The retailer’s photo was true to color, according to a reviewer who picked yellow.
examples.zh: 一位选了黄色款的评价者说，商家照片「与实物颜色相符」。

examples.en: My roommate said her photos were true to color because she took them in daylight.
examples.zh: 室友说她是在日光下拍的，所以照片「与实物颜色相符」。

collocations: a photo that is true to color

words.enDefinition: fitting about as expected for the standard size on the label

examples.en: These shoes feel true to size compared with the pair I wore in.
examples.zh: 和我穿来的那双相比，这双鞋的「尺码符合预期」。

examples.en: The assistant said the jacket was generally true to size for this brand.
examples.zh: 店员说，这个牌子的这款夹克「尺码通常符合预期」。

collocations: a style that is true to size

words.enDefinition: to test an item before deciding whether to purchase it

examples.en: The instrument shop lets students try before you buy if they make an appointment.
examples.zh: 乐器店允许学生预约后「先试再买」。

examples.en: The notice invited buyers to try before you buy at the campus bike sale.
examples.zh: 告示邀请买家在校园自行车售卖会上「先试再买」。

collocations: option to try before you buy
encourage buyers to try before you buy
room to try before you buy

words.enDefinition: to put on both shoes in a pair to test the fit

examples.en: I asked whether I could try both shoes on before paying.
examples.zh: 我问付款前能不能「两只鞋都试穿」。

examples.en: The shop assistant brought the full pair so I could try both shoes on.
examples.zh: 店员拿来了一整双，让我能「两只鞋都试穿」。

collocations: ask to try both shoes on
let a customer try both shoes on

words.enDefinition: to handle or operate a model on display before buying

examples.en: I asked if I could try the demo before picking a keyboard.
examples.zh: 我挑键盘前问能不能「试用演示样机」。

examples.en: The store assistant invited me to try the demo beside the headphone shelf.
examples.zh: 店员请我「试用耳机货架旁的演示样机」。

collocations: invite someone to try the demo

words.enDefinition: to disable the option that renews a membership or subscription automatically

examples.en: I chose to turn off auto-renewal because I'd be abroad for the next term.
examples.zh: 下学期我要出国，所以决定「关闭自动续费」。

examples.en: The app confirmed I could turn off auto-renewal without losing access that week.
examples.zh: 应用确认，我可以「关闭自动续费」，那一周的使用权限照常保留。

words.enDefinition: A price label saying that two qualifying items cost five units of the stated currency.

examples.en: The sign said “Two for five” with a dollar symbol beside the small notebooks.
examples.zh: 小号笔记本旁的展示牌带有美元符号，写着「两件共五美元」。

examples.en: I read the “Two for five” label before picking two matching folders for our report.
examples.zh: 为报告选两个相配的文件夹之前，我看了「两件合计五元」的价格标签。

collocations: a sign saying two for five

words.enDefinition: work carried out by someone without approval from the relevant service provider

examples.en: The report described the earlier work as an unauthorized repair by an unknown shop.
examples.zh: 报告把之前的工作记为一家不知名店铺所做的「未经授权的维修」。

examples.en: I asked what the warranty wording meant by unauthorized repair on the last page.
examples.zh: 我问保修条款最后一页的「未经授权的维修」指什么。

words.enDefinition: an order still at the shop after its expected collection

examples.en: The shop called about an uncollected order I had placed the previous week.
examples.zh: 店家打电话问我上周那笔「未取走的订单」。

examples.en: I saw an uncollected order from last month when I checked the app.
examples.zh: 我查看应用时，看到上个月有一笔「未取走的订单」。

collocations: follow up on an uncollected order
a reminder about an uncollected order
an uncollected order at the store

words.enDefinition: covered by a warranty that is still in force

examples.en: The headphones were still under warranty when the left side stopped playing sound.
examples.zh: 左边不出声时，这副耳机仍「在保修期内」。

examples.en: I checked whether the charger was under warranty before contacting the shop about it.
examples.zh: 联系商店咨询前，我确认了充电器是不是「在保修期内」。

words.expression: unexpected item in the bagging area
words.lemma: unexpected item in the bagging area
words.zhGloss: 装袋区发现未识别的物品
words.enDefinition: a machine message saying something placed near the bags was not expected
acceptedZhAnswers: 装袋区发现未识别的物品
acceptedEnVariants: unexpected item in the bagging area

examples.en: The display flashed “Unexpected item in the bagging area” when I put my bag down.
examples.zh: 我放下包时，屏幕闪出「装袋区发现未识别的物品」。

examples.en: I saw “Unexpected item in the bagging area” before an attendant came over.
examples.zh: 收银员过来之前，我看到「装袋区发现未识别的物品」的提示。

collocations: a warning saying “Unexpected item in the bagging area”
show “Unexpected item in the bagging area”
an “Unexpected item in the bagging area” message

words.enDefinition: A fit intended to work with many common models rather than one specific model.

examples.en: The page advertised a universal fit for the mount but still listed the supported sizes.
examples.zh: 页面把底座标为「通用适配」，但仍列出了支持的尺寸。

examples.en: A diagram explained the range of devices covered by the mount's universal fit in the listing.
examples.zh: 商品页的示意图说明了底座「通用适配」所涵盖的设备范围。

collocations: a mount with a universal fit

words.enDefinition: still closed in its packaging without having previously been opened

examples.en: The box remained unopened because I noticed the incorrect size on the outside.
examples.zh: 我发现盒子外面标的尺码不对，所以盒子一直「未开封」。

examples.en: I kept the adapter unopened while I waited for the seller to respond.
examples.zh: 等卖家回复的时候，我让转接头一直保持「未开封」。

words.enDefinition: points that a member has earned but has not used for a reward

examples.en: I still had unredeemed points when I checked the balance at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末查余额时，我还有「尚未兑换的积分」。

examples.en: The account page listed my unredeemed points separately from points that had already expired.
examples.zh: 账户页把「尚未兑换的积分」与已经失效的积分分开列出。

words.enDefinition: offered without a check that it works as expected

examples.en: The old tape player was marked untested because it came without batteries.
examples.zh: 旧磁带机没带电池，所以标注为「未经测试」。

examples.en: The listing said the projector was untested, so I asked about the power cable.
examples.zh: 商品页写着投影仪「未经测试」，所以我问了电源线的情况。

words.enDefinition: the state of an item that has not been put to use

examples.en: The jacket was in unused condition because I had only taken it out of the bag.
examples.zh: 我只是把夹克从袋子里取了出来，所以它仍是「未使用状态」。

examples.en: The listing described the charger as being in unused condition with its cable included.
examples.zh: 商品说明写明，充电器处于「未使用状态」，附带线缆。

words.enDefinition: a reward available to a member that has not been applied or claimed

examples.en: I found an unused reward in the app after checking my birthday messages.
examples.zh: 我看过生日消息后，在应用中发现了一项「未使用的奖励」。

examples.en: The expiry reminder showed which unused reward would be removed first from my account.
examples.zh: 到期提醒显示，哪项「未使用的奖励」会最先从我的账户中移除。

words.enDefinition: not previously worn as clothing or footwear

examples.en: The shoes were unworn apart from being briefly tried on indoors that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，那双鞋只在室内试穿了一下，除此之外「没穿过」。

examples.en: The return form asked whether both pairs of trousers were unworn and clean.
examples.zh: 退货表格问，两条裤子是不是都「没穿过」，并且干净。

words.enDefinition: A sale claim saying the largest advertised reduction is half of the stated price.

examples.en: The banner said “Up to 50% off” above a list of desks with different discounts.
examples.zh: 横幅写着「最高减免50%」，下面列的是折扣力度各不相同的书桌。

examples.en: I saw “Up to 50% off” and checked the actual price of my chosen model.
examples.zh: 我看到「最高减免50%」，随后查看了选中型号的实际价格。

collocations: a banner reading up to 50% off
a sale marked up to 50% off

words.enDefinition: made from an older item given a new useful purpose

examples.en: We saw an upcycled lamp made from an old glass bottle.
examples.zh: 我们看到一盏用旧玻璃瓶「升级再造」的灯。

examples.en: An art student sold upcycled tote bags made from discarded curtains.
examples.zh: 一位艺术专业学生卖用废旧窗帘「升级再造」的托特包。

words.enDefinition: To change how many units of a selected item the order contains.

examples.en: I clicked “Update quantity” after my roommate said she also needed a set of folders.
examples.zh: 室友说她也需要一套文件夹后，我点了「更新数量」。

examples.en: The “Update quantity” button changed the number of notebooks without removing my other items.
examples.zh: 「更新数量」按钮改了笔记本的件数，其他商品还留着。

words.enDefinition: having been tried or used on a single occasion

examples.en: The tent was advertised as used once during a weekend trip last summer.
examples.zh: 广告说，这顶帐篷去年夏天周末出游时「只用过一次」。

examples.en: The seller marked the drill used once and included photos of the handle.
examples.zh: 卖家把电钻标为「只用过一次」，还附上了提手的照片。

words.enDefinition: a course book someone owned before it was put up for sale

examples.en: I bought a used textbook from a student who finished the course last term.
examples.zh: 我从上学期修完这门课的同学手里买了本「二手教材」。

examples.en: The shop had one used textbook with the right cover and edition number.
examples.zh: 店里有一本「二手教材」，封面和版次都对。

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the date or time when an offer first applies.

examples.en: The website said the discount was valid from Monday, the first day of classes.
examples.zh: 网站写着折扣「自星期一起有效」，那天是开课第一天。

examples.en: I saw “Valid from noon” on the offer next to the campus bookshop entrance.
examples.zh: 我在校园书店入口旁的优惠告示上看到「自中午起有效」。

collocations: a voucher marked valid from Friday
a notice saying valid from noon

words.enDefinition: A package containing several different versions of a similar item.

examples.en: The variety pack contained four different pen colors that I could use for lecture notes.
examples.zh: 那份「混合组合装」有四种颜色的笔，我上课记笔记时可以用。

examples.en: I bought a variety pack of binder clips to try the different sizes before term.
examples.zh: 开学前我买了一份长尾夹「混合组合装」，想试试不同的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a previous verification is no longer accepted

examples.en: The app showed verification expired even though I was still attending classes that month.
examples.zh: 虽然我那个月还在上课，应用却显示「核验结果已过期」。

examples.en: A verification expired notice appeared when I tried to apply the student rate again.
examples.zh: 我再次尝试使用学生价格时，出现了「核验结果已过期」的通知。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a verification request has yet to be completed

examples.en: The account said verification pending after I uploaded my registration letter on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日上传注册证明后，账户显示「等待核验」。

examples.en: I saw verification pending beside my student membership request when I checked again.
examples.zh: 我再次查看时，看到学生会员申请旁写着「等待核验」。

words.enDefinition: an organization that checks someone meets a programme's eligibility rules

examples.en: The shop sent me to a verification provider to confirm my graduate student status.
examples.zh: 商店把我转给一家「核验服务机构」，以确认我的研究生身份。

examples.en: I checked the name of the verification provider before submitting my enrolment letter.
examples.zh: 递交注册证明前，我先核对了「核验服务机构」的名称。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the submitted details did not pass a verification check

examples.en: The form displayed verification unsuccessful when my old email address no longer matched the records.
examples.zh: 旧邮箱地址与记录不再一致时，表格显示「核验未通过」。

examples.en: I received a message saying “Verification unsuccessful” after leaving out my current term dates.
examples.zh: 我漏填当前学期的起止日期后，收到一条写着「核验未通过」的消息。

words.enDefinition: A label indicating the platform has confirmed a reviewer bought the item through it.

examples.en: The verified purchase label appeared next to a comment about the bag's shoulder strap.
examples.zh: 一条关于背包肩带的评论旁有「已核实购买」标识。

examples.en: I noticed the verified purchase badge when reading a review of the narrow desk lamp.
examples.zh: 看窄款台灯的评价时，我留意到了「已核实购买」标识。

collocations: mark a review as a verified purchase

words.enDefinition: someone whose current student status has been confirmed by a checking process

examples.en: The retailer showed me as a verified student when I opened the account settings.
examples.zh: 我打开账户设置时，零售商显示我为「身份已核验的学生」。

examples.en: Each verified student could see the academic offer on their own shopping account.
examples.zh: 每位「身份已核验的学生」都能在自己的购物账户里看到学生优惠。

collocations: show someone as a verified student

words.enDefinition: a status showing the requested check was completed and accepted

examples.en: The page displayed verified successfully just before the student offer appeared on my account.
examples.zh: 学生优惠在账户中出现前，页面先显示了「核验成功」。

examples.en: I saved the verified successfully message in case I needed it at the checkout desk.
examples.zh: 我保存了「核验成功」的消息，以防结账柜台用得上。

words.enDefinition: to check records that show whether someone currently qualifies as a student

examples.en: The retailer asked the service to verify student status before applying the special price.
examples.zh: 零售商先请服务机构「核验学生身份」，才使用特价。

examples.en: The website explained how to verify student status using an enrolment letter from university.
examples.zh: 网站说明了如何用学校的注册证明「核验学生身份」。

collocations: use documents to verify student status

words.enDefinition: To open the list of items currently selected for purchase.

examples.en: I clicked “View cart” to make sure the lamp was still on the list.
examples.zh: 我点了「查看购物车」，确认台灯还在列表里。

examples.en: The store displayed a “View cart” link after I added a packet of refills.
examples.zh: 我加了一包替芯后，商店显示了「查看购物车」链接。

words.enDefinition: clothes from an earlier era valued for their age or style

examples.en: My cousin sells vintage clothing at a small stall in the covered market.
examples.zh: 表亲在有顶市场的一个小摊位卖「复古旧衣」。

examples.en: The drama society borrowed some vintage clothing for a play set in the seventies.
examples.zh: 话剧社借来了一些「复古旧衣」，用于一部以七十年代为背景的戏。

words.zhGloss: 取消一件已录入的商品
words.enDefinition: to remove a recorded item from the current sale
acceptedZhAnswers: 取消一件已录入的商品

examples.en: The cashier had to void an item after the scanner beeped twice.
examples.zh: 扫描器响了两次后，收银员只好「取消一件已录入的商品」。

examples.en: I asked whether she could void an item before I finished at the checkout.
examples.zh: 我问还没结完账，她能不能「取消一件已录入的商品」。

collocations: ask staff to void an item

words.enDefinition: The amount of money a voucher represents when applied to a purchase.

examples.en: The voucher value appeared in large print below the name of the shopping event.
examples.zh: 购物活动名称下方用大字标出了「券面金额」。

examples.en: I checked the voucher value before working out what I still needed to pay.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「券面金额」，再算自己还要付多少钱。

words.enDefinition: the distance measured around the waist

examples.en: I used my waist measurement to choose between two pairs of jeans.
examples.zh: 我根据自己的「腰围尺寸」在两条牛仔裤里挑了一条。

examples.en: The assistant checked my waist measurement before suggesting another pair of trousers.
examples.zh: 店员先核对了我的「腰围尺寸」，再推荐另一条裤子。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the process cannot continue until the seller responds

examples.en: The case still said “waiting on the seller” when I checked after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后查看时，工单仍然显示「等待卖家答复」。

examples.en: I asked what “waiting on the seller” meant for the order page.
examples.zh: 我问订单页面上的「等待卖家答复」是在说什么。

collocations: a case marked “waiting on the seller”

words.enDefinition: to take a few steps while wearing the shoes being tried

examples.en: The assistant suggested I walk around in them before choosing a size.
examples.zh: 店员建议我先「穿着它们走一走」，再选尺码。

examples.en: Can I walk around in them to see how the soles feel?
examples.zh: 我能「穿着它们走一走」，感受一下鞋底吗？

collocations: try to walk around in them
ask if you can walk around in them
walk around in them for a minute

words.enDefinition: an advertisement asking for a specific item someone wants

examples.en: I posted a wanted ad for a used copy of our chemistry textbook.
examples.zh: 我发了一则「求购广告」，想找我们化学教材的二手书。

examples.en: Two neighbours replied to my wanted ad for a small sewing machine.
examples.zh: 有两位邻居回复了我想买小型缝纫机的「求购广告」。

words.enDefinition: an Australian term for a promise to provide a specified remedy if a product has a defect

examples.en: The Australian consumer guide discusses a warranty against defects under its own heading.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚消费者指南有单独一节介绍「缺陷保修承诺」。

examples.en: I checked who issued the warranty against defects for the small kitchen appliance.
examples.zh: 我核对了这件小厨电的「缺陷保修承诺」由谁提供。

collocations: make a claim under a warranty against defects

words.enDefinition: a small booklet containing a product's warranty information

examples.en: I read the warranty booklet to see who handled repair requests outside my city.
examples.zh: 我读了「保修手册」，想知道本市之外由谁受理维修申请。

examples.en: The warranty booklet had a table showing which accessories were covered by the promise.
examples.zh: 「保修手册」有张表，写着哪些配件在承诺范围内。

words.enDefinition: a document identifying a product and recording the attached warranty

examples.en: The shop stamped the warranty certificate before putting it back inside the box.
examples.zh: 商店为「保修凭证」盖了章，再将它放回盒内。

examples.en: I found the warranty certificate underneath the cable and the printed user guide.
examples.zh: 我在数据线和纸质用户指南下面找到了「保修凭证」。

words.enDefinition: a request for a repair, replacement, or other remedy under a warranty

examples.en: I submitted a warranty claim after the shop checked the purchase date on my receipt.
examples.zh: 商店核对了收据上的购买日期后，我提交了「保修申请」。

examples.en: The service team asked for a brief description of the fault in my warranty claim.
examples.zh: 服务团队请我在「保修申请」中简要说明故障。

words.enDefinition: a status saying the seller or manufacturer accepted the warranty request

examples.en: The portal read warranty claim approved after the service team inspected the defective screen.
examples.zh: 服务团队检查屏幕故障后，门户网站显示「保修申请已批准」。

examples.en: I got a warranty claim approved notice while waiting for a reply from the shop.
examples.zh: 等店家回复时，我收到了一条「保修申请已批准」的通知。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the warranty provider decided not to accept a request

examples.en: The email said warranty claim denied and included the outcome of the inspection.
examples.zh: 邮件写着「保修申请已被拒」，并附上了检验结果。

examples.en: I checked the part number again after noticing warranty claim denied on the service page.
examples.zh: 我看到服务页面显示「保修申请已被拒」，又查了一遍部件编号。

words.enDefinition: a form used to give details needed to assess a warranty claim

examples.en: The warranty claim form had a separate box for the product's full model number.
examples.zh: 「保修申请表」上有一栏专门填写产品的完整型号。

examples.en: I attached a picture of the loose hinge to my warranty claim form that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我把松动铰链的照片附在了「保修申请表」上。

collocations: fill in a warranty claim form

words.enDefinition: a unique number used to identify a request made under a warranty

examples.en: I read out the warranty claim number when the clerk answered the service line.
examples.zh: 客服接通服务热线时，我报出了「保修申请编号」。

examples.en: The email put my warranty claim number beside the date it received the product.
examples.zh: 邮件把「保修申请编号」放在收到产品的日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: the current stage or outcome of a request under a warranty

examples.en: The account showed my warranty claim status after I verified the serial number online.
examples.zh: 我在网上验证序列号后，账户显示了「保修申请进度」。

examples.en: I checked the warranty claim status before deciding whether to borrow another computer for class.
examples.zh: 我先查了「保修申请进度」，再决定要不要借另一台电脑上课。

words.enDefinition: the faults, parts, services, or costs included in a warranty

examples.en: The website showed different warranty coverage for the main unit and the battery.
examples.zh: 网站显示，主机和电池的「保修范围」不同。

examples.en: I contacted support to confirm the warranty coverage before dropping off my laptop.
examples.zh: 我先联系了客服确认「保修范围」，才把笔记本电脑送去。

words.enDefinition: whether the product or request meets the conditions for warranty service

examples.en: The agent checked warranty eligibility using the date on the original sales receipt.
examples.zh: 客服用原始购物小票上的日期核对了「保修适用资格」。

examples.en: I asked what affected warranty eligibility before moving the equipment to my new flat.
examples.zh: 把设备搬到新公寓前，我问了什么会影响「保修适用资格」。

words.enDefinition: faults or situations explicitly left outside the scope of a warranty

examples.en: The warranty exclusions explained which kinds of damage the manufacturer would assess separately.
examples.zh: 「保修除外事项」说明了哪些损坏情形需要由生产商另行评估。

examples.en: I noticed the warranty exclusions after reading the cover promised for electrical faults.
examples.zh: 看完针对电气故障的保障后，我注意到了「保修除外事项」。

words.enDefinition: the date when a product's warranty is due to end

examples.en: I wrote the warranty expiry date next to the purchase date in my notebook.
examples.zh: 我把「保修截止日期」记在笔记本的购买日期旁边。

examples.en: The service page showed my warranty expiry date after I entered the serial number.
examples.zh: 输入序列号后，服务页面显示了我的「保修截止日期」。

words.enDefinition: an increase in the time a warranty remains in effect

examples.en: The service centre confirmed a warranty extension after processing my service request that month.
examples.zh: 服务中心处理我当月的服务申请后，确认了「保修期限延长」。

examples.en: I checked the new expiry date shown after the warranty extension was applied.
examples.zh: 「保修期限延长」生效后，我检查了显示的最新到期日。

words.expression: warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
words.lemma: warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
words.zhGloss: 特定用途适用性默示担保
words.enDefinition: a US implied warranty when the seller knows the buyer's specific purpose and the buyer relies on the seller's judgement
acceptedZhAnswers: 特定用途适用性默示担保
acceptedEnVariants: warranty of fitness for a particular purpose

examples.en: Our US course guide listed warranty of fitness for a particular purpose under implied warranties.
examples.zh: 我们的美国课程指南把「特定用途适用性默示担保」列在默示担保下。

examples.en: The lecturer discussed the warranty of fitness for a particular purpose in a camping example.
examples.zh: 讲师用一个露营例子讲解了「特定用途适用性默示担保」。

collocations: implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
claim involving a warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
breach of a warranty of fitness for a particular purpose

words.enDefinition: an implied promise under US law that goods are suitable for their ordinary use

examples.en: The US reading used a kettle to illustrate the warranty of merchantability in class.
examples.zh: 美国的阅读材料用水壶说明课堂上的「适销性默示担保」。

examples.en: I looked up warranty of merchantability after seeing the phrase in a consumer guide.
examples.zh: 我在消费者指南上看到这个短语后，查了「适销性默示担保」。

collocations: breach of the warranty of merchantability

words.enDefinition: the length of time during which a product's warranty applies

examples.en: I checked the warranty period because the screen started flickering almost a year later.
examples.zh: 屏幕差不多隔了一年才开始闪烁，我就查了「保修期」。

examples.en: The information sheet gave a shorter warranty period for the included battery pack.
examples.zh: 说明单上写着，随附电池的「保修期」更短。

words.enDefinition: a substitute item provided to resolve a fault covered by a warranty

examples.en: The warranty replacement arrived before the start of classes in the autumn term.
examples.zh: 「保修替换品」在秋季学期开课前到了。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the warranty replacement had the same port as my old monitor.
examples.zh: 店员确认了「保修替换品」是否与我旧显示器的接口相同。

words.enDefinition: repair or other assistance provided within the terms of a warranty

examples.en: The local shop handled warranty service for the monitor I bought at another branch.
examples.zh: 本地门店受理了我在另一家分店买的显示器的「保修服务」。

examples.en: I asked where warranty service was available after moving to a new city for school.
examples.zh: 我搬到一座新城市读书后，询问哪里可以获得「保修服务」。

words.enDefinition: a location that accepts and carries out work covered by a warranty

examples.en: The nearest warranty service centre was just beyond the station, opposite the library.
examples.zh: 最近的「保修服务中心」刚过车站，就在图书馆对面。

examples.en: I called the warranty service centre to check which models it could handle locally.
examples.zh: 我打电话给「保修服务中心」，确认当地可以受理哪些型号。

words.enDefinition: the date from which a warranty begins to apply

examples.en: The help centre asked for the warranty start date printed on the product record.
examples.zh: 服务中心要求提供产品记录上印的「保修起始日期」。

examples.en: I compared the warranty start date with the day the retailer dispatched my order.
examples.zh: 我把「保修起始日期」与零售商发出订单的日期做了对照。

words.enDefinition: the conditions describing what a warranty provides and how it applies

examples.en: I checked the warranty terms before taking the speakers to a local repair shop.
examples.zh: 把音箱拿去本地维修店前，我先查了「保修条款」。

examples.en: The warranty terms listed a separate contact address for items bought outside the country.
examples.zh: 「保修条款」为境外购买的商品另列了一个联系地址。

words.enDefinition: passing an existing warranty from one owner of a product to another

examples.en: The seller gave me a separate reference for the warranty transfer after the purchase.
examples.zh: 购买后，卖家单独给了我一个「保修权利转移」的编号。

examples.en: I asked whether the warranty transfer would change the original coverage ending date.
examples.zh: 我问「保修权利转移」是否会改变原来的保修到期日。

words.enDefinition: a status meaning that a particular warranty no longer applies

examples.en: The service team wrote warranty void on its decision about the damaged headphones.
examples.zh: 服务团队在有关损坏耳机的决定上写了「保修失效」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the system showed warranty void for that serial number.
examples.zh: 客服解释了为什么系统对那个序列号显示「保修失效」。

words.enDefinition: wording on a label stating a warranty condition about removing the label or component

examples.en: The repair form asked whether the seal marked “Warranty void if removed” was intact.
examples.zh: 维修表问，写着「标签拆除则保修失效」的封签是否完好。

examples.en: I photographed the sticker saying “Warranty void if removed” for the support representative.
examples.zh: 我把写着「标签拆除则保修失效」的标签拍给了客服。

words.enDefinition: A display comparing a seller’s stated previous price with its current price.

examples.en: The shop used was-now pricing on the sign above the discounted calculators near the entrance.
examples.zh: 店铺在入口旁打折计算器上方的牌子上用了「原价现价对照标示」。

examples.en: The website used was-now pricing, showing the earlier amount above the current price for the lamp.
examples.zh: 网站用了「原价现价对照标示」，在台灯现价上方列出此前的价格。

collocations: show was-now pricing for a sale item

words.expression: we have all the information we need
words.lemma: we have all the information we need
words.zhGloss: 我们需要的资料都齐了
words.enDefinition: a confirmation that staff have enough information to continue
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们需要的资料都齐了
acceptedEnVariants: we have all the information we need

examples.en: The adviser replied, “We have all the information we need,” and ended the chat.
examples.zh: 客服回复「我们需要的资料都齐了」，然后结束了聊天。

examples.en: “We have all the information we need,” the agent said after I confirmed the address.
examples.zh: 我确认完地址后，客服说「我们需要的资料都齐了」。

collocations: say “We have all the information we need”
“We have all the information we need for now”
“We have all the information we need to review it”

words.expression: we'll contact you once we hear back
words.lemma: we'll contact you once we hear back
words.zhGloss: 收到回复后我们会联系你
words.enDefinition: a promise to get in touch after another party replies
acceptedZhAnswers: 收到回复后我们会联系你
acceptedEnVariants: we'll contact you once we hear back

examples.en: “We'll contact you once we hear back,” the adviser said after messaging the seller.
examples.zh: 给卖家发完消息后，客服说「收到回复后我们会联系你」。

examples.en: The store asked its warehouse and wrote, “We'll contact you once we hear back.”
examples.zh: 店铺询问了仓库，然后写道「收到回复后我们会联系你」。

collocations: say “We'll contact you once we hear back”
“We'll contact you once we hear back from the seller”
“We'll contact you once we hear back from our warehouse”

words.enDefinition: a request from support for an image of the issue

examples.en: The seller wrote, “We need a photo,” after asking whether the box was intact.
examples.zh: 卖家问箱子完不完整，接着写道「我们需要一张照片」。

examples.en: “We need a photo,” the adviser said, pointing to the worn label.
examples.zh: 客服指着磨损的标签说「我们需要一张照片」。

collocations: “We need a photo of the serial number”
“We need a photo of the whole package”

words.enDefinition: a response saying staff are finding out what happened

examples.en: The reply said, “We're looking into it,” after I showed the two receipts.
examples.zh: 我出示两张收据后，对方回复「我们正在查」。

examples.en: The agent said, “We're looking into it,” and asked me to stay in the chat.
examples.zh: 客服说「我们正在查」，并请我先别离开聊天窗口。

collocations: “We're looking into it with the warehouse”

words.enDefinition: a response confirming that staff asked the warehouse about the matter

examples.en: The seller wrote, “We've checked with the warehouse,” before confirming what was packed.
examples.zh: 卖家写道「我们已和仓库核实」，然后确认了装箱内容。

examples.en: “We've checked with the warehouse,” the agent said before describing the other box.
examples.zh: 在说明另一个箱子的情况前，客服说「我们已和仓库核实」。

collocations: “We've checked with the warehouse about this item”
“We've checked with the warehouse and will email you”

words.enDefinition: The maximum weight an item is designed to hold.

examples.en: I compared the shelf's weight capacity with the weight of the books I keep beside my bed.
examples.zh: 我把架子的「承重上限」和床边那些书的重量作了比较。

examples.en: The listing stated a separate weight capacity for each of the two wall hooks.
examples.zh: 商品页分别注明了两个墙钩各自的「承重上限」。

words.enDefinition: A promotion intended for someone new to a shop or service.

examples.en: The shop sent a welcome offer after I signed up to receive its email updates.
examples.zh: 我订阅邮件动态后，店铺发来一项「新客优惠」。

examples.en: I saved the welcome offer until I knew which supplies we needed for the project.
examples.zh: 我把「新客优惠」留了下来，等确定项目需要哪些用品再用。

collocations: a welcome offer for new customers

words.enDefinition: a benefit offered to someone after they join a programme

examples.en: The first email said my welcome reward would appear after the initial purchase.
examples.zh: 第一封邮件说，首次消费后就会显示「入会奖励」。

examples.en: I checked the welcome reward before deciding which items to buy that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午决定买什么之前，我查看了「入会奖励」。

words.enDefinition: used a lot and often showing wear as a result

examples.en: The listing described the chair as well loved and showed its worn corners.
examples.zh: 帖子称这把椅子「用过不少」，还展示了磨损的边角。

examples.en: The doll was well loved, with faded clothes and one missing shoe.
examples.zh: 这个娃娃「玩过很多次」了，衣服褪了色，还少了一只鞋。

words.enDefinition: a question asking what result someone wants from a complaint

examples.en: The platform asked, “What is your preferred outcome?” before opening the text box.
examples.zh: 文字框打开前，平台问「你希望怎么解决？」

examples.en: The supervisor read my email and then asked, “What is your preferred outcome?”
examples.zh: 主管读了我的邮件，然后问「你希望怎么解决？」

collocations: “What is your preferred outcome in this situation?”
“What is your preferred outcome for this order?”

words.enDefinition: A heading introducing the items included in a product's package.

examples.en: The “What's in the box” section listed a stand, a cable, and a printed leaflet.
examples.zh: 「包装内含物」一栏列了一个支架、一根线和一份印刷说明单。

examples.en: I checked “What's in the box” before deciding whether to add a cable to the order.
examples.zh: 我先看了「包装内含物」，再决定订单里要不要加一根线。

collocations: a section titled what's in the box
a what's in the box list

words.expression: where do I collect online orders
words.lemma: where do i collect online orders
words.enDefinition: a question asking where a shop hands over online purchases
acceptedEnVariants: where do I collect online orders

examples.en: I saw several desks and asked, “Where do I collect online orders?”
examples.zh: 我看到好几个柜台，便问「网上订单到哪儿取？」

examples.en: “Where do I collect online orders?” my friend asked the attendant by the stairs.
examples.zh: 朋友问楼梯旁的店员「网上订单到哪儿取？」

collocations: ask “Where do I collect online orders?”
“Where do I collect online orders at this store?”
“Where do I collect online orders after six?”

words.enDefinition: a question asking which store aisle contains an item

examples.en: “Which aisle is it in?” I asked when we couldn't find the soap.
examples.zh: 我们找不到香皂，我就问「它在几号过道？」

examples.en: The clerk said they had folders, so I asked, “Which aisle is it in?”
examples.zh: 店员说有文件夹，我就问「它在几号过道？」

collocations: “Which aisle is it in at this branch?”

words.enDefinition: An offer condition limiting availability to the stock set aside for it.

examples.en: The sign said the free notebooks were available while supplies last at the campus fair.
examples.zh: 告示写着，校园集市的免费笔记本「送完为止」。

examples.en: I noticed “While supplies last” beneath the offer on the stationery store's website.
examples.zh: 我在文具店网站优惠信息的下方看到「送完或售完为止」。

collocations: an offer running while supplies last
a sign reading while supplies last

words.enDefinition: a shoe fit with extra space across the foot

examples.en: The assistant suggested a wide fit after I tried the regular pair.
examples.zh: 试过普通版后，店员建议我试试「宽楦版鞋」。

examples.en: I found a wide fit in the same style at the other shop.
examples.zh: 我在另一家店找到了同款的「宽楦版鞋」。

words.enDefinition: A way of listing width first and height second in measurements.

examples.en: The frame measurements were listed as width by height in the sheet beneath the pictures.
examples.zh: 相框的尺寸在照片下方的表格中按「宽乘高」列出。

examples.en: I checked whether the figures were given as width by height before ordering the board.
examples.zh: 订购那块板之前，我核对了尺寸是不是按「宽乘高」写的。

collocations: measurements given as width by height

words.enDefinition: the final successful price offered by a bidder at auction

examples.en: The winning bid for the desk was less than I had expected.
examples.zh: 那张书桌的「最高成交出价」比我预想的低。

examples.en: My friend placed the winning bid for the bicycle at the student auction.
examples.zh: 朋友在学生拍卖会上给那辆自行车报出了「最高成交出价」。

words.enDefinition: A saved list of products a shopper might want later.

examples.en: My roommate put the lamp on her wish list while she measured the space beside her bed.
examples.zh: 室友把灯加到了「心愿单」，留着先量一下床边还有多少空间。

examples.en: I shared my wish list with my sister so she could see my favorite notebook designs.
examples.zh: 我把「心愿单」分享给了姐姐，让她看看我最喜欢的笔记本款式。

collocations: add something to a wish list

words.enDefinition: indicating that an item lacks the box it originally came in

examples.en: I bought the game without the original box at a stall near the station.
examples.zh: 我在车站附近的摊位买了这款游戏，「不带原包装盒」。

examples.en: The seller offered the camera without the original box but included a soft case.
examples.zh: 卖家的相机「不带原包装盒」，不过附带一个软包。

words.enDefinition: a description of the actual services carried out on an item

examples.en: The service order listed the work performed beside the charge for each part.
examples.zh: 维修服务单在每项零件费用旁列出「已完成的维修工作」。

examples.en: I compared the work performed with what the technician had promised on Friday.
examples.zh: 我把「已完成的维修工作」与维修人员周五的承诺做了比较。

words.enDefinition: Ends up costing less once the relevant amounts are compared.

examples.en: The refill pack works out cheaper per sheet if I use it for both classes.
examples.zh: 如果两门课都用这个内页补充装，按张「算下来更便宜」。

examples.en: Buying locally works out cheaper once I include the delivery charge from the other shop.
examples.zh: 把另一家店的配送费算进去，在本地买「算下来更便宜」。

words.enDefinition: Describes an upgrade or alternative whose benefits justify its higher price.

examples.en: We decided the sturdier display board was worth the extra cost for our exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们觉得展览用更牢固的展示板「值得多花这笔钱」。

examples.en: I wasn’t sure the extra dividers were worth the extra cost of the larger binder.
examples.zh: 我不确定大款活页夹多出的这几张隔页「值不值得多花这笔钱」。

collocations: decide whether something is worth the extra cost
consider something worth the extra cost

words.enDefinition: An expression used in reviews to say someone would suggest an item to others.

examples.en: The review said “Would recommend” and explained why the organizer worked well in a dorm.
examples.zh: 评价写了「愿意推荐」，还说了为什么这款收纳架在宿舍里好用。

examples.en: I wrote that I would recommend the folder to anyone who carries notes between classes.
examples.zh: 我在评价中写道，自己「愿意推荐」这款文件夹给课间携带笔记的人。

collocations: would recommend it for daily use
say you would recommend an item

words.enDefinition: to place separate wrapping around every item instead of combining them

examples.en: Could you wrap each one individually so the two cups don't knock together?
examples.zh: 能「每件单独包起来」吗？这样两只杯子就不会相碰。

examples.en: I asked the assistant to wrap each one individually before putting them in the bag.
examples.zh: 我请店员先「每件单独包起来」，再把它们装进袋子。

collocations: ask staff to wrap each one individually
wrap each one individually in paper
could you wrap each one individually

words.enDefinition: to put several purchases in the same gift wrapping

examples.en: Could you wrap these together so I can give them as one gift?
examples.zh: 能「把这几样包在一起」吗？我想当成一份礼物送人。

examples.en: I asked the clerk to wrap these together with the matching card.
examples.zh: 我请店员「把这几样和配套卡片包在一起」。

collocations: ask someone to wrap these together
wrap these together in one box
could you wrap these together as one gift

words.enDefinition: decorative paper used to cover a present

examples.en: I chose green wrapping paper for the book we bought our tutor.
examples.zh: 我们买了本书送导师，我选了绿色的「礼品包装纸」。

examples.en: The assistant cut a piece of wrapping paper to fit the box.
examples.zh: 店员裁了一张大小适合盒子的「礼品包装纸」。

collocations: cover a box in wrapping paper

words.enDefinition: To submit a written opinion based on experience with an item.

examples.en: I decided to write a review after using the laptop stand for an entire semester.
examples.zh: 那款电脑支架用了一整个学期后，我决定「撰写评价」。

examples.en: The shop invited me to write a review a week after the organizer arrived.
examples.zh: 收纳架送到一周后，商家邀请我「撰写评价」。

collocations: write a review of an item
be invited to write a review

words.enDefinition: a written statement of how much a repair is expected to cost

examples.en: I asked for a written estimate before deciding whether to repair the old laptop.
examples.zh: 决定要不要修旧笔记本电脑之前，我要了一份「书面报价」。

examples.en: The written estimate listed labour separately from the new keyboard and delivery.
examples.zh: 「书面报价」把人工费与新键盘和配送费分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the result of a decision provided in a written message

examples.en: I received a written outcome although the case had been discussed by phone.
examples.zh: 这笔工单是电话沟通的，我也收到了「书面处理结果」。

examples.en: I checked the written outcome before explaining the agreement to my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先查看「书面处理结果」，然后向室友解释了双方约好的事。

words.enDefinition: a promise about product coverage recorded in a document

examples.en: I saved a copy of the written warranty with the receipt from the shop.
examples.zh: 我把「书面保修承诺」副本与商店收据一起保存。

examples.en: The assistant showed me where the written warranty listed the excluded parts for the device.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了「书面保修承诺」上哪里列着设备不在保修范围内的部件。

words.enDefinition: a return reason showing that the seller shipped a different item from the one ordered

examples.en: I chose wrong item sent because the box contained the smaller model instead.
examples.zh: 盒子里装的是小一号的型号，所以我选了「发错商品」。

examples.en: The service agent added wrong item sent to the notes for my return.
examples.zh: 客服人员在我的退货备注中加入了「发错商品」。

collocations: wrong item sent by the seller

words.enDefinition: a number of items different from what was ordered

examples.en: I reported the wrong quantity after counting the notebooks in the two boxes.
examples.zh: 数过两个箱子里的笔记本后，我报告说「数量不对」。

examples.en: The seller admitted that the wrong quantity had been packed at the warehouse.
examples.zh: 卖家承认仓库装箱时「数量装错了」。

words.enDefinition: a shipped item whose size differs from the size ordered

examples.en: I chose “wrong size sent” and showed the label inside the shirt.
examples.zh: 我选了「尺码发错了」，给客服看了衬衫里面的标签。

examples.en: The chat window showed “wrong size sent” as one possible reason to contact support.
examples.zh: 聊天窗口把「尺码发错了」列为联系客户支持的一个原因。

collocations: report that the wrong size was sent
